jobs.description:
About Us:

Good Business Lab (GBL) is a research-to-action nonprofit that advances access to high-quality jobs for low-income workers. We believe a truly good job is more than wages — it creates conditions for workers to thrive. Yet too few workers have access to sustained wage growth, supportive workplaces, and real opportunities for advancement. GBL works to change this by expanding pathways into better-fit, higher-opportunity work and improving job quality within large employers. We study worker needs, partner with workers and employers to co-design interventions that serve both individual and business goals, and evaluate impact through causal methods. Across manufacturing, retail, and food service, our work shows that improving job quality also improves firm performance. Globally, we have directly improved outcomes for over 500,000 workers, with indirect reach across an ecosystem impacting nearly 2 million more.

The founders of the GBL are Ach Adhvaryu – Professor of Economics, Director of 21st Century India Center, School of Global Policy and Strategy at UC San Diego, Anant Ahuja – Director of ESG and Sustainability at Shahi Exports Pvt. Ltd. (India’s largest Ready Made Garment firm), and Anant Nyshadham – Associate Professor of Business Economics and Public Policy at the University of Michigan.

About the role

The Senior Associate – Digital Marketing & Communications will be the primary operational owner of GBL’s website and digital marketing systems. The role will ensure that GBL’s research, solutions, insights, and organisational story are presented through accurate, accessible, engaging, and measurable digital experiences. You will combine hands-on website management with SEO, analytics, digital campaigns, technical support for events, vendor coordination, and cross-functional project management. You will work closely with colleagues across Marketing & Communications, Growth, Research, Programmes, and Design to convert organisational priorities into effective digital journeys and audience-facing outputs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of content, technology, design, and strategy and is equally comfortable making website updates, interpreting performance data, and coordinating specialists for more complex work.

We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to historically underrepresented and marginalized communities. If comfortable, please share your social location in your application. This information will be limited to the hiring team and will not have any detrimental impact on your candidature.

Location: Delhi/Bangalore/Remote

  • Maintain UTM, attribution, and conversion-tracking practices across social media, email, paid campaigns, and partner links.
  • Use performance data and user feedback to recommend improvements to content, website architecture, and digital campaigns.

Digital campaigns and content operations

  • Support integrated digital campaigns across the website, social media, email, and paid channels.
  • Work with content and design colleagues to adapt research, reports, and organisational updates into effective digital formats.
  • Support the execution of the editorial calendar and coordinate copy, design, review, approval, scheduling, and publishing workflows for digital marketing channels.
  • Build reusable campaign templates, checklists, content banks, and workflows that improve consistency and reduce last-minute production.
  • Support paid-media activity on platforms such as LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Manager, including setup, tracking, budget monitoring, and reporting.

Digital and technical support for events

  • Build and maintain event landing pages or microsites, registration and waitlist forms, confirmation flows, and related website components.

  • Coordinate with vendors or internal teams to troubleshoot forms, embeds, links, livestreams, and other technical requirements.
  • Conduct pre-launch quality assurance and post-event updates or archiving for digital event assets.

Project, vendor, and systems management

  • Convert broad objectives into project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, review points, and measurable outcomes.
  • Maintain accurate trackers and communicate timelines, blockers, risks, and trade-offs early.
  • Brief and coordinate website, design, development, analytics, or other specialist partners as required.

  • Maintain SOPs, templates, checklists, screen-recorded walkthroughs, and onboarding resources for recurring digital tasks.

Who are you?

Required technical skills and experience

Required behavioural skills

Job Description:

Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure


At Toppan Merrill, we're building Quinn, a cloud-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports.


We're applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter the most. This is a unique opportunity to join a small, highly visible team and help define the future of AI-assisted financial disclosure. You'll work directly with senior engineering leadership, engage with some of the world's largest law firms, and help shape a product already supported by a working prototype and strong market interest.

Most importantly, you'll be the first AI-dedicated Product Owner for Quinn. Your leadership will ensure we're building the right solutions for customers and bringing clarity, prioritization, and rigor to every product decision.


Learn more at . About Toppan Merrill

What You'll Do


As Principal Product Owner, you will lead product discovery and product execution for Quinn’s AI capabilities, translating Quinn’s broader product strategy into validated AI solutions and prioritized delivery.

You'll partner closely with engineering, legal, security, sales, and customers to translate market needs into innovative, practical solutions that professionals can trust.


Product Strategy & Ownership


  • Own and prioritize the Quinn AI product backlog.
  • Transform client feedback, market insights, and emerging product opportunities into clear, actionable requirements.
  • Define and maintain the Quinn AI roadmap, release priorities, and measurable success criteria in alignment with the broader Quinn product strategy.
  • Create detailed user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria that enable engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business priorities, and regulatory requirements when making product decisions.

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Lead product discovery with customers and design partners to understand workflows, identify unmet needs, validate concepts, and assess product-market fit.
  • Translate discovery insights into hypotheses, product decisions, experiments, and prioritized development opportunities.”
  • Distinguish problems that warrant AI solutions from those better addressed through conventional product capabilities or workflow changes.
  • Build trusted relationships with attorneys, corporate reporting leaders, and other detail-oriented professional users.

AI Product Delivery

  • Define the scope, success criteria, and acceptance standards for AI-powered features.
  • Establish quality thresholds for capabilities that attorneys and financial professionals will rely on in critical SEC reporting workflows.
  • Define evaluation frameworks and quality thresholds for AI capabilities, including accuracy, groundedness, completeness, consistency, and appropriate human oversight.”
  • Partner with Engineering to establish representative evaluation datasets, regression testing, and feedback loops that measure AI quality over time.
  • Define what AI features should and should not do within customer documents.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to establish realistic timelines and delivery commitments.
  • Review and approve product scope and release plans before commitments are shared externally.

Security, Compliance & Governance

  • Collaborate with Legal, Security, and Engineering teams to define appropriate handling of customer content and sensitive documents.
  • Ensure AI capabilities align with security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements.
  • Help shape responsible AI practices within a highly regulated environment.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

  • Establish a structured product discovery approach for Quinn AI and begin discovery with prospective and confirmed design partners.
  • Take ownership of the Quinn AI backlog and establish clear product priorities aligned with the broader Quinn roadmap.
  • Define and publish pilot scope, success metrics, and acceptance criteria.
  • Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Legal, Security, and executive stakeholders.

  • 7+ years of product management or product ownership experience delivering B2B software solutions.
  • Experience launching AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation capabilities for professional users.
  • Strong experience writing product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Proven ability to work directly with engineering teams to deliver complex products.

  • Ability to build credibility with senior, detail-oriented professional audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in legal technology, capital markets, SEC reporting, financial disclosure, compliance software, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with how law firms evaluate and approve technology, including security reviews, data privacy considerations, and vendor risk assessments.
  • Experience working with SaaS and cloud-based enterprise platforms.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location:

  • Preferred Locations: San Francisco, Austin, NYC OR Remote

About the Role

Cloudflare’s GTM organization is scaling rapidly, and its RevOps tech stack must scale with it. We are hiring a RevOps Technologist to shape future-state workflows and move our RevOps technology roadmap from strategy and prototype toward secure, scalable execution.

This senior individual contributor will combine deep Sales and Revenue Operations expertise with the hands-on technical fluency to identify strategic solutions and simplified workflows. You'll report directly to the Director of RevTech Strategy & Operations, and be the senior counterpart to our business partners, IT, Procurement, Engineering, Security & Privacy, to ensure our systems are optimized, and governed.

You will transform our rapidly scaling, today’s fragmented tech stack into a secure, orchestrated engine, across vendor platforms, internal tooling, and Cloudflare’s internal orchestration platform (Cloudflare OS). You will set the direction for Build/Buy/Blend opportunities, prototype AI- and automation-enabled capabilities, and partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production.

You will bring an end-to-end view across workflows, systems, data and integrations, to reduce complexity and elevate the seller experience while balancing technical feasibility with business value.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage the existing RevOps stack, but actively reimagines a scalable, best-in-class stack with a stellar seller experience. If you thrive on challenging the status quo, hands-on building with cutting-edge technology, and turning bold GTM ideas into high-impact reality, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do:

Shape the Future of RevTech & GTM Systems

  • Drive the AI-first RevOps technology roadmap across internal systems, Cloudflare OS, vendor platforms, and new build opportunities, to improve seller efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Identify where the stack needs to scale, simplify, or modernize based on jobs-to-be-done, user needs, and workflow friction points.
  • Connect technology decisions across the broader GTM ecosystem (workflows, systems, data, integrations, and dependencies) rather than optimizing individual tools in isolation.
  • Apply AI, agents, automation, and emerging technologies to practical opportunities that reduce friction, and modernize GTM operations.
  • Document current state-workflows, systems, dependencies and pain points to identify exactly where the stack needs to scale or simplify, and translate findings into clear future-state designs and recommendations.

Design, Prototype & Automate

  • Translate sales capabilities “jobs-to-be-done", workflow context, and user needs into clear technology requirements and solution approaches balancing user experience, scalability, and technical feasibility.
  • Architect solutions across the RevTech landscape that work cohesively with existing CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, data, and other seller technologies.
  • Leverage Cloudflare OS, AI, agents, and automation to prototype and build secure solutions, validating where tech adds value vs. human judgement is required.
  • Partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production, aligning on the APIs, MCPs, integrations, and security.

Drive Technology & Investment Strategy

  • Advise on build, buy, blend, or retire decisions based on time-to-value, scalability, security, cost, and flexibility.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary SaaS dependency, utilizing Cloudflare OS or internal capabilities where appropriate.
  • Bring a technical and strategic lens to technology investments, partnering with Procurement, Software Asset Management, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate vendors and inform a ROI-backed roadmap investments.

Own Governance & Systems Standards

  • Define governance, intake models, and decision guardrails for RevTech and AI use cases.
  • Participate in cross-functional AI initiatives to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI-enabled seller workflows.
  • Establish auditable RevTech change controls with clear governance based on risk and impact.
  • Ensure vendors and internal builds comply with security, privacy, data, and AI standards.

Strategic Partnership & Communications

  • Build trusted relationships across GTM, tech teams, business partners and vendors as a trusted advisor on priorities, trade-offs, and future-state direction.
  • Translate complex tech concepts and ROI assessments into clear, decision-ready executive recommendations and business impact analyses.
  • Leverage external benchmarks (e.g., Gartner) and industry trends to inform tool strategy.
  • Support the RevTech budget planning and stewardship in partnership with business partners, Finance and procurement.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Ops, Business Systems, or related roles within B2B SaaS organizations.
  • Deep understanding of B2B seller workflows, sales processes, and the broader GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Deep, hands-on experience across GTM technology ecosystem, including CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, revenue orchestration, enablement, data, and automation (e.g; Salesforce, Clari, Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Highspot, LinkedIn Navigator, Clay etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with AI, agents, and automation, with ability to rapidly prototype solutions, test assumptions, and solve business problems.
  • Solid conceptual and practical understanding of how modern tools connect via APIs, data flows, and “headless” architecture (separating the custom UI a seller uses from the backend).
  • 5+ years driving cross-functional technology initiatives, from discovery, vendor evaluation and solution design to secure implementation and adoption across the enterprise.
  • Proven track record of evaluating technology options, identifying build/buy/blend opportunities, developing ROI-backed recommendations, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive enterprise alignment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, marketing, or a technical field is required (Master’s or advanced degree, or AI/data training, is a plus).

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on building with emerging AI agent frameworks, custom GPTs, or AI-driven workflow tools to enhance seller productivity.
  • Background in consulting or solution architecture, with exposure to advisory frameworks (e.g; Gartner, Forrester).
  • Certifications: Salesforce (Advanced Administrator, Sales Cloud, AI Associate) or any relevant AI, or business systems certifications.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare products, commercial negotiations, and tech marketplace dynamics.
  • Experience standing up internal automation platforms or replacing SaaS tools with internal builds.

An experienced clinical research professional who brings strong quality focus, analytical thinking, clear communication, sound judgment, and the ability to work collaboratively across virtual teams. At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. The Team:

Upstart’s Brand & Creative team shapes how people discover, understand, and experience Upstart. Our web team brings together design, SEO, content, and production to create useful, engaging experiences that support our brand and business goals.

As the Senior Web Producer at Upstart, you’ll manage web requests across products and stakeholders, turn priorities into production plans, and build and publish pages in WordPress and Instapage. You’ll partner with our Lead Web Designer, SEO / Web Lead, channel owners, and Engineering to keep work moving and balance business impact within the limitations of team capacity.   • Manage web intake and prioritization. Clarify goals and requirements across products and stakeholders. Partner with Design, our SEO / Web Lead, and Engineering to assess impact, scope effort, and negotiate priorities, timelines, and tradeoffs.

  • Familiarity with Figma, basic HTML/CSS, and headless CMS workflows.

  • Experience improving publishing processes, documenting workflows, and managing platform access and governance.

Time zone requirements The team operates on the West coast time zones.

Role Title: Humanitarian Aid Representative

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Humanitarian Aid Representatives to contribute their field expertise in humanitarian and civilian protection for a unique project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. The focus of this engagement is to design, review, and refine scenarios involving civilian harm, protected persons, and the boundaries of legitimate activity, ensuring responses are grounded in International Humanitarian Law (IHL) and best practices in humanitarian action. Strong written and verbal communication skills are highly valued, as your insights and documentation will directly influence AI performance and sensitivity to complex humanitarian concerns.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop nuanced cases and scenarios focused on civilian protection, proportionality, and humanitarian constraints for AI model evaluation.
  2. Assess and grade AI-generated responses for accuracy, depth of reasoning, and sensitivity to civilian-harm considerations.
  3. Identify and flag instances of excessive caution or insufficient restraint in model responses, highlighting humanitarian implications.
  4. Document challenging or ambiguous cases from a humanitarian perspective to inform future training and refinement.
  5. Collaborate with project stakeholders to clarify humanitarian concepts and contribute to guidance on IHL-related reasoning.
  6. Maintain precise, clear, and context-rich records of findings and recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Background in humanitarian operations, protection, or policy with organizations such as ICRC/Red Cross, UN agencies, or major NGOs.
  2. Strong grounding in International Humanitarian Law and civilian-protection principles.
  3. Experience in teaching, training, or field leadership related to humanitarian action or IHL dissemination.
  4. Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, especially in crafting and reviewing complex case material.
  5. Proven ability to apply proportionality reasoning in conflict or protection scenarios.
  6. Experience documenting or reporting on edge cases or challenging humanitarian situations.
  7. Conflict-zone fieldwork, protection-cluster participation, or IHL-dissemination experience is highly valued.

This role provides timely and detailed service to ensure all critical deadlines, court dates, and case-related events are accurately recorded, tracked, and communicated to attorneys and staff. The specialist works closely with legal teams to review court filings, monitor rules and procedures, and update the docket database with relevant information. The Specialist also provides comprehensive administrative and filing support, assists in departmental initiatives, special projects, and handles a variety of docketing and calendaring tasks.

  • Research and/or monitor cases with the use of various online resources, and provide court filing and service information.
  • Respond promptly and professionally to information requests from attorneys and professional staff regarding docketed dates, agency and court rules and procedures.
  • Generate calendar reports and queries for case teams based upon standard procedures, and generate custom docket reports and queries as requested.
  • Assist with service and filing of court documents.
  • Perform Electronic Court Filings in Federal, State and Appellate Courts.

  • Occasional travel to local courts and agencies.
  • Other duties as assigned to fully meet the requirements of the position.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Minimum two (2) years docketing experience in a law firm docket department required.

  • Proficient with Microsoft Office suite applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks in a high-pressure environment.
  • Excellent communication, time management and organizational skills.
  • Strong collaborative skills and flexibility to adapt to changing department procedures when necessary.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving and service skills.
  • Available to work overtime and/or do limited business travel.

Education

The position requires a Bachelor’s Degree. Equivalent training and legal experience may substitute for education.

Experience

The position requires a minimum of two (2) years of docketing experience during which knowledge, skills and abilities relevant to the position were attained.

$70,000 - $110,000 - Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Los Angeles, Minneapolis, Orange County, Waltham, and Washington DC

jobs.excerpt: About LyraLyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships.
jobs.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

As a therapist within our Pediatric Outpatient Service Line, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of children, teens, young adults, and their families while working as part of an integrated clinical team.

You'll provide evidence-based, developmentally appropriate therapy that helps members build resilience, strengthen relationships, develop effective coping skills, and make progress toward individualized treatment goals. Depending on the member's age and clinical needs, treatment may also involve partnering with parents or caregivers to reinforce skills, support treatment goals, and promote meaningful change outside of therapy sessions.

Therapists are an integral part of our collaborative care model. You'll work closely with behavioral case managers, psychiatric providers, nurses, coaches, and other clinical team members to ensure members receive coordinated care that reflects their individual, developmental, and family needs.

This role is a great fit for an independently NY licensed behavioral health clinician who is passionate about supporting children, teens, and young adults, values collaboration, and is comfortable adapting treatment across developmental stages. You'll have opportunities to expand your clinical expertise through consultation, ongoing training, evidence-based care practices, and collaboration with an interdisciplinary team.

We are looking for a part-time licensed therapist to join our Pediatric Care Services clinical team. This role sits within the Pediatric Outpatient Service Line and reports to a Clinical Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and family therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and caregivers.

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral health assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.

  • Utilize evidence-based modalities, including CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, trauma-informed interventions, and other approaches appropriate to the member's clinical and developmental needs.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists, behavioral case managers, coaches, nurses, and other interdisciplinary team members to provide coordinated care.

  • Engage caregivers as active partners in treatment when clinically and developmentally appropriate through psychoeducation, collaborative goal setting, and skills coaching.

  • Maintain timely, accurate, clinically meaningful, and compliant documentation.

  • Participate in clinical consultation, supervision, ongoing training, and professional development.

  • Support quality improvement initiatives and the continued delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care.

Requirements:

  • Ability to work part-time, 24 hours per week.

  • Availability to provide care during afternoon and evening hours to support member scheduling needs.

  • Potential opportunity to work Saturdays based on program needs.

  • Ability to maintain a private, professional workspace appropriate for providing confidential telehealth services.

  • Ability to maintain reliable internet connectivity necessary to provide consistent, high-quality virtual care.

  • Must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States

  • Ability to meet applicable state licensing, credentialing, payer enrollment requirements, and interstate practice requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Current, active New York license and registration in good standing that permits independent clinical practice and diagnosis, such as LCSW, Licensed Psychologist, LMHC, or LMFT. LMHCs and LMFTs must hold New York’s diagnostic privilege. License must have no current restrictions or pending disciplinary action.

  • Doctoral degree (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) in Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a related psychology discipline.

  • Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health treatment to children, adolescents, young adults, and families.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and developmentally appropriate care that recognizes and respects members' identities, lived experiences, family structures, and backgrounds.

  • Experience utilizing evidence-based interventions such as CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, EMDR, and other clinically appropriate treatment approaches.

  • Experience engaging caregivers as collaborative partners in treatment while promoting developmentally appropriate member autonomy.

  • Experience working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary care team.

  • Strong clinical judgment with excellent communication, organization, and documentation skills.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable utilizing telehealth platforms, electronic health records, and other digital tools to deliver high-quality virtual care.

  • Warm, engaging, and collaborative clinical style with the ability to build therapeutic rapport across developmental stages.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a talented Network Engineer to join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, implementing, managing, and maintaining the organization's networking infrastructure. This individual is detail-oriented, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and possesses a proven track record in learning, implementing, and maintaining enterprise networks and new technologies. Must be a commutable distance to Manchester DC, should the need arise.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

  • Network: Designing, planning, and implementing network infrastructure move, add, or changes. Including maintenance and support.
  • Network Security: Implementing and maintaining network security protocols, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), VPNs, access control lists (ACLs), and encryption technologies to safeguard the organization's data and systems.
  • Network Troubleshooting and Optimization: Diagnosing and resolving complex network issues, analyzing network performance, and optimizing network infrastructure to ensure high availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Creating and maintaining network documentation, diagrams, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Generating reports on network performance, security incidents, and compliance status for management review.
  • Capacity Planning: Assessing current and future network capacity requirements based on business growth projections and technology trends. Planning and implementing scalability solutions to accommodate increasing demand.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring network infrastructure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., PCI DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, Webtrust). Conducting audits and implementing remediation measures as needed.
  • Mounting and Installation: Ability to mount and install network devices such as routers, switches, and servers in data centers and office locations. This includes rack mounting, cable management, and hardware configuration. Candidates must be able to lift network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Travel & Operational Requirements:
    • Participate in on-call rotation.
    • Travel both internationally and nationally as needed (site support meetings, projects, etc.).
    • Frequent visits to Datacenter near Manchester.
  • Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

More information about this role:

  • This is a full-time and remote position based in U.K., with the ideal candidate reside within 1-hour driving distance to the greater Manchester area.
  • The targeted compensation package for this role is between GBP 55,000 and 62,000 per annum, subject upon internal equity and years of experience. We may make further adjustments through an approval process if the targeted compensation range needs to be modified based on business needs and market trends.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or related field is strongly preferred. Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CCIE, CISSP) are a plus.

Experience:

  • Proven experience (typically 5+ years) in network engineering roles, with a focus on supporting, implementing, and managing enterprise-scale network infrastructures.
  • Automation and Infrastructure as Code (IAC):
    • Ability to create, implement, and maintain automation using Terraform and Ansible.
    • Proficiency with GIT.
    • Comfortable with JSON, YAML, and XML.
    • Knowledge of Python is a plus.
  • Cloud Environments:
    • AWS network experience is necessary (TGWs, Network ACLs, AWS Network Firewall, Security Groups, VPCs, Subnet,etc..), and general experience is required.
  • Must be proficient in installing, implementing, supporting, and maintaining Juniper, Palo Alto, and Arista hardware and software for Datacenter and Campus environments.
  • Knowledge of SD-WAN technologies such as Palo Alto, Aruba/Silverpeak, or Cisco/Viptela is a plus.
  • Site to Site VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support Route based and Policy based VPN. Knowledge of specific technologies such as DMVPN, FlexVPN, and other vendor-specific VPNs is a plus.
  • RA VPN: Must be able to design, implement, and support enterprise VPNs such as Global Protect or AnyConnect.
  • VXLAN: Understanding of overlay vs underlay and how it interacts with EVPN
  • AAA: Must be able to support, implement, and maintain Radius and Tacacs+ for both device access management and NAC (e.g., 802.1x). SAML-based authentication is a plus.
  • Network Monitoring: Must be able to implement, support, and use: Netflow, SNMP, and related enterprise tools (e.g., Solarwinds, Nagios, LiveNX).
  • FW Technologies and Traffic Flow: Must understand stateful vs non-stateful rules, symmetric vs non-symmetric, NAT types, order of operation, etc.
  • L3 Routing Protocols: Must have knowledge of OSPFv2, OSPFv3 and BGP. Knowledge of others such as ISIS and mBGP is a plus.
  • L3: Must know IPv6. IPv4 and IPv6 dual stack is a plus.
  • Layer 2: Must understand rSTP, dot1q, vlan, L2 security
  • Wireless: Good understanding wireless, roaming, troubleshooting
  • HA: Must understand FHRP (VRRP, HSRP, etc.), LACP, BFD, switch stacks.etc.
  • TCP/IP: Must understand path MTU discovery (ICMP), basic TCP flags, etc.
  • DNS, DHCP, ARP, Neighbor Discovery: Must have a good understanding.
  • Segment Packet Frame troubleshooting: Must be comfortable packet captures and utilizing tools like Wireshark and tcpdump.

Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:

  • In-depth knowledge of networking protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, etc.
  • Strong understanding of network security principles and best practices, including firewall configuration, intrusion detection/prevention, encryption, and secure remote access.
  • Proficiency in network hardware and software, such as Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, Aruba, etc. Experience with SDN, SD-WAN, and cloud networking is desirable.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, and mentor junior staff.
  • Attention to detail, organization, and documentation skills, with a commitment to maintaining accurate network documentation and following standard procedures.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies, methodologies, and tools to keep pace with evolving business needs and industry trends.

Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

Sectigo is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Simplicity at Scale.

How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. jobs.title: Media Performance Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Data Wrangling & Analysis• Collect, clean, organize, and reconcile data from multiple sources, including media platforms, client performance reports, analytics tools, and third-party data providers.
jobs.description:
Data Wrangling & Analysis

  • Collect, clean, organize, and reconcile data from multiple sources, including media platforms, client performance reports, analytics tools, and third-party data providers.

  • Work with complex datasets to establish consistent definitions, classifications, geographic mappings, and reporting structures, in collaboration with Strategy/Planning, Activation, and the Client.

  • Analyze media investment and performance across channels, campaigns, markets, audiences, and time periods.

  • Connect media performance data with available business outcomes, including leads, appointments, conversions, sales, and revenue.

  • Collaborate with media planning, investment, and measurement teams to address business questions and support performance assessments and optimization decisions.

  • Leverage AI and other analytical tools to accelerate data wrangling and analysis, applying appropriate judgment to validate findings, ensure accuracy, and protect data privacy.

  • Develop repeatable analytical processes that improve efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.

Performance Insights & Recommendations

  • Identify meaningful trends, performance drivers, anomalies, and opportunities within media and business data.

  • Investigate changes in performance to understand potential contributing factors, distinguishing between correlation and demonstrated causation.

  • Evaluate differences in performance across markets, channels, and campaigns to help inform media investment and optimization decisions.

  • Translate analytical findings into clear insights, business implications, and recommended actions.

  • Partner with Strategy and Activation teams to identify opportunities to improve investment effectiveness and overall business performance.

  • Proactively surface questions and areas for further investigation rather than relying solely on predefined reporting requirements.

Reporting, Visualization & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain analytical reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Excel.

  • Help establish consistent performance metrics and reporting methodologies across clients and campaigns.

  • Work with internal teams to improve data accessibility, reporting efficiency, and the usability of performance dashboards.

  • Create clear, concise presentations of analytical findings for internal teams and client stakeholders.

  • Support automation of recurring data preparation, analysis, and reporting processes.

  • Help develop automated workflows within dashboards to streamline the review, approval, and implementation of media optimization recommendations and investment shifts.

Required

We value demonstrable capabilities over specific years of experience. While 4–6 years of relevant experience is ideal, candidates with less experience who demonstrate strong technical expertise, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills will also be considered.

  • Strong technical proficiency, analytical capabilities, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex, incomplete, or inconsistent datasets to produce reliable analyses and actionable insights.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, Power Query, and data manipulation. Experience with macros and VBA (Visual Basic for Applications) is a plus.

  • Strong data wrangling skills, including cleaning, transforming, combining, and analyzing large datasets using SQL or comparable tools. Python proficiency is a plus.

  • Proficiency in developing dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable platforms, including experience with data integration, workflow automation, and streamlining reporting and approval processes.

  • Ability to interpret analytical findings, identify business implications, and communicate recommendations clearly to nontechnical audiences.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical curiosity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Familiarity with media or marketing performance metrics and their relationship to business outcomes is valuable, including experience with paid media platforms such as Google Ads and Meta.

  • Experience at a media agency, marketing agency, or in a performance-focused marketing organization is an advantage, as is exposure to Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution, incrementality testing, or other marketing measurement approaches.

  • Experience working with geographic and market-level data, including Designated Market Area (DMA) analysis, is a plus.

  • Experience using AI-assisted analytical tools and workflows for data preparation, wrangling, automation, and analysis, with appropriate attention to accuracy, validation, and data privacy.

What Success Looks Like

  • Media and client performance data can be analyzed more efficiently and consistently, even when sourced from disparate or imperfect reporting systems.

  • Planning and investment teams have greater visibility into the factors influencing performance across channels, markets, and campaigns.

  • Analytical findings go beyond reporting what happened to help explain potential performance drivers, implications for paid media strategy, and opportunities for optimizations to improve business outcomes.

  • Dashboards and recurring analyses provide reliable, accessible information that supports faster and better-informed decisions.

  • The agency develops more scalable analytical capabilities that strengthen its performance-first approach to media planning, investment, and optimization.

The Ideal Candidate

You are as interested in understanding why performance changed as you are in reporting what changed. You enjoy working with data, are resourceful in finding ways to organize and analyze it, and know how to turn complex findings into insights that others can act on.

You understand that the value of analytics is not simply producing reports or dashboards, but helping teams make better decisions and deliver stronger business outcomes.

The Organizational Change & Transformation Manager plays a meaningful role in enabling successful enterprise transformation by ensuring operating model changes are understood, adopted, and sustained. This role partners closely with Enterprise Transformation Planning & Execution Leads and Transformation Strategy Analysts to translate target-state designs into clear change, communication, and adoption strategies. The role applies structured change methodologies to assess impact, readiness, and resistance, and works with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to drive behavioral and capability shifts required to realize intended business outcomes. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world! As an organization, we are united through trust as one engaged team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. Conduct change impact and readiness assessments across capabilities, roles, processes, and governance to inform adoption strategies. Partner with Enterprise Transformation Planning & Execution Leads to surface change implications, adoption risks, and sequencing considerations embedded in operating model designs. Identify, assess, and proactively manage resistance by developing targeted mitigation, engagement, and reinforcement strategies. Develop actionable change strategies, communication, and training plans aligned to enterprise milestones and workstream priorities. Support senior leaders and workstream sponsors with tailored messaging, talking points, and engagement approaches to reinforce change objectives. Define success metrics for adoption and behavior change; monitor progress and recommend corrective actions as needed. Track change-related risks, issues, and dependencies; raise concerns with clear impact articulation and recommended paths forward.. Exceptional communication skills, including executive-level presentations and concise, decision-ready materials. Ability to influence without authority and align diverse collaborators around shared outcomes. Experience developing change, communication, and training content using tools such as PowerPoint and Excel. MS Project, Azure DevOps and JIRA is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis of adoption challenges and resistance drivers. Comfort operating across strategy, design, and execution phases of transformation work. This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.
Candidates must be willing to work 8am to 5pm PST time zone.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Systems Analyst and NetSuite Administrator to lead our NetSuite ERP platform initiatives and provide strategic support across our finance organization. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can balance competing priorities, communicate effectively across all organizational levels, and drive continuous improvement in our financial systems and processes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to functional leaders, acting as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical resources. Your ability to understand complex business challenges, coordinate project delivery, and translate between technical and non-technical audiences will be critical to success. Additionally, you'll provide support on an as-needed basis, stepping in to triage and troubleshoot issues and mentor team members.

Strategic & Leadership:

  • Provide deep expertise across NetSuite finance modules including: customized envormnet, fixed assets, ARM (Advanced Revenue Management), AR, AP, revenue recognition, general ledger, planning, audit, and reporting

  • Provide ticket and triage support on as-needed basis

  • Provide executive-level summaries for leadership and detailed technical guidance for implementation teams
  • Document processes, decisions, and lessons learned to support organizational knowledge
  • Act as a bridge between business users and technical resources, translating requirements and solutions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in CS or related field required, (or equivalent combination of NetSuite and ERP experience)
  • Minimum 5+ years as a NetSuite Administrator or Business Systems Analyst
  • Critical Requirement: Demonstrated experience working in large organizations (2,000+ employees) where you've successfully managed competing priorities, stakeholder expectations, and complex organizational dynamics
  • Support Experience: Proven background providing Tier 2/Tier 3 support in an organization—demonstrating ability to troubleshoot complex issues, manage escalations, and mentor others
  • Proven track record supporting NetSuite in highly customized environments with complex financial processes
  • Strong understanding of financial processes: billing, payments, AR, AP, revenue recognition, general ledger, planning, audit, and reporting

Technical & Analytical Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
  • Hands-on knowledge of NetSuite modules and features: custom workflows, custom records, role management, integration setup, dashboards, searches/reports, SuiteAnalytics, SuiteFlow
  • Ability to learn and support customized billing, contracts, fixed assets, and customer portal implementations
  • Comfortable working with technical teams and understanding system architecture and data flows
  • Ability to work in a support managing criticality, triaging, and prioritizing incidents and tasks

Soft Skills & Attributes:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to adapt messaging for different audiences
  • Strong organizational and time management skills—ability to juggle multiple priorities and maintain focus
  • Proactive, self-managed, and driven to seek continuous improvement and upskilling
  • Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to challenge the status quo
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and multiple business disciplines
  • Confident in providing support, training, and guidance to end-users at all levels

Preferred Qualifications:

  • NetSuite Administrator Certification or relevant NetSuite certifications
  • Technical development skills (JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL) or exposure to custom development
  • Experience with AI-assisted tools or emerging technologies in ERP environments
  • Background in financial operations, accounting, or finance systems
  • Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional projects

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Core AE, you will be helping our largest and most strategic enterprise sized customers consolidate outdated technologies, digitize workflows, and unlock game-changing data insights that will transform their businesses. We are helping the companies that literally keep our lights on, put food on our tables, and build our communities to become safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. Typical sales will be $100k to $500k, and typically involve POCs, multiple stakeholders, managing trials, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to executives and CXOs.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US in the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia, and West Virginia.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years experience in a full-cycle, closing sales role
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $100k+ ARR transactions
  • Experience handling and owning enterprise deal sizes and C-Level relationships
  • Willing and comfortable with strategic outbound prospecting
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast paced environment
  • Willing and comfortable traveling to meet customers on a monthly basis

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with line of business stakeholders (Operations, Finance, IT)
  • Awards for top achievement (President’s club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passion for the world of operations!

Total Rewards

We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Integração EDI para atuar na sustentação dos processos dos clientes, com foco no monitoramento de incidentes, acompanhamento de melhorias e atendimento de solicitações relacionadas a integrações via EDI.
Essa pessoa será o elo entre as áreas de negócio e os fornecedores responsáveis pelas integrações, atuando de forma analítica, garantindo a fluidez da comunicação, a continuidade operacional e a evolução dos processos.

Idiomas

Alemão – preferencialmente
Inglês - Mandatório

Experiência Profissional

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente AMS,
  • Noções de integração entre sistemas (IDocs, RFCs, APIs, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de chamados (ex.: ServiceNow, Jira, Solution Manager);
  • Experiência com ambiente multi-source, lidando com diferentes fornecedores de serviços.
  • Experiência em monitoramento e suporte a processos de integração, preferencialmente envolvendo EDI ou sistemas correlatos.
  • Vivência em atuação como interface entre clientes, fornecedores e times técnicos de terceiro nível, focando em comunicação clara e acompanhamento das demandas.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de chamados, especialmente ServiceNow.

Atividades

  • Atuar no suporte funcional de segundo nível para as áreas de logística
  • Realizar a triagem, categorização e acompanhamento de tickets de incidentes, requisições e melhorias;
  • Identificar o time ou fornecedor responsável pela resolução dos problemas, acompanhar planos de ação e garantir a resolução dentro do prazo acordado;
  • Apoiar na validação de soluções entregues pelos fornecedores, conduzindo testes funcionais quando necessário;
  • Interagir com sistemas legados e apoiar na análise de integrações entre SAP e demais sistemas;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com áreas internas e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar como ponto de contato entre o cliente e seus fornecedores, acompanhando solicitações relacionadas a processos EDI.
  • Realizar o atendimento, direcionamento e acompanhamento de e-mails relacionados a erros de integração, requisições de suporte e melhorias.
  • Monitorar o ambiente da plataforma interna (sistema Everest) de forma contínua, identificando ocorrências que possam impactar o serviço e acionando os times técnicos de terceiro nível.

Job Description:

The Committee Engagement Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day management and facilitation of Safety and Compliance Committee(s) operations, with a primary focus on maintaining accurate and up-to-date committee rosters, maintaining thorough record-keeping, and coordinating effectively with internal and external stakeholders. This role supports the integrity of committee activities by tracking and managing member appointments, overseeing onboarding processes, maintaining conflict-of-interest (COI) records, and ensuring alignment with OPTN governance and HRSA oversight requirements.


Reporting to the Director of Membership or the designated supervisor, this position maintains the accuracy of committee rosters, tracks member training completion, maintains detailed records to support compliance with governance and oversight standards, and facilitates the availability of resources to support committee functions. The Committee Engagement Specialist must excel in data management, attention to detail, and collaboration with stakeholders to ensure the seamless execution of membership processes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Committee Membership Management

  • Maintain accurate, current, and transparent records of Safety and Compliance Committee(s) membership, including member roles, appointment timelines, affiliations, contact information, and training status.
  • Execute the appointment and onboarding process for new committee members, ensuring timely assignment of roles and subcommittee responsibilities.
  • Track annual orientation and training status for all committee members to ensure compliance with governance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain a Conflict of Interest (COI) tracking log, monitoring and addressing potential conflicts for committee members and participants.
  • Collaborate with HRSA, OPTN contractors, and internal teams to ensure alignment and continuity of committee operations.

2. Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) Implementation

  • Facilitate the execution of the Appointment and Roster Draft Plan by adhering to SOPs for:
    • Monitoring and updating committee membership rosters.
    • Coordinating with contractors and stakeholders to support committee operations.
    • Submitting updated rosters and related documentation within specified timeframes.
    • Maintaining detailed records of processes, authority boundaries, and roles in committee-related activities.
  • Support updates to SOPs based on internal feedback or COR requests, ensuring alignment with organizational and governance standards.

3. Subject Matter Expertise Coordination

  • Facilitate the availability and access to a pool of HRSA-approved Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with specialized knowledge in areas such as patient safety, risk management, healthcare analytics, transplant medicine, and quality assurance.
  • Implement procedures for selecting, maintaining, and rapidly deploying SMEs to support site visits, incident reviews, or other committee functions.
  • Track and document SME involvement, including expertise type, hours used, request sources, and outputs delivered.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to address ad hoc expertise requests, ensuring timely and accurate responses.

4. Data Management and Reporting

  • Provide ongoing access to committee records, data, trackers, dashboards, and SOP documentation to the COR and relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparent and accurate reporting of committee membership activities, including rosters, training status updates, and COI logs.
  • Submit reports and deliverables in formats and timeframes required by the Appointment and Roster Draft Plan and Subject Matter Expertise Draft Plan.

5. Committee Coordination and Support

  • Collaborate with other entities supporting the OPTN to enable the execution of committee-related processes.
  • Track changes to committee membership and notify the COR of updates within one business day.
  • Provide administrative and logistical support for committee meetings, member communications, and related activities.
  • Facilitate alignment with the approved OPTN Patient Safety and Compliance Operations Plan, ensuring all contractor support procedures are implemented effectively.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare management, public policy, or a related field.

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of experience in roles involving policy compliance, operational coordination, healthcare processes, or committee/board management.
  • Experience with maintaining accurate records, managing workflows, and coordinating among multiple stakeholders.

Skills and Knowledge:

  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage complex workflows and meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of healthcare operations, compliance standards, or governance processes preferred.
  • Proficiency in office productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite) and data tracking systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for preparing reports, facilitating stakeholder interaction, and supporting governance activities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams, including contractors, government stakeholders, and committee members.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers, and Earn the Respect of Others.

​

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. jobs.description:
Social Media Engagement Strategist

Givelify is a fintech-for-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we’ve helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7.5 billion. Together, they’re changing their world with kindness and generosity.

Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters.

Make an impact at one of the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits.

About your role:

We’re looking for a Social Media Engagement Strategist to grow Givelify’s organic social presence through audience-first content and authentic community engagement. You’ll own our social content from idea to publish, uncover stories worth telling, and build relationships that strengthen our community.

Your team:

The Social Media team at Givelify is collaborative and results-driven, working closely with the content, marketing, and creative teams to develop and execute social media strategies that drive impact. You will report to the Social Media Manager.

The Social Media Engagement Strategist will get to:

KPI 1: Reach

  • Own the social content process from ideation through publishing, ensuring every piece supports business goals and audience needs.
  • Develop audience-first content strategies and creative briefs informed by insights, platform best practices, and campaign goals.
  • Partner with internal teams and external organizations and community advocates, to uncover and craft stories worth telling.

KPI 2: Engagement Rate

  • Create audience-first content that sparks conversation, encourages sharing, and builds community.
  • Blend compelling content with authentic engagement across comments, direct messages, and owned communities.
  • Use social listening, audience research, and community engagement to understand what people care about and why.

KPI 3: New Followers

  • Create content and engagement strategies that turn new audiences into loyal followers.
  • Identify opportunities to engage with creators, organizations, and communities aligned with Givelify’s mission.
  • Measure audience growth, test new ideas, and continuously improve follower acquisition.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

  • Plan and execute monthly and quarterly campaigns aligned with business goals and audience insights.
  • Use AI to accelerate research, planning, and execution.
  • Own opportunities to delight organizations and donors through original, engagement-boosting comments (you know how to use AI prompts to generate comments for efficiency, but you genuinely enjoy interacting with our audiences through social comments).
  • Monitor and share digital and industry trends and best practices.
  • Summarize key themes and shifts in sentiment to inform future content direction and engagement strategies.
  • Report on effectiveness, key performance indicators and value delivered per campaign/projects. Surface actionable insights to refine content strategy and drive stronger outcomes.
  • Navigate high-visibility conversations with empathy, sound judgment, and professionalism, including responding to negative feedback and public conflict.
  • Build and manage community spaces, like Facebook Groups, where our target audience can connect. This includes sharing helpful content, starting conversations, and creating a space where donors and organizations engage with us and with one another.

Your experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field (preferred)  
  • 3–5 years creating high-performing social media content and managing online communities.
  • A portfolio highlighting some of your best work (please include password)
  • Proficiency with Sprout Social, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube  
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to craft engaging and authentic social media comments  and content captions
  • Experience with social media analytics and reporting tools  
  • Experience in project management software like Asana, Notion, Airtable, JIRAetc  
  • Experience in sales (preferred) 

Your superpowers:

  • Audience-First Storyteller: You know attention is earned. You create content people want to stop for, not scroll past. You advocate for the audience, challenge weak ideas, and use insights, creativity, and data to create content worth their time.
  • Skilled Connector: You intuitively read the room, adapting your voice and message to meet people where they are. You understand how to communicate across cultures and beliefs with emotional intelligence, curiosity, and empathy.
  • Test-and-Learn Trailblazer: social media is your playground, and every interaction is an experiment. You’re constantly testing new approaches, measuring outcomes, and iterating for improvement  
  • Extreme Ownership Mindset: You treat Givelify’s social channels like they’re your own. You don’t wait to be told what needs fixing or settle for “good enough.” You proactively uncover opportunities, solve problems, and continuously improve our content, community, and results.

Our culture:

We are a virtual team of award-winning and high-performing professionals who innovate and collaborate to fulfill our mission to instantly connect people to causes that matter most to them so they can change their world with kindness and generosity. Our four keys to success - integrity, heart, simplicity, and wow - fuel our passion to be recognized among the tech industry’s most inclusive and purpose-driven workplaces.

We are steadfast in our conviction to overcome challenges while performing meaningful work alongside some of the most brilliant minds and biggest hearts. It propels our growth as individuals and as a team. We are committed to respecting each other in our workplace, firmly believing diversity is our strength.

At the heart of everything we do are our giving community, our donors and our partner organizations. We lean on research and human-centered design to consistently push the envelope and innovate our products and customer experiences.

We take great pride in providing competitive pay, full benefits to help care for you today and in the future, amazing perks (including flexible PTO), and, most importantly, the opportunity to put passion and purpose front and center.

About Givelify

Givelify is the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving platform. Along with its powerful donation management system, it’s the fastest-growing technology for advancing generosity in the world. We instantly connect people to their heart’s impulse to do good with award-winning products and experiences. A global community of over 2 million generous people supports their favorite churches, places of worship, nonprofits, and causes with over $7.5 billion in donations across more than 80,000 organizations. Givelify leads all giving apps on the App Store and Google Play Store with more than 135,000 verified, authentic reviews with an average 4.9 out of 5-star rating. Learn more at Givelify.com.

About Qblox

At Qblox, we operate at the frontier of the quantum revolution, delivering the advanced control stack technology needed to build scalable quantum computers. Since 2019, we have grown into a dynamic international company of 170+ scientists, engineers and commercial professionals dedicated to accelerating quantum innovation worldwide.

With headquarters in Delft and a growing global presence including the United States, Qblox combines deep technical expertise with ambitious commercial growth.

We believe innovation thrives through diversity, collaboration and curiosity, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where exceptional people can do their best work.

What will you do?

At Qblox, we’re accelerating the worldwide race to build scalable quantum computers by delivering the world’s leading quantum control stack. We’re not just building hardware - we’re enabling the next generation of quantum technology.

We’re now looking for a highly commercial, hunter-oriented Account Executive / Strategic Account Manager to expand our presence across Germany and the wider DACH region. This is a strategic growth role focused on developing new business opportunities across both public and private sector organisations within the research, advanced computing and wider deep-tech ecosystem, including customers operating in and around High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. We are looking for a commercially driven sales professional with experience selling complex technology solutions into enterprise, research and technical organisations.

What you’ll do

  • Identify, develop and close new opportunities across research institutions, universities, national labs, HPC centres, advanced computing environments and enterprise organisations.

  • Develop long-term relationships with key stakeholders including directors, research leads, IT infrastructure teams, enterprise architects and C-level decision makers.

  • Lead the full sales process from prospecting and pipeline generation through to negotiation, deal closure and account growth.

  • Represent Qblox across the German and European HPC and quantum ecosystem through conferences, customer engagements, industry events and strategic partnerships.

  • Understand customer challenges and position Qblox’s quantum control stack and infrastructure solutions within complex technical and research environments.

  • Work closely with application scientists, product management, marketing and leadership teams to align customer requirements with Qblox’s product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Develop strategic account plans and consistently exceed ambitious growth and revenue targets in a fast-scaling deep-tech environment.

Why you’ll love it

  • Work at the Frontier of Technology: Quantum computing is one of the most exciting and transformative industries in the world today.

  • Build a New Market: Play a key role in scaling one of Europe’s leading quantum technology companies and help shape the future of quantum infrastructure.

  • Engage with World-Leading Organisations: Work directly with some of the world’s most advanced research institutions, HPC centres and technology companies.

  • High Impact, High Growth: Join a fast-growing, international deep-tech company where you can make a visible commercial impact and grow your career globally.

Requirements

ICF seeks an experienced Early Childhood (EC) Manager for the Office of Head Start Training and Technical Assistance Service Area XI contract to co-lead a team of EC Specialists and provide one-on-one management and supervision of EC Specialists employed by ICF. This position is home-based in the U.S. and will involve extensive travel up to 50% of the time to programs across the United States where the candidate is assigned.


Basic Qualifications

  • 1+ year experience in coaching staff.

  • 1+ year experience in using data to inform decision making.
  • 1+ year experience facilitating group discussions and presenting to range of audiences using a variety of formats to include virtual.
