jobs.title: Vice President of Sales
jobs.excerpt: This job posting is available in English and Canadian French.
jobs.description:
This job posting is available in English and Canadian French. Please scroll down for the French version.

Cette offre d’emploi est disponible en anglais et en français (Canada). Veuillez faire défiler pour la version française.

Remote - U.S. & Canada Only | Full-Time

Compensation:

OTE $125,000 - $175,000 USD/CAD (Salary + Commission)

We’re Not Looking for Someone to Manage the Pipeline. We’re Looking for a Closer Who Can Shape It.

Level Agency is hiring a Vice President of Sales to lead complex pursuits, win high-value accounts, and build the sales systems that fuel our next stage of growth.

This is not a role for someone who needs a C-level executive to step in when the deal gets complicated. This is for a proven seller who can earn trust with senior decision-makers, lead a six- or seven-figure opportunity from first conversation through signed agreement, and coordinate the internal team required to win.

You’ll take ownership of Level’s most strategic opportunities, including executive referrals, high-potential prospects, RFPs, and “house accounts” that have traditionally gone directly to senior leadership. You’ll also oversee our inbound and SDR functions and shape our outbound strategy in partnership with the CRO.

You’ll sell sophisticated, customized marketing services to organizations with complex goals, multiple stakeholders, and high expectations. That means understanding the client’s business, asking better questions, assembling the right solution, navigating procurement and internal politics, and creating enough confidence for the buyer to move forward.

Success in this role means Level is consistently winning the right clients, our pipeline is healthy and credible, our sales team is operating with focus, and executives no longer need to quarterback every major opportunity.

This role reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer.

This Isn’t for Everyone.

We’re building something rare: a place where growth, truth, and high performance go hand-in-hand.

You’ll thrive here if:

✅ You have personally closed six- and seven-figure B2B services engagements.

✅ You know how to sell complex, customized solutions—not just software licenses or standardized packages.

✅ You understand how buyers in industries such as B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and other considered-purchase categories make decisions.

✅ You can build credibility with executives, uncover the real business problem, and connect Level’s capabilities to outcomes that matter.

✅ You are comfortable owning the entire sales process, including qualification, discovery, solution development, proposals, negotiation, procurement, and close.

✅ You can lead internal teams through influence, create clarity, and keep a pursuit moving without formal authority over every contributor.

✅ You know how to balance hands-on selling with sales leadership, pipeline strategy, forecasting, coaching, and process improvement.

✅ You use data, technology, and AI to improve how you research accounts, prepare for meetings, develop solutions, and move opportunities forward.

And you’ll struggle here if:

❌ Your largest wins depended on an executive stepping in to lead the strategy, pitch, or negotiation.

❌ Your experience is limited to transactional sales, short sales cycles, or highly standardized products.

❌ You confuse a large pipeline with a strong pipeline.

❌ You avoid difficult qualification decisions or keep weak opportunities alive to protect your forecast.

❌ You rely on charisma without disciplined discovery, preparation, follow-through, and commercial judgment.

❌ You need direct authority to align people and move work forward.

❌ You are more interested in managing sellers than personally winning business.

❌ You treat AI as a novelty rather than a practical tool for improving sales performance.

About Level

We’re an AI-powered performance marketing agency—built for precision, designed to scale, and powered by a scientific mindset. At Level, we blend strategy, media, creative, and machine intelligence to deliver outcomes that matter. Every time. At scale.

We’ve been named one of Pittsburgh’s Best Places to Work and an Inc. 500 Fastest-Growing Company. Our clients span B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, and more.

Your Role (and Impact)

As Vice President of Sales, you’ll own Level’s most strategic and complex revenue opportunities while helping lead the systems, people, and processes behind our broader sales function.

You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for high-stakes pursuits and lead the full sales process from qualification through negotiation and close. You’ll also oversee inbound and outbound functions, manage our Inbound Manager and SDR resources, and partner with the CRO to develop a modern, high-impact outbound strategy.

You’ll:

  • Own Strategic Sales Execution: Lead the end-to-end sales process for high-value, high-complexity opportunities, including executive referrals, strategic prospects, RFPs, and high-potential accounts.
  • Close Six- and Seven-Figure Services Engagements: Independently navigate complex buyer journeys, build consensus among multiple stakeholders, and close significant marketing services partnerships without relying on executive intervention.
  • Lead Discovery and Qualification: Identify the business problem behind the request, assess fit, clarify decision criteria, understand the stakeholder landscape, and determine whether an opportunity deserves Level’s time and resources.
  • Sell Level’s Service Lines: Connect client challenges to tailored solutions across performance media, creative, strategy, analytics, AI-enabled marketing, and related capabilities.
  • Lead Solution Engineering: Partner with strategists, channel experts, creative leaders, analysts, and executives to develop solutions that are differentiated, commercially sound, and grounded in the client’s business goals.
  • Own RFP and Proposal Development: Lead the strategy, positioning, coordination, writing, review, and delivery of RFP responses and proposals across your accounts.
  • Navigate Complex Deals: Manage long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, procurement requirements, budget constraints, legal reviews, competitive pressure, and shifting internal priorities.
  • Lead Negotiation and Closing: Protect value, maintain momentum, resolve objections, and negotiate agreements that support successful, sustainable client relationships.
  • Quarterback Internal Pursuit Teams: Establish roles, timelines, decision points, and next steps across cross-functional teams. Keep contributors aligned and hold the process together without depending on formal authority.
  • Build Referral Relationships: Develop and strengthen relationships with referral partners, industry contacts, executives, current clients, and other sources of high-value opportunities.
  • Lead Outbound Strategy: Develop, implement, and optimize outbound programs across email, calls, LinkedIn, events, account-based outreach, partnerships, and emerging channels.
  • Oversee Inbound and SDR Functions: Provide direction, coaching, prioritization, and accountability across inbound and sales development activities.
  • Improve Sales Infrastructure: Ensure Level has the right processes, messaging, tools, technology, data, and talent to support a high-performing sales function.
  • Own Pipeline Health and Forecasting: Maintain accurate opportunity data, inspect deal quality, identify risk, create realistic forecasts, and provide senior leadership with clear visibility into expected revenue.
  • Partner with the CRO: Work closely with Level’s Chief Revenue Officer to shape sales strategy, refine market focus, improve sales execution, and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Contribute Beyond the Core: Depending on business needs, you may support industry events, strategic partnerships, sales hiring, compensation planning, enablement, team development, or other revenue initiatives.

Travel is required and may include client meetings, company events, pitches, conferences, and industry events. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on deal activity and business needs.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 10+ years of complex B2B sales experience. You have built a career selling sophisticated solutions to organizations with multiple stakeholders and meaningful commercial risk.
  • At least 5 years in enterprise or strategic sales. You understand long-cycle, high-value opportunities and know how to maintain momentum across extended buying processes.
  • Proven six- and seven-figure closing experience. You can point to specific services engagements you personally sourced, shaped, negotiated, and closed.
  • Relevant services sales experience. You have sold digital marketing, advertising, consulting, professional services, technology-enabled services, agency services, or similarly complex solutions.
  • Experience selling to Level-like clients. You understand considered buyers in markets such as B2B, education, healthcare, financial services, ecommerce, or other industries where trust, expertise, measurable outcomes, and stakeholder alignment matter.
  • Full-cycle sales ownership. You have managed deals from prospecting or referral through qualification, discovery, proposal, negotiation, procurement, and close.
  • Strong discovery skills. You know how to move beyond surface-level requests, uncover business needs, evaluate urgency, identify decision dynamics, and shape the buying process.
  • Executive presence. You can lead high-stakes conversations with senior executives, challenge assumptions appropriately, and build trust without overpromising.
  • Customized solution selling experience. You know how to assemble tailored offerings with subject matter experts rather than relying on a fixed product or standard package.
  • RFP and proposal leadership. You have led complex proposals and RFP responses that required positioning, coordination, customization, and strong written communication.
  • Commercial and negotiation judgment. You can protect value, manage scope, work through objections, and negotiate agreements with confidence and professionalism.
  • Leadership through influence. You can align cross-functional teams, create accountability, resolve friction, and drive decisions without relying solely on reporting lines.
  • Sales leadership experience. You have experience coaching, directing, or managing inbound, outbound, SDR, business development, or sales team members.
  • Pipeline and forecasting discipline. You use data and deal evidence—not optimism—to evaluate pipeline quality and forecast revenue.
  • CRM fluency. You have strong working experience with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and consistently maintain accurate, useful sales data.
  • Sandler knowledge. You have a working understanding of the Sandler Sales framework and can apply disciplined qualification and mutual decision-making principles.
  • Bachelor’s degree. You hold a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Strong Preferences

  • Digital marketing agency experience. You have sold services such as paid media, creative, analytics, strategy, lifecycle marketing, SEO, performance marketing, or integrated digital programs.
  • Professional services experience. You understand how to sell expertise, people, process, and outcomes rather than a tangible product.
  • Experience with complex client types. You have sold into regulated industries, matrixed organizations, founder-led companies, private equity-backed businesses, or other environments with complex decision structures.
  • Existing referral network. You have trusted relationships with executives, investors, consultants, technology partners, or other sources of strategic opportunities.
  • Outbound program experience. You have built or materially improved outbound systems, messaging, segmentation, team structure, technology, or performance.
  • Account-based sales experience. You know how to coordinate personalized outreach and pursuit strategies across a defined set of high-value accounts.
  • Experience hiring and developing sales talent. You have recruited, coached, evaluated, and made performance decisions involving sales or business development staff.
  • Marketing fluency. You can credibly discuss performance media, creative strategy, measurement, customer acquisition, pipeline generation, conversion, and business growth with both clients and internal specialists.

AI Expectations

At Level, AI is a skillset—not a shortcut. In this role, AI fluency is not optional. You’ll be expected to use AI to improve the quality, speed, rigor, and leverage of how you sell.

You’ll be expected to:

  • Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Midjourney, and other AI platforms to improve account research, prospecting, discovery preparation, proposal development, competitive analysis, meeting follow-up, and sales planning.
  • Build and document AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency and effectiveness across inbound, outbound, qualification, proposal development, and pipeline management.
  • Use AI to synthesize industry information, company context, stakeholder priorities, call notes, account history, and opportunity risks.
  • Experiment with AI-supported messaging, personalization, objection preparation, proposal structures, and pursuit strategies while maintaining strong human judgment.
  • Create and share prompt libraries, sales workflows, use cases, and lessons that other team members can adopt and improve.
  • Evaluate AI outputs critically and verify claims, insights, and recommendations before using them in client-facing work.
  • Approach AI with an iterative mindset. The first prompt, message, or workflow is rarely the best one.
  • AI is not a replacement for commercial judgment, preparation, relationship-building, or thoughtful selling. It is infrastructure that should make each of those capabilities stronger.

Our Core Values

No Ego, All In

We don’t do “that’s not my job.” We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.

Better Every Day

We want the feedback—even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.

Relentless for Results

Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.

Driven by Truth

We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear—not just what is easy to say.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Travel is required and may include client meetings, company events, pitches, conferences, and industry events. Occasional evening or weekend availability may be required based on active deal cycles.

We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We are committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. Level is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer—we celebrate what makes you, you.

Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

Click below to submit your resume. You’ll also answer a few thoughtful questions, so take your time.

We are looking for evidence—not sales theater. Tell us what you sold, who you sold it to, how you shaped the opportunity, and what you personally did to get the deal across the line.

We care more about your ability to build trust, navigate complexity, and close the right business than whether your career path has been perfectly linear.

Let’s build something together.

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level’s hiring team.

Vice-président·e, Ventes

Télétravail - États-Unis et Canada seulement | Temps plein

Rémunération :

Rémunération cible totale de 125 000 $ à 175 000 $ US (salaire + commissions)

Nous ne cherchons pas une personne pour gérer le pipeline. Nous cherchons une personne capable de le façonner et de conclure.

Level Agency est à la recherche d’un·e vice-président·e, Ventes pour diriger des démarches commerciales complexes, gagner des comptes à forte valeur et bâtir les systèmes de vente qui alimenteront notre prochaine phase de croissance.

Ce poste ne s’adresse pas à une personne qui a besoin qu’un membre de la haute direction intervienne lorsque l’entente devient complexe. Nous cherchons une personne ayant fait ses preuves, capable de gagner la confiance de décideurs et décideuses de haut niveau, de mener une occasion à six ou sept chiffres de la première conversation jusqu’à la signature et de coordonner l’équipe interne nécessaire pour gagner.

Vous prendrez en charge les occasions les plus stratégiques de Level, notamment les recommandations provenant de la direction, les prospects à fort potentiel, les appels d’offres et les « comptes maison » qui étaient traditionnellement gérés directement par les membres de la haute direction. Vous superviserez également nos fonctions de ventes entrantes et de développement des ventes et contribuerez à définir notre stratégie de prospection en collaboration avec le chef de la direction des revenus.

Vous vendrez des services marketing sophistiqués et personnalisés à des organisations ayant des objectifs complexes, plusieurs parties prenantes et des attentes élevées. Vous devrez donc comprendre les activités du client, poser de meilleures questions, assembler la bonne solution, naviguer dans les processus d’approvisionnement et les dynamiques internes, puis créer suffisamment de confiance pour permettre à l’acheteur d’aller de l’avant.

La réussite dans ce rôle signifie que Level gagne constamment les bons clients, que notre pipeline est sain et crédible, que notre équipe de vente travaille avec rigueur et que les membres de la direction n’ont plus à diriger chaque occasion importante.

Ce poste relève directement du chef de la direction des revenus.

Ce rôle ne convient pas à tout le monde.

Nous bâtissons quelque chose de rare : un milieu où la croissance, la vérité et la haute performance vont de pair.

Vous vous épanouirez ici si :

✅ Vous avez personnellement conclu des mandats de services B2B à six et sept chiffres.

✅ Vous savez vendre des solutions complexes et personnalisées, et non seulement des licences logicielles ou des forfaits standardisés.

✅ Vous comprenez comment les acheteurs de secteurs comme le B2B, l’éducation, la santé, les services financiers, le commerce électronique et d’autres catégories à processus d’achat réfléchi prennent leurs décisions.

✅ Vous pouvez établir votre crédibilité auprès de cadres, découvrir le véritable problème d’affaires et relier les capacités de Level aux résultats qui comptent.

✅ Vous êtes à l’aise de prendre en charge l’ensemble du processus de vente, notamment la qualification, la découverte, la conception de solutions, les propositions, la négociation, l’approvisionnement et la conclusion.

✅ Vous pouvez diriger des équipes internes par influence, créer de la clarté et maintenir l’élan d’une démarche sans détenir d’autorité formelle sur chaque personne contributrice.

✅ Vous savez combiner la vente active avec le leadership commercial, la stratégie de pipeline, les prévisions, l’accompagnement et l’amélioration des processus.

✅ Vous utilisez les données, la technologie et l’IA pour améliorer vos recherches sur les comptes, votre préparation aux rencontres, la conception de solutions et la progression des occasions.

Et vous aurez de la difficulté ici si :

❌ Vos plus grandes réussites dépendaient d’un membre de la direction pour mener la stratégie, la présentation ou la négociation.

❌ Votre expérience se limite aux ventes transactionnelles, aux cycles de vente courts ou aux produits hautement standardisés.

❌ Vous confondez un pipeline volumineux avec un pipeline solide.

❌ Vous évitez les décisions de qualification difficiles ou maintenez des occasions faibles pour protéger vos prévisions.

❌ Vous comptez sur votre charisme sans faire preuve de rigueur dans la découverte, la préparation, le suivi et le jugement commercial.

❌ Vous avez besoin d’une autorité directe pour aligner les personnes et faire avancer le travail.

❌ Vous vous intéressez davantage à la gestion de vendeurs qu’à la conquête personnelle de nouveaux mandats.

❌ Vous considérez l’IA comme une nouveauté plutôt que comme un outil pratique pour améliorer la performance commerciale.

À propos de Level

Nous sommes une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour la précision et la croissance, et guidée par une approche scientifique. Chez Level, nous combinons la stratégie, les médias, la création et l’intelligence machine afin de produire des résultats qui comptent. Chaque fois. À grande échelle.

Nous avons été nommés parmi les meilleurs milieux de travail de Pittsburgh et parmi les entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide du classement Inc. 500. Nos clients œuvrent notamment dans les secteurs B2B, de l’éducation, de la santé, des services financiers et du commerce électronique.

Votre rôle et votre impact

À titre de vice-président·e, Ventes, vous prendrez en charge les occasions de revenus les plus stratégiques et complexes de Level tout en contribuant à diriger les systèmes, les personnes et les processus qui soutiennent l’ensemble de notre fonction commerciale.

Vous serez le principal point de contact pour les démarches à fort enjeu et dirigerez l’ensemble du processus de vente, de la qualification jusqu’à la négociation et à la conclusion. Vous superviserez également les fonctions de ventes entrantes et sortantes, gérerez la personne responsable des ventes entrantes et les ressources de développement des ventes, puis collaborerez avec le chef de la direction des revenus afin d’élaborer une stratégie de prospection moderne et à fort impact.

Vous devrez :

  • Prendre en charge l’exécution des ventes stratégiques : Diriger l’ensemble du processus de vente pour des occasions à forte valeur et grande complexité, notamment les recommandations de cadres, les prospects stratégiques, les appels d’offres et les comptes à fort potentiel.
  • Conclure des mandats de services à six et sept chiffres : Naviguer de façon autonome dans des parcours d’achat complexes, créer un consensus entre plusieurs parties prenantes et conclure d’importants partenariats de services marketing sans dépendre de l’intervention de la direction.
  • Diriger la découverte et la qualification : Déterminer le problème d’affaires derrière la demande, évaluer l’adéquation, clarifier les critères de décision, comprendre l’écosystème des parties prenantes et déterminer si une occasion mérite le temps et les ressources de Level.
  • Vendre les lignes de services de Level : Relier les défis des clients à des solutions personnalisées en médias de performance, création, stratégie, analytique, marketing propulsé par l’IA et autres capacités connexes.
  • Diriger la conception de solutions : Collaborer avec les stratèges, spécialistes de canaux, responsables de la création, analystes et membres de la direction afin d’élaborer des solutions différenciées, commercialement solides et ancrées dans les objectifs d’affaires du client.
  • Prendre en charge les appels d’offres et les propositions : Diriger la stratégie, le positionnement, la coordination, la rédaction, la révision et la présentation des réponses aux appels d’offres et des propositions liées à vos comptes.
  • Naviguer dans des ententes complexes : Gérer de longs cycles de vente, plusieurs décideurs et décideuses, les exigences d’approvisionnement, les contraintes budgétaires, les examens juridiques, la pression concurrentielle et les priorités internes changeantes.
  • Diriger la négociation et la conclusion : Protéger la valeur, maintenir l’élan, répondre aux objections et négocier des ententes qui soutiennent des relations clients durables et fructueuses.
  • Diriger les équipes internes responsables des démarches : Établir les rôles, les échéanciers, les points de décision et les prochaines étapes pour les équipes multidisciplinaires. Maintenir l’alignement des personnes contributrices et assurer la cohérence du processus sans dépendre d’une autorité formelle.
  • Développer les relations de recommandation : Établir et renforcer les relations avec les partenaires de recommandation, les contacts de l’industrie, les cadres, les clients actuels et les autres sources d’occasions stratégiques.
  • Diriger la stratégie de ventes sortantes : Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des programmes de prospection par courriel, téléphone, LinkedIn, événements, comptes ciblés, partenariats et nouveaux canaux.
  • Superviser les fonctions de ventes entrantes et de développement des ventes : Fournir de l’orientation, de l’accompagnement, des priorités et de la responsabilisation pour les activités de ventes entrantes et de développement des ventes.
  • Améliorer l’infrastructure commerciale : Veiller à ce que Level dispose des bons processus, messages, outils, technologies, données et talents pour soutenir une fonction de vente performante.
  • Prendre en charge la santé du pipeline et les prévisions : Maintenir des données exactes, évaluer la qualité des occasions, repérer les risques, produire des prévisions réalistes et donner à la haute direction une visibilité claire sur les revenus attendus.
  • Collaborer avec le chef de la direction des revenus : Travailler étroitement avec le chef de la direction des revenus de Level pour façonner la stratégie de vente, préciser les marchés prioritaires, améliorer l’exécution et repérer de nouvelles occasions de croissance.
  • Contribuer au-delà des responsabilités principales : Selon les besoins de l’entreprise, soutenir des événements de l’industrie, des partenariats stratégiques, l’embauche en vente, la planification de la rémunération, l’aide à la vente, le développement de l’équipe ou d’autres initiatives de revenus.

Des déplacements sont requis et peuvent comprendre des rencontres avec des clients, des événements d’entreprise, des présentations, des conférences et des événements de l’industrie. Du travail occasionnel en soirée ou la fin de semaine peut être requis selon l’activité commerciale et les besoins de l’entreprise.

Exigences

Exigences essentielles

  • Au moins 10 ans d’expérience en ventes B2B complexes. Vous avez bâti votre carrière en vendant des solutions sophistiquées à des organisations comptant plusieurs parties prenantes et comportant des enjeux commerciaux importants.
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en ventes stratégiques ou auprès de grandes entreprises. Vous comprenez les occasions à forte valeur et à cycle long et savez maintenir l’élan au fil de processus d’achat prolongés.
  • Une expérience démontrée de conclusion d’ententes à six et sept chiffres. Vous pouvez fournir des exemples précis de mandats de services que vous avez personnellement trouvés, façonnés, négociés et conclus.
  • Une expérience pertinente en vente de services. Vous avez vendu des services de marketing numérique, de publicité, de consultation, des services professionnels, des services technologiques, des services d’agence ou d’autres solutions de complexité comparable.
  • Une expérience auprès de clients semblables à ceux de Level. Vous comprenez les acheteurs à processus réfléchi dans des secteurs comme le B2B, l’éducation, la santé, les services financiers, le commerce électronique ou d’autres industries où la confiance, l’expertise, les résultats mesurables et l’alignement des parties prenantes sont essentiels.
  • Une prise en charge complète du cycle de vente. Vous avez géré des ententes de la prospection ou de la recommandation jusqu’à la qualification, la découverte, la proposition, la négociation, l’approvisionnement et la conclusion.
  • De solides compétences en découverte. Vous savez aller au-delà des demandes de surface, découvrir les besoins d’affaires, évaluer l’urgence, comprendre les dynamiques décisionnelles et façonner le processus d’achat.
  • Une présence auprès des cadres. Vous pouvez diriger des conversations à fort enjeu avec des membres de la haute direction, remettre les hypothèses en question de façon appropriée et établir la confiance sans faire de promesses excessives.
  • Une expérience en vente de solutions personnalisées. Vous savez assembler des offres adaptées avec des spécialistes plutôt que de dépendre d’un produit fixe ou d’un forfait standard.
  • Une expérience en direction d’appels d’offres et de propositions. Vous avez dirigé des propositions et des réponses complexes nécessitant du positionnement, de la coordination, de la personnalisation et de fortes aptitudes rédactionnelles.
  • Un bon jugement commercial et de négociation. Vous pouvez protéger la valeur, gérer la portée, répondre aux objections et négocier des ententes avec assurance et professionnalisme.
  • Du leadership par influence. Vous pouvez aligner des équipes multidisciplinaires, créer de la responsabilisation, résoudre les frictions et faire avancer les décisions sans dépendre uniquement des liens hiérarchiques.
  • Une expérience en leadership commercial. Vous avez accompagné, dirigé ou géré des membres d’équipes de ventes entrantes, de ventes sortantes, de développement des ventes, de développement des affaires ou de vente.
  • Une grande rigueur en gestion du pipeline et en prévisions. Vous utilisez les données et les faits liés aux occasions, plutôt que l’optimisme, pour évaluer la qualité du pipeline et prévoir les revenus.
  • Une maîtrise des CRM. Vous possédez une solide expérience pratique avec HubSpot ou une plateforme comparable et maintenez des données commerciales exactes et utiles.
  • Une connaissance de Sandler. Vous avez une compréhension pratique du cadre de vente Sandler et savez appliquer des principes rigoureux de qualification et de prise de décision mutuelle.
  • Un baccalauréat. Vous détenez un baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en marketing, en communications ou dans un domaine connexe.

Atouts importants

  • Une expérience en agence de marketing numérique. Vous avez vendu des services comme les médias payants, la création, l’analytique, la stratégie, le marketing du cycle de vie, le référencement, le marketing de performance ou des programmes numériques intégrés.
  • Une expérience en services professionnels. Vous comprenez comment vendre de l’expertise, des personnes, des processus et des résultats plutôt qu’un produit tangible.
  • Une expérience avec des clients complexes. Vous avez vendu à des organisations de secteurs réglementés, à structure matricielle, dirigées par leurs fondateurs, soutenues par du capital-investissement ou évoluant dans d’autres contextes décisionnels complexes.
  • Un réseau de recommandation existant. Vous entretenez des relations de confiance avec des cadres, des investisseurs, des consultants, des partenaires technologiques ou d’autres sources d’occasions stratégiques.
  • Une expérience en programmes de prospection. Vous avez bâti ou amélioré de façon importante des systèmes, des messages, une segmentation, une structure d’équipe, des technologies ou des résultats de ventes sortantes.
  • Une expérience en vente par comptes ciblés. Vous savez coordonner des stratégies personnalisées de prospection et de démarche auprès d’un groupe défini de comptes à forte valeur.
  • Une expérience en embauche et en développement de talents commerciaux. Vous avez recruté, accompagné et évalué du personnel de vente ou de développement des affaires et avez pris des décisions relatives au rendement.
  • Une bonne compréhension du marketing. Vous pouvez discuter de façon crédible des médias de performance, de la stratégie créative, de la mesure, de l’acquisition de clients, de la génération de pipeline, de la conversion et de la croissance avec les clients et les spécialistes internes.

Attentes relatives à l’intelligence artificielle

Chez Level, l’IA est un ensemble de compétences, et non un raccourci. Dans ce rôle, la maîtrise de l’IA n’est pas facultative. Vous devrez l’utiliser pour améliorer la qualité, la rapidité, la rigueur et l’effet de levier de votre travail commercial.

On s’attendra à ce que vous puissiez :

  • Utiliser des outils comme ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Midjourney et d’autres plateformes d’IA pour améliorer la recherche sur les comptes, la prospection, la préparation à la découverte, l’élaboration de propositions, l’analyse concurrentielle, le suivi des rencontres et la planification commerciale.
  • Bâtir et documenter des processus assistés par l’IA qui améliorent la cohérence et l’efficacité des ventes entrantes, des ventes sortantes, de la qualification, de la conception de propositions et de la gestion du pipeline.
  • Utiliser l’IA pour synthétiser l’information sur les secteurs, le contexte des entreprises, les priorités des parties prenantes, les notes d’appels, l’historique des comptes et les risques liés aux occasions.
  • Expérimenter avec des messages, de la personnalisation, des réponses aux objections, des structures de propositions et des stratégies de démarche assistés par l’IA tout en conservant un solide jugement humain.
  • Créer et partager des bibliothèques de requêtes, des processus de vente, des cas d’utilisation et des apprentissages que les autres membres de l’équipe peuvent adopter et améliorer.
  • Évaluer de façon critique les résultats produits par l’IA et vérifier les affirmations, les constats et les recommandations avant de les utiliser dans du travail destiné aux clients.
  • Adopter une approche itérative. La première requête, le premier message ou le premier processus est rarement le meilleur.
  • L’IA ne remplace pas le jugement commercial, la préparation, le développement de relations ou la vente réfléchie. Elle constitue une infrastructure qui doit renforcer chacune de ces capacités.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

Sans ego, pleinement engagés

Nous ne disons pas : « Ce n’est pas mon travail. » Nous gagnons ensemble, intervenons lorsque nécessaire et accordons plus d’importance au résultat qu’à l’organigramme.

Meilleurs chaque jour

Nous voulons recevoir la rétroaction, même lorsqu’elle est difficile. Nous testons, apprenons, nous adaptons et continuons de relever la barre.

Inlassables dans la recherche de résultats

L’activité ne vaut rien sans résultats. Nous nous concentrons sur le travail qui fait avancer l’entreprise.

Guidés par la vérité

Nous remettons les hypothèses en question, suivons les données et disons aux clients ce qu’ils ont besoin d’entendre, et non seulement ce qui est facile à dire.

Avantages sociaux

Chez Level, nous soutenons les membres de notre équipe aux États-Unis et au Canada grâce à des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet aux États-Unis et au Canada, allocation mensuelle pour le travail à domicile et vendredis d’été
  • Congés généreux, notamment des congés payés illimités aux États-Unis, des vacances concurrentielles au Canada et des options de congé parental et familial
  • Régime complet d’assurance collective, soutien en santé mentale et assurance invalidité et vie payée par l’employeur
  • Cotisations de l’employeur aux régimes de retraite, soit le 401(k) aux États-Unis et une contribution équivalente au REER au Canada
  • Évaluations trimestrielles du rendement et possibilités d’avancement professionnel

Le télétravail d’abord

Ce poste est ouvert aux personnes résidant aux États-Unis et au Canada et s’effectue entièrement à distance. Des déplacements sont requis et peuvent comprendre des rencontres avec des clients, des événements d’entreprise, des présentations, des conférences et des événements de l’industrie. Une disponibilité occasionnelle en soirée ou la fin de semaine peut être requise selon les cycles de vente actifs.

Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.

Level repose sur l’inclusion

Nous nous engageons envers la diversité, l’équité, l’inclusion et le sentiment d’appartenance. Level est fière d’être un employeur souscrivant au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous une personne unique.

Level Agency offre des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap pendant le processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d’une mesure d’adaptation, veuillez nous en informer lors de votre candidature ou pendant le processus d’entrevue.

Prêt·e à postuler?

Cliquez ci-dessous pour soumettre votre curriculum vitæ. Vous devrez également répondre à quelques questions réfléchies, alors prenez le temps nécessaire.

Nous cherchons des preuves, pas un spectacle de vente. Dites-nous ce que vous avez vendu, à qui vous l’avez vendu, comment vous avez façonné l’occasion et ce que vous avez personnellement fait pour conclure l’entente.

Votre capacité à établir la confiance, à naviguer dans la complexité et à gagner les bons mandats compte davantage pour nous qu’un parcours professionnel parfaitement linéaire.

Bâtissons quelque chose ensemble.

Nous utilisons des outils assistés par l’IA pour soutenir certaines étapes de notre processus d’embauche, notamment la présélection des curriculum vitæ ainsi que la prise de notes ou la production de résumés d’entrevue. Ces outils appuient le jugement humain, mais ne le remplacent pas. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par l’équipe de recrutement de Level.

  • Promote adoption of FICO’s latest best in class mortgage analytics such as FICO Score 10T, UltraFICO and FSMS

  • Conduct executive-level presentations and client consultations to demonstrate ROI, competitive advantages, and positioning of FICO scores across various mortgage products and origination cycles

  • Develop comprehensive account plans to maximize revenue opportunities and identify cross-sell/up-sell initiatives in collaboration with sales executives

  • Lead seamless onboarding processes for new mortgage originators adopting FICO products, establishing success metrics and monitoring initial adoption against KPMs

  • As part of a matrix sales organization leverage FICO experts in your sales engagement across mortgage credit risk, GSE credit score requirements, investor buy guides, and origination operations

  • Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance against client objectives, review transactional activity, and communicate material changes to internal teams

  • Understand lender origination volumes, market position, strategic initiatives, and contractual levers to identify revenue growth opportunities

  • Serve as escalation point for technical issues and service delivery concerns while supporting change management initiatives to ensure positive client experience

  • Showcase new product features from releases and capture client requests for integration into product roadmap development

  • Attend industry networking events and trade shows to expand FICO's presence within the mortgage market

  • Track market trends, competitor activities, and industry regulations, relaying strategic insights to team and broader FICO organization

  • Identify new opportunities for FICO scores within various stages of the mortgage origination cycle and present findings to clients

  • Stay current on mortgage industry regulations, products, and best practices through ongoing education and professional development

What We're Seeking

  • Five+ years of experience in analytics, software, data and/or financial services sales.

  • Familiarity with managing lender relationships across IMBs, depositories, and credit unions preferred.

  • Proven track record of executive-level engagement and consultative selling within the mortgage origination ecosystem, with the ability to communicate ROI and competitive positioning to senior stakeholders.

  • Experience developing account plans, identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities, and driving revenue growth in a matrixed, collaborative sales environment.

  • Outstanding executive presence with superior communication, negotiation, and relationship management capabilities.

  • Strategic thinking combined with tactical execution skills and proven ability to drive results in matrix organizations.

  • Ability to travel 25% to 35% for partner meetings, industry conferences, and strategic planning sessions.

The targeted base pay range for this role is: $148,400 to $233,200 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Our Offer to You

  • An inclusive culture that strongly reflects our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.

  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.

  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $148,000 to $233,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. As an Area Distributor Manager (ADM), you will play a critical front-line sales role, driving Kraft Heinz’s Away From Home market share and profitability within a designated geographic territory. Essential Functions & Responsibilities

· Execute all elements of the Foodservice ADM playbook to ensure market success.

Your Role at Baxter

As a Critical Account Lead, you will serve as the single point of accountability for Baxter's most complex customer escalations within the Care Communications Solutions business. This newly created role was designed to improve the customer experience when issues span multiple products, teams, or technologies.


You'll partner closely with Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, Customer Success, Sales, and leadership teams to coordinate resolution efforts and ensure customers have a clear path forward. This is an opportunity to help build a new function, influence how critical customer situations are managed, and play a direct role in strengthening Baxter's relationships with healthcare customers.

  • Triage incoming escalations, assess severity levels, and determine appropriate engagement and response plans.
  • Lead cross-functional resolution teams across Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, Customer Success, Services, and Sales.
  • Coordinate resolution activities for complex customer issues, including incidents that span multiple products, technologies, business units, and support organizations.
  • Deliver executive-level status updates and escalation communications to internal stakeholders and customer leadership.
  • Maintain escalation records, action plans, and status reporting within established systems and processes.
  • Conduct post-incident reviews, document root causes, and identify opportunities to improve products, processes, and customer outcomes.
  • Support the development of escalation criteria, critical account pathways, performance metrics, and scalable operational processes for the Critical Account Lead program.

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

ABOUT US

GoGlobal is the leading professional services company to guide, establish and manage global operations with compliance and confidence. We bring the human touch to entering new markets and consolidating vendors through a single point of management. With a presence in over 140 countries on six continents and growing, we make running a global business easy.

Business & Corporate Services provided:

  • Entity Solutions: Entity establishment, Corporate secretarial & directorship services, Domicile services, Dormancy/Liquidation
  • HR Solutions: Global recruitment, Employer of Record (EOR), Agent of Record (AOR), Global benefits, Global payroll, International HR Consulting
  • Finance Solutions: Accounting & Tax

For more information, please visit GoGlobal.com

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

  • A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

  • We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout
  • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way
  • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
  • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world
  • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success
  • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership
  • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions
  • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

The Senior Clinical Data Manager will be responsible for performing Data Management activities that support client’s commercial and development projects worldwide. He/she will participate as an active member of a multi-disciplinary team to plan, lead and execute the Data Management tasks required for phase 1-4 studies. The Senior Clinical Data Manager has a broad, fundamental knowledge of the data management process and is able to perform most required tasks with minimal guidance.Essential Functions

  • ​Be able to lead a large clinical study or a series of related studies with minimal guidance
  • ​Represents Data Management on the CTWG for assigned studies
  • ​Provide mentoring and training to lower level Data Management staff assigned to his/her studies
  • ​Manage and monitor the progress of data management activities with CROs or other vendors on assigned studies; build effective relationships with CRO / vendor counterparts
  • ​Review protocols for appropriate data capture including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • ​Be able to perform a thoroughly detailed review of eCRF data requirements.
  • ​Interact with CRAs, programmers, study managers and statisticians in designing eCRFs and creating the annotated eCRF and CRF completion guidelines.
  • ​Lead the development of data edit check specifications and data listings
  • ​Coordinate the design and testing of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems according to company standards. Able to resolve EDC system issues with team members
  • ​Develop or lead the development of the Data Management Plan for a clinical study.
  • ​Able to review and provide feedback to the clinical team on other study documents e.g. Clinical Monitoring plans, Statistical analysis plans and vendor specifications
  • ​ May provide training on the EDC system and/or eCRF Completion Guidelines at Investigator Meetings and to internal and external study team members as needed
  • ​Perform reconciliation of header data from external data sources against the clinical database
  • ​Perform Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities according to SOPs and guidelines
  • ​Lead database upgrades/migrations including performing User Acceptance Testing
  • ​Be able to maintain study workbooks and data management files
  • ​Perform database lock and freeze activities per company SOPs
  • ​Participate in regular team meetings and provide input when appropriate
  • ​Provide input into the development of data management SOPs, Work Instructions, and process documents; take a leadership role in the development of assigned documents
  • ​Contribute to a professional working environment including the application of client’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics
  • ​Assist with the training of new employees and/or contractors

​

​Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • ​At least 8 years’ experience in Data Management for the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry, or equivalent experience in an FDA-regulated environment, including study lead experience
  • ​Has good project management skills and a proven ability to multitask
  • ​Understands the scope and focus of Phase 1-4 clinical studies, and has a proven ability to perform most of the core Data Management tasks and interact with vendors.
  • ​Possesses a comprehensive understanding of regulatory guidelines and industry standards (e.g., ICH/FDA guidances, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, etc.) and their application to Data Management practice.
  • ​Attention to detail and the ability to work individually, within a multi-disciplinary team, as well as with external partners and vendors.
  • ​Possesses strong English language written and verbal communication skills.
  • ​Experience and understanding of the Oncology or CNS therapeutic area, and with Phase III pivotal studies are preferred.
  • ​Able to travel to off-site meetings or training seminars as needed.
  • ​Possesses solid computer system and technical skills with a strong ability to learn multiple computer applications. Prior experience with different Data Management systems and technologies, and Electronic Data Capture systems is desirable

​Required/Preferred Education and Licenses

  • ​BA/BS, preferably in the scientific/healthcare field.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a stealth AI startup backed by one of Southeast Asia's leading technology companies and is currently building its global founding team.

The company is developing an AI-native communication platform designed to simplify everyday tasks by integrating AI directly into conversations. Instead of switching between multiple applications, users can plan, organize, compare, research, and complete tasks within a single intelligent assistant.

Serving a market of billions of users still relying on traditional productivity tools, the platform focuses on delivering reliable AI workflows, persistent context, multi-step reasoning, and seamless task execution. The mission is to create an AI assistant that significantly improves productivity while making everyday work simpler and more intuitive.

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Technical Lead, Machine Learning to lead the execution of its AI platform by translating research into scalable, production-ready machine learning systems. This role sits at the intersection of research, infrastructure, and product, with responsibility for ensuring models are trainable, deployable, observable, and optimized for real-world performance.

Working closely with research, engineering, and product teams, this position will drive the development of robust ML infrastructure while balancing performance, reliability, latency, and cost.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end execution of machine learning systems, including data pipelines, training workflows, evaluation frameworks, inference architecture, and production deployment.
  • Fine-tune and optimize models using modern techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and model distillation.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable inference systems with a focus on latency, cost efficiency, and reliability.
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines for both synthetic and real-world training datasets.
  • Build evaluation frameworks to measure model performance, robustness, safety, and bias in collaboration with research teams.
  • Optimize production deployments through GPU utilization, memory efficiency, inference optimization, and scaling strategies.
  • Partner closely with application engineering teams to integrate machine learning systems into backend, desktop, and mobile products.
  • Continuously improve production systems through rapid iteration, monitoring, and data-driven optimization.

Requirements

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade machine learning systems used by real users.
  • Strong expertise working with large language models and understanding model behavior, limitations, and failure modes.
  • Experience developing scalable ML infrastructure, training pipelines, and inference systems.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to write maintainable, production-quality code.
  • Experience balancing real-world production constraints, including latency, reliability, scalability, cost, and safety.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently drive technical initiatives from design through deployment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working in cross-functional, high-performing engineering teams.

Preferred Technical Skills

Experience with the following technologies is preferred:

  • Python
  • PyTorch and/or JAX
  • GPU-based model training and inference systems

Accountable for establishing and maintaining analytical and reporting standards across the department and enterprise for quality, patient safety and clinical effectiveness. The Director, System Quality Analytics will develop and facilitate intake governance to prioritize work across all requestors for quality. Responsible for scaling and optimizing quality analytics capabilities to provide forecasting and prediction capabilities in relation to all externally reported quality programs including but not limited to Leapfrog, Vizient, USNEWS, CMS IQR, CMS Care Compare Star Rating in partnership with Director, System Quality Monitoring and Reporting. Position will report to VP, Quality and Patient Safety.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Education: Bachelor's Degree in a work-related field/discipline (i.e. mathematics, economics, engineering, computer science) from an accredited college or university required.

Master's Degree in a work-related field/discipline from an accredited college or university preferred.

Licenses/Certifications: Epic or related database certification or training preferred.


Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Seven (7) years of experience in a complex health system, including five (5) years of supervisory experience in complex environments.
  • Five (5) years of experience with deployment of operational reporting and/or business intelligence solutions in a complex health system.
  • Effective oral and written communication skills, advanced presentation skills.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Establishes, supports, and optimizes an organizational structure that provides analytics and reporting aligned with Quality department’s goals.
  • Provides strategic leadership to standardize reporting capabilities, processes, and resources across the Quality Analytics department.
  • Collaborates with department managers, physicians, and senior leadership to continuously improve operations quality and provide analytics and reports that assist in managing quality improvement.
  • Responsible for creation and maintenance of a framework for continuous monitoring and improvements related to the value of clinical services based on quality, cost, and appropriateness of the care and service provided to patients.

  • Manages departmental human resources related to the direct report team; meets department budget target for labor and non-labor budgets.
  • Evaluates the efficiency of Quality Analytics and organizes work to maximize output.
  • Directs the data analysis and reporting of clinical utilization, cost, financial, claims and clinical data; oversees timelines; monitors performance and anticipates and mitigates risks.
  • Develops and maintains technology roadmap in support of Quality Analytics department needs.
  • Collaborates with Central Analytics team to establish enterprise-wide data governance processes that enable clear and consistent data definitions (both in business and technical terms), and clear stewardship processes for maintenance of data.

jobs.excerpt: Leidos is seeking a Senior Environmental Chemist to support federal environmental remediation and restoration programs for multiple government clients.
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Environmental Chemist to support federal environmental remediation and restoration programs for multiple government clients. This position will provide senior-level technical expertise in environmental chemistry, chemical data validation, data quality, and environmental data management in support of site characterization, remediation, environmental compliance, waste disposal, and restoration activities.


The Senior Environmental Chemist will oversee the validation and management of inorganic and organic analytical data, including PFAS and other emerging contaminants; provide technical oversight of analytical laboratory subcontractors; and ensure environmental data meet applicable project, regulatory, and quality assurance requirements. The position will also provide technical guidance and oversight to junior and mid-level chemists performing data validation activities.

This role will manage environmental sample and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle, from sampling preparation and laboratory coordination through data validation, database management, usability assessment, and final reporting.

This is a remote, office-based position and does not involve routine laboratory bench work.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Perform chemical data validation and independent technical reviews of inorganic and organic analytical laboratory data packages.
  • Evaluate laboratory deliverables for completeness and compliance, assess quality control results, and assign appropriate data validation qualifiers based on applicable criteria.
  • Oversee and review Stage 2 data validation performed by junior and mid-level chemists.
  • Prepare data validation narratives, quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) reports, and data usability assessments documenting findings and conclusions.
  • Author, review, and implement Uniform Federal Policy Quality Assurance Project Plans (UFP-QAPPs) and associated quality assurance documentation.
  • Support environmental field sampling activities through database setup, sample identification, labels, chain-of-custody documentation, and review for compliance with project planning documents.
  • Manage environmental samples and analytical data throughout the project lifecycle using applicable environmental data management systems.
  • Perform quality control reviews of data entered into environmental databases, including EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and FUDSChem.
  • Query, evaluate, and reconcile environmental data in response to project needs and verify final database information against laboratory-reported results.
  • Manage analytical laboratory subcontractors, coordinate sample delivery and analytical schedules, review laboratory performance, and resolve laboratory QA/QC deficiencies.
  • Coordinate closely with project managers, environmental scientists, engineers, field personnel, laboratories, and data management staff to meet project requirements and schedules.
  • Provide technical guidance to project managers and junior staff regarding analytical chemistry, laboratory methods, data quality, validation requirements, and interpretation of chemical data.
  • Support environmental investigations, site characterization, remediation, environmental permitting, effluent monitoring, waste characterization and disposal, and other environmental restoration activities.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry or a closely related scientific discipline and at least 10 years of relevant experience in environmental chemistry, including validation of inorganic and organic analytical data and environmental data/database management.
  • Demonstrated experience validating analytical data for environmental investigation, remediation, restoration, or compliance programs.
  • Experience with PFAS analytical data and other emerging contaminants.
  • Experience overseeing and providing technical review of junior and mid-level chemists performing Stage 2 data validation.
  • Strong working knowledge of EPA SW-846 methods, Contract Laboratory Program (CLP) requirements, and environmental analytical chemistry methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate laboratory QA/QC results and determine the usability and quality of environmental analytical data.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to organize, prioritize, and manage responsibilities across multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Self-motivated with strong analytical, problem-solving, verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Word.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing or reviewing Stage 3 and/or Stage 4 data validation.
  • Working knowledge of the Department of Defense (DoD) Quality Systems Manual (QSM) and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) National Functional Guidelines for Data Review.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing UFP-QAPPs for federal environmental programs.
  • Experience supporting CERCLA, RCRA, DoD, USACE, EPA, or other federal environmental remediation/restoration programs.
  • Experience with environmental data management systems such as EQuIS, ERPIMS, ADR.net, and/or FUDSChem.
  • Experience with database and data management tools such as Microsoft Access and SQL.
  • Experience managing analytical laboratory subcontractors and resolving laboratory data quality or performance issues.

Must be able to pass a Public Trust background investigation; due to contract requirements, U.S. Citizenship or U.S. Permanent residency is required.

**Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.**

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer/AI Lead
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer/AI Lead to join our team. As a Senior AI Engineer/AI Lead, you will drive the design and implementation of a cutting-edge, multi-agent AI platform that transforms how adverse event data is processed and managed in pharmacovigilance. This position plays a critical role in advancing clinical research automation, ensuring regulatory compliance, and establishing new standards for safety and efficiency in drug safety operations. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including domain experts, quality assurance, and regulatory specialists, following industry-standard processes and contributing to system development from architecture through validation and deployment. Responsibilities include designing and implementing advanced AI agent orchestration, defining evaluation frameworks, architecting secure integrations with enterprise systems, and ensuring GxP compliance, with significant opportunities to influence technical direction, drive innovation in AI governance, and expand your expertise in regulated AI systems.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing pharmacovigilance automation, improving data accuracy and safety oversight, and establishing Parexel as a leader in AI-driven clinical research. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior AI Engineer/AI Lead can explore emerging technologies, mentor junior engineers, and expand skills across AI architecture, regulatory compliance, and healthcare innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement the multi-agent architecture using AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, Strands SDK, and/or LangGraph, with Anthropic Claude as the foundation model layer

  • Define the agent topology including supervisor orchestration, inter-agent communication, state management, escalation routing, and comprehensive audit trail infrastructure

  • Own the prompt engineering strategy across all pharmacovigilance agents, including system prompts, few-shot examples, and guardrails to ensure accuracy and compliance

  • Architect, design, and build Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose enterprise applications, data sources, and services as standardized tools for AI agents

  • Build and maintain the evaluation pipeline by designing benchmarks, curating ground-truth datasets with domain experts, and running accuracy and precision measurements

  • Architect the quality control layer including cross-model verification, deterministic rule engines for field validation, and auto-escalation logic

  • Collaborate with the existing team to migrate current systems to Claude on Bedrock while preserving proven logic and re-engineering prompts and evaluation pipelines

  • Define the CI/CD and MLOps strategy including model versioning, prompt version control, deployment of pipelines, monitoring dashboards, and cost tracking

  • Own the technical validation strategy aligned to GAMP5 Category 5 requirements, working with QA to produce IQ/OQ/PQ documentation specific to LLM-based systems

  • Write and review technical documentation including architecture decision records, algorithm descriptions, and AI model specifications aligned to regulatory frameworks

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Expertise in AI system architecture, prompt engineering, and large language model orchestration

  • Experience designing and implementing secure integrations between AI systems and enterprise applications

  • The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear communication for non-technical stakeholders, including regulatory and quality audiences

  • A commitment to quality, compliance, and patient safety in regulated environments

  • Comfort working with AWS cloud services, Python, and modern AI frameworks and tools

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience building ML/AI production systems, with at least 2 years working with large language models in application-level contexts

  • Deep working knowledge of Anthropic Claude APIs, prompt engineering patterns, and retrieval-augmented generation architectures

  • Practical experience with AWS, specifically Bedrock (model invocation, agents, knowledge bases), Lambda, S3, IAM, and CloudTrail

  • Experience building multi-agent or multi-step LLM orchestration systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or Strands SDK

  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals including API design, containerization, infrastructure-as-code, testing, and version control

  • Demonstrated ability to design evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs, including accuracy measurement, regression testing, and confidence calibration

  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including regulatory and quality audiences

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing and implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or equivalent tool-serving frameworks

  • Familiarity with GxP/regulated software environments, GAMP5 validation, CSV/CSA approaches, or FDA software guidance

  • Prior work on document processing pipelines including OCR, PDF extraction, email parsing, or structured data extraction from unstructured clinical text

  • Experience with MedDRA or other medical coding dictionaries

  • Track record of shipping LLM-based systems in regulated industries such as pharma, healthcare, or fintech

  • Exposure to pharmacovigilance, clinical safety, or healthcare data processing

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
