jobs.title: Development Lead - Prospect Research & New Business Development
jobs.excerpt: Job Description: Position OverviewThe Development Lead – Prospect Research and New Business Development leads funder research, prospect development, active pipeline management, and research operations across fundraising verticals, including individuals, foundations, corporate philanthropy, corporate fee-for-service engagement partners, and the public sector.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Position Overview

The Development Lead – Prospect Research and New Business Development leads funder research, prospect development, active pipeline management, and research operations across fundraising verticals, including individuals, foundations, corporate philanthropy, corporate fee-for-service engagement partners, and the public sector.


This is an experienced Lead / senior individual contributor role for a candidate who can assess RMI's current state, strengthen standards, and help mature the prospect development function. The role supports unrestricted and general operating revenue growth by improving how prospects are identified, prioritized, tracked, and advanced; how prospect data is captured and surfaced in Salesforce or related data warehouse/reporting environments; and how AI, automation, and prospect intelligence are used responsibly to support better fundraising decisions.


The ideal candidate brings dedicated prospect development practice, data fluency, Apra-informed standards, and experience supporting prospect discovery across individual, foundation, corporate, and public-sector revenue streams. Individual/HNWI research experience is especially valuable given RMI’s unrestricted giving goals.


This role is part of RMI's Development & Strategic Engagement team and reports to the Director of New Initiatives & Partnerships (Strategic Services).


Key Responsibilities

Prospect Research and New Business Development

  • Lead and evolve RMI's prospect research and prospect development work across the revenue portfolio, maintaining centralized prospect lists and pipelines that incorporate inputs from new business development efforts, Program teams, Development staff, events, executive engagement opportunities, and shifts in the broader funding landscape.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend U.S. and global prospects across revenue streams, with emphasis on action-ready opportunities that have clear capacity, inclination, access, timing, and strategic fit for unrestricted, flexible, general operating, or priority program support.
  • Apply Apra-informed best practices in capacity, inclination, affinity, and readiness analysis; relationship mapping; ethical research; due diligence; reputational judgment; and privacy-conscious documentation.
  • Own cross-vertical new business development workstreams, including research delivery, reporting, meeting facilitation, accountability tracking, process improvements, and concise prospect briefings with clear next steps.

Pipeline Strategy and Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Actively manage program-specific and cross-program prospect pipelines, tracking opportunity status, prospect movement, owner accountability, next steps, and action follow-up.
  • Conduct pipeline analysis, reporting, and financial pipeline reviews to identify funding gaps, high-potential opportunities, prospects ready for outreach, and actions needed to move prospects forward.
  • Partner with Relationship Managers and program colleagues to prioritize prospects, identify engagement gaps, support follow-up, and elevate recurring or unresolved barriers to Development leadership when needed.
  • Translate prospect and pipeline data into clear recommendations for where RMI should focus limited relationship-building time and senior leadership attention, separating useful intelligence from action-ready opportunities.

Systems, Data, Automation, and Operational Excellence

  • Serve as a steward of high-quality prospect and pipeline data in Salesforce, including relationship data, ratings, attribute coding, opportunities, tasks, moves management, prospect status, and next steps.
  • Partner with Development Operations and data/technology colleagues to strengthen the prospect research data model in Salesforce or related data warehouse/reporting environments, including fields, tagging, data standards, dashboards, and data-quality checks.
  • Develop standardized capacity, inclination, affinity, and readiness rating practices; evaluate research resources, datasets, AI applications, automation tools, data enrichment services, and vendor relationships to improve the effectiveness and efficiency of RMI's prospect research system.
  • Use AI and automation responsibly to reduce duplicative manual work, improve prospect discovery, increase reporting speed, and support prioritization while maintaining human judgment, documentation quality, privacy safeguards, and ethical review.
  • Identify, streamline, document, and improve internal processes across research requests, qualification, outreach handoffs, data flow, reporting, and knowledge management.

Training, Standards, and Resource Coordination

  • Promote knowledge-sharing and consistent adoption of prospect research and new business development processes across collaborators, making tools and workflows practical, easy to use, and tied to fundraising decisions.
  • Train Development, Strategic Engagement, and Program colleagues on prospect research tools, data practices, and effective partnership with Development; guide staff, contractors, interns, or vendors on repeatable research or data tasks as needed.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5 years of dedicated experience in prospect research, prospect development, fundraising operations, donor services, advancement services, or a related nonprofit development function.
  • Familiarity with the Apra Body of Knowledge, Apra-informed ethical research standards, and current prospect development practices; Apra membership, training, or equivalent professional development preferred.
  • Experience identifying and qualifying prospects across fundraising verticals, including individuals/HNWIs, family offices, family foundations, donor-advised fund holders, institutional foundations, corporate philanthropy or fee-for-service partners, and public-sector funders; individual giving experience preferred.
  • Experience with prospect research tools and methods, including DonorSearch, WealthX, Foundation Directory/Foundation Center, Relationship Science, Salesforce, screenings, relationship mapping, public records, due diligence, and moves-management support.
  • Strong data fluency, including Salesforce reports/dashboards, segmentation, data mining, database overlays, data hygiene, pipeline reporting, and comfort partnering on Salesforce or data warehouse improvements.
  • Experience using or evaluating AI-enabled research tools, workflow automation, data enrichment tools, or vendor systems to improve research speed, accuracy, and decision-making.
  • Demonstrated analytical, project management, writing, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, including sound judgment with sensitive information; disciplined prioritization; due diligence and judgment; and ability to build shared ownership of next steps across a matrixed team.
  • Experience working in the environmental, climate, clean energy sector, or adjacent mission-driven sector is preferred but not required.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note: At this time, RMI is not able to sponsor employment visas or hire candidates who require visa sponsorship to work in the United States. All candidates must have current, independent authorization to work in the U.S. without present or future sponsorship from RMI. We will update our hiring pages if this status changes.


Location

We are a remote-ready company with team members around the globe. Our beautiful and welcoming offices are available for meetings or focused work, whether you are traveling through or living nearby. Our U.S. offices are in New York City; Washington DC; Oakland, California; Boulder, Colorado, and Basalt, Colorado. This role can be located from anywhere in the continental United States.


We provide you with the essential IT equipment plus a one-time home technology payment and a monthly work from home/commuter allowance to ensure you have a comfortable home office set up and necessary supplies.


We love seeing each other in person! We occasionally gather for shared time together like retreats and learning experiences. Be ready to travel for occasional in-person meetings (and of course, we cover travel costs).


Compensation   

At RMI, we prioritize fairness in our pay practices. Salaries are determined based on a mix of experience, market benchmarks, and internal equity across similar roles. The salary range of this position is $$76,030-$93,707. New hires typically start toward the lower end of the range, depending on experience and alignment with the role’s scope. In addition to base salary, this position includes an annual bonus target of 5% and eligibility for merit-based increases, which are tied to both individual and organizational performance.

  

Benefits:    

We offer an array of benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 403b retirement match with immediate vesting
  • Group life, AD&D, and short- and long-term disability
  • Optional voluntary life, AD&D and accident plans
  • Health savings or flexible spending accounts
  • Fertility and hormonal health support
  • Mental health and wellness support
  • Comprehensive leaves of absence (including generous parental leave)
  • Generous paid time off and sick leave
  • Paid sabbatical leave
  • Regional holidays with at least one extended break in each geography
  • Work from home and home technology allowances
  • Learning & development opportunities (LinkedIn Learning and an annual individual professional development budget)
  • Potential for bonuses and merit increases
  • Discount marketplace (gym memberships, pet insurance, etc.)
  • Hybrid / remote work options
  • Team retreats and geographic meetups
  • Rewards and recognition programs

  

Diversity         

We know that the diversity of our teams makes us stronger as an organization, and RMI is dedicated to the principles of equal employment opportunity as outlined in U.S. federal law. We prohibit discrimination against applicants, interns, and employees on the basis of any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: age (40 and over), race, color, sex, pregnancy (including lactation, childbirth, or related medical conditions), religion, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), sexual orientation, gender expression/identity, uniformed service member status, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other applicable status protected by applicable law.

RMI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Product Marketing Manager

Givelify is a fintech-for-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we’ve helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7.5 billion. Together, they’re changing their world with kindness and generosity.

Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters.

Make an impact at one of the fastest-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits.

About your role:

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help our rapidly growing, award-winning organization bring world-class product marketing to our giving communities, making it easier for them to understand how Givelify’s products can help them achieve their goals and do more good.

In this role, you will shape Givelify’s positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies for products and customer segments. You will use customer and market research, competitive intelligence, industry best practices, and company data to translate donor and Giving Partner needs into product narratives, launch strategies, and marketing and enablement materials.

You will also collaborate with multiple cross-functionable teams from Product to Customer to drive strong launches, adoptions, and growth. Success will be measured through KPIs, including product usage, NPS, and percentage of consistent givers.

If you are a mission-driven product marketer who cares deeply about helping audiences understand how the right products can support their goals, solve real problems, and help them do more good, we would like to speak with you.

Your team:

You will join the Product Marketing Team, reporting to the Senior Product Marketing Manager. The team drives product awareness and usage by helping donors and Giving Partners clearly understand how Givelify products help them achieve their goals better than any alternative — through insight-driven positioning, messaging, pricing, packaging, and marketing and sales channel activation.

You will be surrounded by brilliant, passionate people committed to success. Within Marketing, you’ll collaborate closely with Brand, Channel, and Content. Your key cross-functional partners will include Product, Creative, Customer Success & Experiences, Data Science & Insights, and Strategic Partnerships.

The product marketer, you will get to:

Lead and complete key product marketing milestones that impact nearly 2 million generous donors and more than 75,000 nonprofits and places of worship.

  • Research & Customer Insights: Conduct customer, market, and competitive research to understand donor and Giving Partner needs, market trends, competitive alternatives, and opportunities for Givelify to better serve them.
  • Positioning & Messaging: Translate insights into strong positioning and simple, compelling product messaging that communicates Givelify’s value to target audiences. Lead audience validation to improve resonance and effectiveness.
  • Launch Strategy: Build launch campaigns and channel plans based on target audience insights, market learnings, company goals, and past performance.
  • Launch Asset Development & Enablement: Create, maintain, and update core product marketing assets, including positioning and messaging strategies, audience insights, competitive snapshots, launch initiative strategies, and enablement materials.
  • Optimization: Track launch results and optimize plans using qualitative and quantitative data, including but not limited to audience voice, product awareness and adoption. Monitor market trends, customer feedback, and competitive activity to identifyfuture growth opportunities.

To be successful in this role, you’ll also:

  • Customer Understanding: Build a strong understanding of donors, Giving Partners, nonprofits, places of worship, and the teams who support them.
  • Strategy and Business Case: Turn customer, market, competitive, and company data into clear recommendations that improve messaging, launch strategy, adoption, and growth.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success & Experiences, Strategic Partnerships, and Data Science & Insights to refine strategies and execute successful launches.
  • Project Management: Manage launch workstreams, timelines, dependencies, approvals, and stakeholder communication to keep initiatives moving forward.
  • Documentation: Ensure every initiative’s plan, results, and learnings are clearly communicated, documented, and discoverable for future use.
  • Continuous Improvement: Use performance data, audience feedback, and launch learnings to improve future campaigns, customer communications, and enablement materials.

Your experience:

  • 3+ years of relevant, demonstrable experience in product marketing. 5+ years of total experience in marketing and/or strategy
  • MBA or MS in marketing or business
  • Experience working in Consumer-Packaged Goods, Consumer Technology and/or 2-sided Marketplace
  • Strong experience in product marketing fundamentals, including but not limited to consumer insights and market research, product positioning & messaging development, and GTM strategy building & execution
  • Certification(s) in product or customer marketing a plus
  • Experience in hypothesis-based test-and-learn growth approach a plus
  • Experience in lifecycle marketing a plus

Your superpowers:

  • Combination of a customer-centric, data-oriented mindset with creative/brand sensibilities
  • Strategic thinker with a data-driven approach to driving content development decisions
  • Seasoned at connecting the dots between the psychology of consumer behavior, communication, and data
  • Excellent communicator who uses storytelling to break down complex topics into fifth grade concepts
  • Strong interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders
  • Preference for working in an agile environment with a “get it done” mentality
  • Outstanding project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

Our culture:

We are a virtual team of award-winning and high-performing professionals who innovate and collaborate to fulfill our mission to instantly connect people to causes that matter most to them so they can change their world with kindness and generosity. Our four keys to success - integrity, heart, simplicity, and wow - fuel our passion to be recognized among the tech industry’s most inclusive and purpose-driven workplaces.

We are steadfast in our conviction to overcome challenges while performing meaningful work alongside some of the most brilliant minds and biggest hearts. It propels our growth as individuals and as a team. We are committed to respecting each other in our workplace, firmly believing diversity is our strength.

At the heart of everything we do are our giving community, our donors and our partner organizations. We lean on research and human-centered design to consistently push the envelope and innovate our products and customer experiences.

We take great pride in providing competitive pay, full benefits to help care for you today and in the future, amazing perks (including flexible PTO), and, most importantly, the opportunity to put passion and purpose front and center.

About Givelify

Givelify is the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving platform. Along with its powerful donation management system, it’s the fastest-growing technology for advancing generosity in the world. We instantly connect people to their heart’s impulse to do good with award-winning products and experiences. A global community of over 2 million generous people supports their favorite churches, places of worship, nonprofits, and causes with over $7.5 billion in donations across more than 80,000 organizations. Givelify leads all giving apps on the App Store and Google Play Store with more than 135,000 verified, authentic reviews with an average 4.9 out of 5-star rating. Learn more at Givelify.com.

Ready to join the Givelify team? Apply below.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the Job

As a Remote Enterprise Account Manager, you will manage a premium portfolio of restaurant groups and strategic accounts, taking full ownership of client relationships to maintain high retention rates and foster satisfaction. Your goal is to drive deep utilization of our services by building meaningful, high-level connections with decision-makers and conducting insightful business reviews. This impact-focused role involves delivering tailored training to maximize the value of software and marketing tools while gathering critical feedback to influence product enhancements. You will act as a trusted advisor, playing a key role in shaping account management strategies, driving revenue growth, and helping restaurants optimize their operations with data-driven insights.

Note: Applicants must reside in the United States. Dallas or Houston residence strongly preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a premium portfolio of restaurant groups and strategic accounts, driving client retention, revenue growth, and deep utilization of services.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to decision-makers, conducting business reviews and delivering tailored training on software and marketing tools.
  • Educate clients on industry trends and leverage data-driven insights to help them optimize their restaurant operations.
  • Act as the primary liaison between clients and internal departments, ensuring exceptional support and resolving critical issues efficiently.
  • Partner with Product and Marketing teams by sharing market feedback to influence future developments and enhancements.
  • Travel 30-50% to build and maintain face-to-face relationships with clients and deliver in-person presentations.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in account management or restaurant management.
  • Proven expertise in consultative account management and a strong understanding of restaurant operations.
  • Strong aptitude for data-driven decision-making and providing actionable business insights.
  • Exceptional organizational, time management, and cross-departmental collaboration skills.
  • Ability to travel 30-50% depending on location to engage with clients. Applicants must reside in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Food and Beverage Management experience within a hospitality group.
  • Experience utilizing CRM solutions such as Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with reservation software or restaurant table management software.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in unstructured, entrepreneurial environments.
  • Dallas or Houston residence strongly preferred.

Benefits and Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Competitive retirement and health plans

Note for MA applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

There are a variety of factors that go into determining a salary range, including but not limited to external market benchmark data, geographic location, and years of experience sought/required. The range for this United States located role is $70,000 - $80,000USD.

We offer a competitive base salary and benefits including: health benefits; flexible spending account; retirement benefits; life insurance; paid time off (including PTO, paid sick leave, medical leave, bereavement leave, floating holidays and paid holidays); and parental leave benefits. This role is eligible to be considered for an annual bonus.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

jobs.excerpt: At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet.
jobs.description:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, you will enjoy:

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance; we also offer a company-paid health care concierge service to help navigate our health plan to make the best decisions for you and yours
• 401(k) with company match
• Paid vacation, sick, personal and parental leave time
• Paid Volunteer Time: giving back to our communities is important to us
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities
• Access to on-demand training courses to advance further in your career

Job Description

Please Note: qualified candidates must live within the state of California, Arizona or Oregon for this role, with a heavy preference for greater LA area.


Senior Energy Engineering Consultant (Senior SEM Coach)

CLEAResult’s Strategic Energy Management (SEM) team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior SEM Coach to guide energy teams at large commercial, institutional and industrial facilities through continuous improvement. Your main role is to coach plant and facility staff to find, evaluate and implement energy savings. You’ll manage multiple customer engagements at once and bring a strong understanding of energy-using systems such as central plants, HVAC, lighting and process loads. You will also merge the technical with the human element to add value for each customer site. The aim is to help each participant build lasting energy management practices and measurable savings.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coach and motivate facility and plant teams, from operators to senior management, to adopt SEM practices and sustain energy savings.
  • Deliver SEM engagements per the CA SEM Design Guide, including workshops, one-on-one coaching, energy-use baselining and tracking, and site improvement plans.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects and participant companies, keeping schedules, milestones and savings goals on track and escalating issues early.
  • Facilitate training workshops, onsite energy audits and site walk-throughs to identify energy savings opportunities.
  • Analyze system and process performance using monitoring equipment, utility data and statistical analysis.
  • Write clear reports and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build client trust and show the value of SEM so participants stay engaged and savings keep growing.
  • Mentor junior coaches and help refine SEM tools and materials.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in energy efficiency, facilities or industrial operations, including experience with energy-using systems at large commercial and/or industrial sites.
  • Proven project management skills, including managing multiple projects at once.
  • Strong interpersonal, coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to work with different personalities and drive results.
  • Proficiency in Excel (formulas, charting, data interpretation), Word (styles, cross-referencing, professional layout) and PowerPoint (slide masters, consistent branding, clear and engaging design).

Preferred

  • Certified Energy Manager (CEM) or Professional Engineer (PE) license.
  • Experience with continuous improvement, change management, or Lean/Six Sigma principles.
  • Prior SEM coaching experience and statistical modeling skills.

Target Compensation Range (budgeted)

$100,000 - $120,000

🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer (BE-leaning)interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and SQL.

As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications.

  • Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture.

  • Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team.

  • Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills.

  • Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services.

  • Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts.

  • Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively.

  • Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer

  • Proficient in full stack development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby, Javascript utilizing React or similar.

  • Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases.

  • Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale.

  • Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems.

  • Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks, etc.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor (Healthcare)
jobs.excerpt: Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
Are you ready to leverage your talents to make healthcare better for everyone?
Do you want the opportunity to give back to your community?
Do you want to have fun at work?
Then join the growing team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States!

Summary

The Senior Auditor conducts complex healthcare performance measure validation (PMV) activities. This position applies Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set® (HEDIS) Compliance Audit principles, techniques, and professional judgment to the validation of HEDIS and non-HEDIS performance measures in accordance with applicable technical specifications, contractual requirements, and the Centers for Medicare/Medicaid Services (CMS) External Quality Review (EQR) Protocol 2. The Senior Auditor evaluates information systems, data integrity, measure calculation processes, source code and programming logic, medical record review processes, and reported performance measure results to determine whether measures are accurate, reliable, and calculated in accordance with established specifications. The Senior Auditor will have the ability to work independently while providing technical leadership and mentoring to other staff.

Essential Competencies, Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and conduct HEDIS compliance audit and performance measure validation activities.
  • Apply HEDIS audit techniques and methodologies to HEDIS, CMS Core Set, state-defined, HRSA, AHRQ, and other performance measures, as applicable.
  • Conduct information systems assessments and evaluate systems and processes supporting performance measure calculation and reporting.
  • Assess the accuracy, completeness, and integration of enrollment, claims/encounter, provider, pharmacy, laboratory, medical record, supplemental, vendor, and other applicable data sources.
  • Review source code, programming logic, data mapping, measure workflows, and calculation methodologies for compliance with measure specifications.
  • Validate denominator, numerator, exclusions, eligibility, continuous enrollment, clinical coding, sampling, and other measure-specific requirements.
  • Conduct primary source verification and record-level testing to verify the accuracy of source data and reported results.
  • Evaluate medical record review processes, abstraction methodologies, sampling, and quality-control procedures, as applicable.
  • Lead virtual and onsite audit activities and conduct interviews with client staff responsible for information systems, data management, programming, quality measurement, and reporting.
  • Identify audit findings, assess their impact on measure validity, and develop clear, evidence-based conclusions and recommendations.
  • Prepare and review audit workpapers, validation tools, findings, and client-facing reports.
  • Provide senior-level review and technical guidance to auditors and other project staff.
  • Communicate complex technical findings effectively to clients, state Medicaid agencies, internal leadership, and other stakeholders.
  • Support development and continuous improvement of audit methodologies, tools, workpapers, and reporting processes.
  • Maintain current knowledge of HEDIS requirements, CMS EQR protocols, CMS Core Set specifications, and other applicable performance measurement standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, public health, health information management, nursing, information systems, statistics, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Significant experience in HEDIS compliance auditing, healthcare performance measurement, performance measure validation, healthcare data validation, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret and apply complex performance measure specifications.
  • Experience evaluating healthcare information systems, data flows, and data used for performance measure reporting.
  • Experience reviewing source code, programming logic, or measure calculation methodologies, directly or in collaboration with technical staff.
  • Experience conducting audits, developing findings, documenting supporting evidence, and communicating results to clients and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex audit activities and provide technical guidance to other staff.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience conducting NCQA HEDIS Compliance Audits.
  • Experience conducting performance measure validation under CMS EQR Protocol 2.
  • Experience with Medicaid and/or CHIP managed care programs.
  • Experience validating CMS Core Set, state-defined, or other non-HEDIS performance measures.
  • Experience with information systems assessments, primary source verification, medical record review validation, and source code review.
  • Familiarity with SQL, SAS, Python, or similar data-query or programming tools.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of HEDIS performance measurement and audit concepts.
  • Knowledge of CMS EQR performance measure validation requirements and methodologies.
  • Ability to apply established HEDIS audit techniques to HEDIS and non-HEDIS performance measures.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare information systems, data flows, and performance measure calculation processes.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to interpret technical specifications and translate them into effective audit procedures.
  • Sound professional judgment in evaluating audit evidence and determining the significance of findings.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to prepare clear, concise, and defensible technical documentation.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet contractual and regulatory deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while providing technical leadership and mentoring to other staff.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Planejamento, desenvolvimento, implantação e execução continuada de atividades de suporte técnico aos usuários de TIC e Serviços de Sustentação da Infraestrutura, remoto e presencial, abrangendo orientação e esclarecimento de dúvidas, recebimento, registro, análise, diagnóstico, atendimento de solicitações de clientes, resolução de problemas, implementação de serviços, migrações e transferência tecnológicas, execução de procedimentos periódicos, controle e atualização de documentações voltadas para sustentação da infraestrutura de TIC.

    Especialização Exclusiva e Avançada em PostgreSQL

    • Administração de Ambientes: Gestão completa e exclusiva de ecossistemas PostgreSQL corporativos.
    • Tuning e Performance: Domínio avançado em rotinas de vacuum/autovacuum, otimização de performance e análise detalhada de planos de execução (EXPLAIN, ANALYZE).
    • Gerenciamento de Conexões (PgBouncer): Instalação, configuração de pooling modes, monitoramento avançado de conexões e diagnóstico de problemas de saturação.
    • Automação e Desenvolvimento: Capacidade para criar, ler e revisar scripts complexos em PL/pgSQL.

    Infraestrutura Linux, Resiliência e Continuidade

    • Sustentação do Sistema Operacional: Suporte e otimização (tuning) em ambientes Linux (RHEL, Debian e Ubuntu), com foco em storage e sistemas de arquivos (file systems) para alta performance de banco de dados.
    • Alta Disponibilidade (HA) e DR: Experiência prática com replicação física e lógica, monitoramento preventivo com alertas e estratégias consolidadas de Disaster Recovery.
    • Gestão de Backups: Configuração, administração e proposição de melhorias para as políticas internas de backup e restore.
    • Ciclo de Vida Operacional: Aplicação de patches, atualizações de versão e resolução de incidentes/problemas nos ambientes de Desenvolvimento, Homologação, Testes e Produção.

    Governança, Modelagem e Compliance de Dados

    • Padrões Corporativos: Manutenção de padrões rigorosos de nomenclatura, mnemônicos, biblioteca de objetos de dados e do mapa de integração, seguindo a Política de Administração de Dados da Contratante.
    • Homologação de Modelos: Validação técnica de modelos de dados lógicos e físicos junto à instituição.
    • Segurança e LGPD: Controle estrito de acessos (roles), auditoria, logs, criptografia e total conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de segurança lógica.

    Consultoria Técnica e Cooperação Institucional

    • Integração com Equipes de TI: Suporte técnico para as áreas de Planejamento de TI, Gestão de Mudanças, Qualidade de Software e Testes no que tange às bases corporativas.
    • Documentação e Pesquisa: Elaboração de artigos de melhores práticas, prospecção e especificação técnica de novas soluções de infraestrutura e interface direta com fornecedores/fabricantes via chamados.
  • ESCOLARIDADE
  • Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação (TI).
  • EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL
  • Comprovar, através de registros na Carteira de Trabalho e Previdência Social ou de declaração de instituição pública ou privada onde já tenha trabalhado, possuir experiência mínima de 05 (cinco) anos na especialidade citada, em ambientes corporativos críticos e com alta disponibilidade.
  • CERTIFICAÇÕES/CURSOS/TREINAMENTOS

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Incident Commander
jobs.excerpt: Position DescriptionValiant Solutions is seeking a Cybersecurity Incident Commander to join our rapidly growing and innovative team!
jobs.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Cybersecurity Incident Commander to join our rapidly growing and innovative team!

The Cybersecurity Incident Commander will direct and manage multiple work streams and resources during/after Incident Response & Recovery engagements. You will be tasked with incident response coordination and project management in a matrixed triage environment, forensic imaging and analysis, breach containment, and infrastructure recovery planning and execution, after-action reporting, and analysis. This role will often interface with multiple groups, including external agency IR functions, third-party contracting companies, external law firms, etc.), internal direct contract and third-party resources, and customer resources (C-Suite, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Security, Cybersecurity, Auditing, Operations, IT, Call Centers, Communications, Public Relations). Additionally, the Incident Commander will collaborate with Security Operations and Security Engineering practice leaders to evaluate the direction of our offerings, establish ongoing relationships with third parties and clients, and work closely with stakeholders to understand business objectives and advise on security risks/mitigation strategies during incident response work.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Clearance Requirements: Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience within the incident response, cybersecurity, and/or IT risk management arena
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, or related degree or an additional three (3) years of relevant experience.
  • Leadership experience and high level of confidence with incident response management, i.e., technical recovery, legal or compliance notifications, incident response plan development, forensic investigation, and tabletop testing - required
  • Advisory experience in compliance or regulatory frameworks (i.e., FISMA, PCI, GDPR, NIST, ISO)
  • Experience owning the critical process steps with incident response: detection, validation, containment, remediation, and communication – for computer-based security events and incidents such as malware infections, potential compromise, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS), etc.
  • Experience driving the strategy for Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) and overseeing the effectiveness of the technology and process. Involves appropriate tuning, correlation of critical logs, connection to our incident response process, and reporting of relevant metrics.
  • Experience responding to critical security incidents and leading escalation teams to close with response, containment, and remediation.
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and promoting a set of security operation playbooks with Agilent’s IT teams to effectively trigger and execute the security incident response process.
  • Experience managing the current state of logging and monitoring while maintaining a vision of the ideal state and driving a prioritized roadmap to reduce the gaps.
  • Experience acting as an Information Security & Risk consultant to various IT and business-driven projects and operations.
  • Solid understanding of the application, database, authentication, and network security principles; able to demonstrate how network services and protocols interact to provide communications, evidence recovery techniques, log data analytics, Incident categories, IR event handling methodologies, intrusion detection systems, network protocol, and packet analysis
  • Understanding of system and application security, systems and network administration, and operating system hardening techniques
  • General cyber-attack stages, profiling techniques, and techniques for detecting host and network-based intrusions
  • Evidence recovery techniques, Preservation of evidence integrity, and collection of forensically sound collection images, logs, and other critical components to discern possible mitigation/remediation of systems
  • Ability to perform or direct malware analysis, Threat Hunting, and incident response
  • Understanding of Computer Network Defense (CND) policies, procedures, and regulations
  • Ability to convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences during crises, i.e., executive or board-level presentations
  • Ability to work with senior business leaders to understand business objectives/functions, identify risk factors, and communicate effective mitigation strategies
  • Excellent organizational, verbal, presentation/facilitation, and written communication skills
  • All candidates must have US work authorization and the ability to pass a federal background check and credit check.

Preferred, not required:

  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications
  • PMP
  • At least 8 years of directly related experience in Information Security Threat Management.
  • Process management experience with incident response and SIEM.
  • Experience with and confidence to develop and socialize security operations playbooks across infrastructure and applications teams in IT.
  • Prior experience with Law Enforcement, Forensic / Incident Response Firms, Cyber Insurance providers, Breach Coaches and/or Law Firms

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in a rotating on-call; rotation is based on the number of team members.
  • Serve as the incident response event point person and liaison to enterprise teams, responding to crisis or urgent situations aimed at mitigating, preparing for, responding to, and recovery systems. Will also coordinate resources, activities, and timelines during security incidents to ensure a unified structured response to incidents (I.e., data breaches, ransomware events, etc.)
  • Work under the direction of the Security Operations lead aimed at mitigating, preparing for, responding to, and recovering systems from cyber threats/incidents.
  • Conduct initial incident triage, assess the effectiveness of various tactics/strategies, and make rapid decisions on appropriate courses of action.
  • Supports/develops reports during and after incidents, which include all actions taken to properly mitigate, recover, and return operations to normal operations
  • Review and recommend technical, process, and physical controls to counteract damage from breach events.
  • Lead forensic investigators and application security analysts in reactive and proactive Threat-hunting engagements, performing endpoint, network, and log analysis.
  • Mentor and grow junior resources to develop additional forensic, response, and threat-hunting capabilities

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $170,000 to $189,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

We are a consumer protection law firm located in the Financial District of New York City, providing representation to consumers who have been harassed or otherwise deceived by creditors and debt collectors. With our growing firm, we offer you the opportunity to develop your career in a practice that is rich in variety and challenges. If you desire to work with other talented people who share a passion for professionalism and growth, then a career with us may be a perfect fit for you!

Associate Attorney

We are looking for a full-time Associate Attorney to join our firm's practice in Michigan. The ideal candidate is one who has experience drafting legal documents such as pleadings and legal memoranda, has strong organizational skills, and is willing to take on a heavy workload. This position imparts broad responsibilities and exposes you to a range of legal issues related to consumer protection, including transactional and civil litigation matters. Because our firm’s headquarters are in New York, this position entails communicating with our main office exclusively via telephone and electronic means (e-mail, Microsoft Teams, etc.).

Candidates must be located in or within a commutable distance to Metro Detroit, MI to be considered for this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintaining and supervising a heavy & diversified caseload of the Firm’s clients in Michigan.
  • Communicating with clients regarding their respective matters.
  • Drafting pleadings, motions, legal memoranda, reviewing & drafting agreements, etc.
  • Communicating with opposing parties to resolve/settle claims.
  • Legal research related to simple and complex issues in contract law and other areas of consumer law.
  • While this role is based from home, you will be required to travel for in court appearances.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Must be currently admitted to practice law in Michigan
  • Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience at a law firm
  • Must possess superior organizational & time-management skills to meet strict deadlines
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Highest ethical standards and professional integrity
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work easily with senior management and employees at all levels throughout the organization
  • Strong legal research skills -- proficiency in LexisNexis is a plus

Benefits

  • Compensation is competitive and commensurate with expertise and previous experience
  • Training & Guidance

  • 401K Benefits with Employer Match
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • An incredible team of smart and supportive people!

Good knowledge of CDISC SDTM and ADaM implementation guidelines; producing, reviewing and updating complex data specifications; creating and debugging complex macros; understanding Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs) and output shells for day to day programming activities. Excellent team work ethos, willingness to help others and learn new skills from working in a team environment.

· Program and validate datasets and SDTMs, including complex efficacy, labs, etc.
· Program complex non efficacy outputs/ figures
· Perform Senior Review and Deliver QC of non- statistical output

· Develop and debug complex macros

  • Become involved in developing the standard macro library and take responsibility to implement standard macros within a study
    · Create, QC and update complex dataset specifications (including efficacy) for single/ multiple studies, ISS/ISEs, etc
    · Review more complex study design SAP without supervision
    · Review all shells without supervision and provide feedback
    · Knowledge, interpretation and implementation of current SDTM, ADAM standards
    · Knowledge of FDA CRT requirements including define.xml and define.pdf

    · Become familiar with and follow study documentation
    · Lead a team for furthering programming development
    · Ensure the principles in the PHASTAR checklist are followed rigorously
    · Archive study documentation following instructions in supplied SOPs
    · Act as a Lead programmer on multiple studies under same project, ensuring quality and timely delivery
    · Liaise with Study Statistician and Project Manager regarding resourcing and deliverables
    · Responsible for study level resources
    · Attend and input to company resourcing meeting
    · Point of contact for programming issues for the team, proactively ensuring everything is working cohesively
    · Persuade stakeholders to follow best practice within a trial
    · Develop and deliver company-wide training as and when required
    · Create, review and update processes and SOPs
    · Take responsibility for study compliance with SOPs and processes

Qualifications

  • Educated to BSc or above within Computer Science, Mathematics or a Science related discipline
    · SAS Programming Experience within the pharmaceutical industry
    · SAS Programming Experience within the pharmaceutical industry
    · Good awareness of clinical trial issues, design, and implementation.
    · Familiarity with GCP and regulatory requirements
    · Experience of programming to SDTM and ADaM standards

LocationAs an Analytics Engineer, you will join the Business Intelligence team within Business Systems Engineering, a group of several teams that builds and runs the systems the company operates on. This role is based remotely in Mexico or Colombia as a full-time employee or in other LATAM locations as a contractor, with working hours that overlap meaningfully with US time zones.
Who We AreDoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation. We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production.
Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multicloud problems and drive efficiency.
With decades of multicloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity

Our governed data platform is a core part of how DoiT operates, with hundreds of Do’ers relying on it every month. We are growing the team that builds and runs it, and we’re looking for an Analytics Engineer to help carry it forward.
You will work as an engineer on the data platform, not just a builder of reports. You are the kind of person who is averse to doing the same manual task twice, who treats data models like production code, and who instinctively adds tests and monitoring so problems are caught before anyone else sees them. You will own a meaningful share of the platform’s day-to-day engineering, which lets our analysts stay focused on analysis and lets our larger platform initiatives get the sustained attention they need.
This is a high-ownership role with real room to grow. You will work closely with our BI analysts and engineers and with partners across the business, reporting to the Head of Business Intelligence.

Responsibilities

  • Shared ownership of the platform's engineering: routine model changes, the engineering backlog, new data source onboarding from raw ingestion to certified datasets, CI/CD maintenance, and infrastructure operations. This is a full-ownership role, not a narrow lane.
  • Build, test, and maintain data models and pipelines that power dashboards, finance and investor reporting, and our AI analytics layer, across 15+ business domains including Finance, Sales, Customer Experience, Marketing, Product, and HR.
  • Manage data infrastructure as code. Provision and configure BigQuery datasets, views, GCS buckets, and IAM permissions through Terraform. This includes onboarding ingestion destinations, managing access controls, and handling schema drift on source tables.
  • Own data access and governance. Own and continue expanding our RBAC implementation — extend the access control framework as new domains and consumers come online, keep data catalog metadata (tier, domain, owner, PII tags) current, and keep documentation up to date.
  • Improve platform reliability by strengthening testing standards, observability, and alerting, so issues are caught early rather than reported by users.
  • Support orchestration and scheduling. Understand how Airflow DAGs run dbt builds (daily, hourly, monthly), tag models so they land in the right schedule, and troubleshoot build failures in Cloud Composer.
  • Build and maintain custom data connectors. When a SaaS source isn't covered by a native Fivetran connector, write and maintain Python-based Fivetran SDK connectors — including pagination, rate limiting, error handling, and automated tests.
  • Partner with BI analysts to turn ambiguous questions into well-modeled, trustworthy datasets, and help raise the team's engineering practices through code review and shared standards.
  • Use modern AI tooling to draft code and accelerate routine work, amplifying your output rather than adding manual effort.

Qualifications

  • Analytics engineering experience. 3–5 years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI engineering, with a track record of delivering data models that other people depend on.
  • Strong SQL and data modeling. You write, read, and optimize complex analytical queries, reason about grain and joins, and design clean, layered models with sound judgment about where logic belongs (staging, business logic, consumption layer).
  • dbt / Data transformation proficiency. You've built and maintained dbt projects professionally — packages, macros, incremental strategies, snapshots, seeds, and CI/CD. You've implemented staging → intermediate → mart patterns and understand deferred builds, state comparison, and slim CI.
  • Software engineering discipline. Version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD, with the habit of making changes safe to ship. You have a strong drive to automate repetitive manual work.
  • Pipeline reliability instincts. You debug data issues to their root cause, and you think about freshness, volume, duplicates, and late-arriving data before they become incidents.
  • Business translation. You translate business needs into data requirements, work with non-technical stakeholders (including Finance), and push back constructively when a request is better solved a different way.
  • Multi-repo comfort. Our data platform spans several repositories (transformation, data infrastructure, orchestration, custom connectors, foundational cloud resources). You're comfortable navigating across these boundaries rather than treating dbt as the whole world.
  • AI-assisted development. Proven track record of using AI coding tools in your daily workflow.
  • Remote ownership. Independence in a remote, global team, with clear written communication and the discipline to document your work.
  • Fluent English. Both written and spoken; knowledge of any other language is an advantage.

Bonus Points

  • Our stack. Hands-on experience with Google BigQuery, Fivetran, and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer); or an AWS/Azure equivalent.
  • Data catalog and governance tooling. Experience with a data catalog (for example OpenMetadata) or data observability tooling (for example Elementary).
  • Git-based CI/CD for data. Experience with CI/CD workflows for data projects — branch-based deployments, slim CI, Docker image builds, and automated plan/apply cycles.
  • Terraform for data infrastructure. You've provisioned BigQuery datasets, IAM bindings, or GCS buckets with Terraform.
  • Python for data integration. You've written Python that talks to REST APIs — pagination, rate limiting, error handling.
  • dbt build lifecycle fluency. You understand how dbt compiles Jinja into SQL, how run/test/snapshot phases chain together, and you've written macros beyond basic ref() and source().
  • BigQuery performance tuning. Experience with partitioning, clustering, incremental strategies, and reasoning about slot consumption and query costs for large datasets.
  • Docker and Kubernetes. Our dbt builds run in containers on GKE. Experience with Docker images and basic Kubernetes concepts (pods, logs, deployments) helps when debugging pipeline issues.
  • Pre-commit hooks and code quality automation. Experience with SQLFluff, pre-commit frameworks, or custom validation scripts.
  • SaaS source system familiarity. Prior experience modeling data from CRM, support, project management, marketing automation, or ERP platforms.
Are you a Do’er?Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.
We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Find your next move at JLL and build a fulfilling career 

At JLL, we value what makes you unique, and we’re committed to give you the opportunity, knowledge and tools to own your success. Explore opportunities to advance your career from within, whether you’re looking to move up, broaden your experience or deepen your expertise.


About JLL

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 91,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers, and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces, and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.


If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!


Senior Threat Intelligence Analyst - Remote

This individual-contributor role sits on JLL's Threat Intelligence Program, working across the full intelligence cycle in close partnership with Cyber Defense, engineering, and business leaders. The role requires ownership: you will take problems from ambiguous starting point to briefed conclusion, and you'll be trusted and expected to operate that way. It demands both technical depth and strategic sense, and the judgment to know which the moment calls for.


We view threat intelligence as, at its core, rigorous analytic tradecraft, the discipline of reasoning under uncertainty, quickly and always in service of a stakeholder. We are an actionable support system, and our job is to drive the efficient allocation of resources against the threats that are relevant and timely to JLL. That demands the full range of analytic discipline, source vetting, calibrated confidence, and clear reasoning among them so that what we hand a stakeholder is a defensible assessment, not a repeated claim.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Operate across all phases of the intelligence cycle, from requirements through dissemination, exercising sound judgment on scope and priority as new threats emerge.
  • Take loosely scoped questions and add the bounds yourself, frame the problem, define what "answered" looks like, and drive it to a conclusion that serves a real stakeholder, not just closes the request.
  • Produce intelligence calibrated to its audience, from engineers to executives, with a clear read on who the customer is and what decision they need to make.
  • Partner with Cyber Defense and engineering as a technical peer to translate intelligence into mitigation and detection strategies.
  • Help guide our intel-architecture requirements, working with engineers to shape the tooling, automation, and data flows that support the team, without needing to be the engineer yourself.
  • Help shape and evolve our Priority Intelligence Requirements and Collection Requirements as the threat landscape shifts.
  • Prepare and deliver briefings, after-action reports, and program metrics to technical and executive audiences.

What an ideal candidate offers

  • 5+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 3 in a dedicated threat intelligence role.
  • Meaningful experience working in, on, or alongside operational security teams such as threat hunt, SOC/IR, or detection engineering, either supporting them in an intelligence capacity or handling and applying intelligence directly while serving in one of those roles.
  • A demonstrated ability to bring structure to ambiguous problems and drive them to a customer-focused resolution.
  • A working command of AI in an analytic context: its strengths, its failure modes, and how to codify analyst judgment and discipline into repeatable tooling and workflows.
  • An understanding of the adversary ecosystem, how different threat groups are structured and how they interplay, and of adversary tradecraft: how campaigns are executed, and where along the attack chain defenders have opportunities to act.
  • Grounding in intelligence discipline: how to gauge source fidelity, how to determine relevance and actionability, what timeliness means, and how to ingest and interpret intel reporting from different vendors and sources.
  • Excellent briefing skills, in person and virtual, tailored to audiences of varying technical depth.
  • Working knowledge of EDR, SIEM, TIP, IPS, and WAF, with experience building intelligence automation into tooling.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, and CIS.

Hear directly from our teammates at AIT Worldwide Logistics and make us the next stop on your career journey.

Overview

The Business Systems Analyst will support all areas of IT by understanding the diverse business need and product offerings, as well as the technology systems that support our business. This position will primarily focus on our customers’ business needs and offer products and/or solutions to meet those needs.

Responsibilities

  • Working with customers and/or business stakeholders to accurately capture business requirements for new projects and customer onboarding
  • Work with IT team members to review and clarify requirements as needed and act as the liaison between business project stakeholders and IT
  • Responsible for technical documentation of system components and processes

  • Manages and monitors existing functionalities and defines new functionality as needed for application integrity
  • Interfaces with internal and external technical staff to define application solutions and resolve problems as needed
  • Manage incident workflow from initial reporting to final resolution including incident handoffs with outsourced 3rd party organizations
  • Collaborate with IT to develop detailed project specifications
  • Conduct testing and deliver training related material for new customer IT enhancements
  • Contribute to a knowledge base of known problems and resolutions for customers and sales to resolve problems on their own
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

  • A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value
  • A strong work ethic with an appreciation for ownership, independence, accountability, and autonomy in your role
  • Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently
  • Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture

Other Skills We Hope to See:

  • Minimum 5 years related work experience and / or training
  • Ability to effectively present and promote technology and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, and co-workers
  • Work with customers to resolve their business problems or inefficiencies using technology and business process
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form
  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists

What AIT Can Offer You

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.

About AIT Worldwide

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods.
