jobs.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Solutions and Tool Specialist – Functional Safety

About the Role

Safety-critical semiconductor products are growing across every market ADI serves. The Functional Safety Office (FSO) is a global team responsible for independent safety confirmation at the highest integrity levels per ISO 26262, and the tooling and infrastructure that supports that work needs to scale with the portfolio.

This role puts you at the center of that challenge. You will build reusable analysis infrastructure — starting with Medini Analyze component libraries — support the development of training content, and work across multiple product families and design types rather than being embedded in a single program. You will gain broad cross-portfolio exposure to how safety-critical semiconductor products are developed.

This role offers a structured path into functional safety — with mentoring from experienced Safety Specialists, progressive project exposure, and the opportunity to build the tooling infrastructure that shapes how safety engineering scales across ADI. You are not expected to arrive as a functional safety expert. You are expected to arrive as an engineer with a solid foundation in semiconductor product development or quality engineering who wants to build tools, tool interfaces, reusable assets and workflows that improve engineering execution.

Why This Team

The FSO operates as ADI's independent safety authority, working across business units and product families rather than within a single design group. The team is global and high-impact — the tooling and methods you help build here will be used across every safety-critical product ADI ships. You will gain exposure to a breadth of product architectures and safety challenges that few individual contributor roles in the industry offer.

Job Responsibilities:

Support, develop and maintain reusable component libraries in Medini Analyze for safety analysis (FMEDA, FTA, dependent failure analysis) across ADI product families, working alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists to ensure technical accuracy and standards compliance.

Work with the FSO team and BU teams to standardize analysis templates and modeling patterns, and translate product-family-specific safety architectures into reusable, parameterized components that improve consistency and reduce setup time for new assessments.

Support the development of role-based training content for common safety activities including FMEDA execution, safety case construction, and safety requirements writing.

Engage with tool vendors such as Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) on capability evaluation, feature requests, and user community activities.

Develop functional safety domain expertise through structured mentoring and progressive project exposure, contributing to confirmation reviews and safety assessments as competence develops.

Who You Will Work With:

Day-to-day: You will work alongside the FSO's Safety Specialists around the world, who provide technical direction and mentoring on safety analysis and Medini.

Across the FSO: You will collaborate with Functional Safety Managers and Safety Specialists globally to understand where enablement assets have the highest impact.

Engineering teams: You will work with Design Engineers across business units who are the consumers of the tools, templates, and training content you help build.

Tool vendors: You will participate in vendor engagements with Synopsys-Ansys (Medini Analyze) and others on tool capabilities and integration.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in semiconductor design engineering, quality engineering, systems engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Solid understanding of semiconductor product development processes and lifecycle.
  • Experience with structured analytical methods used in product development such as FMEA, design verification, characterization, simulation, or reliability analysis.
  • Experience building reusable technical assets such as component libraries, parameterized templates, structured analysis workflows, or design tools.
  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate complex methods into clear, usable guidance for engineering teams.
  • Self-directed work style suited to a globally distributed team spanning multiple countries and time zones.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 10%, primarily to ADI sites in Europe and the US.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with safety analysis methods specifically (FMEA, FMEDA, FTA) including failure mode identification and classification.
  • Experience with Synopsys-Ansys Medini Analyze or comparable safety analysis tools (Isograph, ReliaSoft, APIS IQ, Safety Office).
  • Familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508) at a conceptual level. Direct certification is not required.
  • Experience developing training content, structured knowledge management systems, or technical curricula.
  • Familiarity with automotive quality standards such as IATF 16949 or development process standards such as ASPICE.

Functional safety is one of the fastest-growing disciplines in semiconductor engineering, and this role gives you a structured way in — with mentoring, real project exposure, and the chance to build infrastructure that engineering teams across ADI rely on. If you've been looking for a role with more cross-portfolio visibility and a longer lever than single-program work, we'd like to hear from you.

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. jobs.excerpt: Who We Are: Brilliant is looking for a full-time Account Director to join our fast-moving, award-winning agency.
jobs.description:
Who We Are:
Brilliant is looking for a full-time Account Director to join our fast-moving, award-winning agency. We’re a fully remote performance team built on a simple promise: Work Hard. Play Hard. Laugh Hard.

We aren't for the faint of heart! We move fast, hold a ridiculously high bar for excellence, and thrive on driving real ROI for our clients. But we also believe that intense drive should come with great culture—which is why we offer unlimited PTO, Fabulous Fridays (doors close at 3pm), virtual happy hours, a monthly book club, and endless reasons to win together.

And the industry notices: We were recently named an Inc. Best Workplace 2026 and landed on the Inc. 5000 List of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for 2026!

What We Do:

Since 2008, Brilliant has been where bold ideas meet relentless execution. We're a performance marketing agency with deep expertise in family-focused brands, bringing together PR, Influencer, Social, Paid Media, Affiliate, Retail Support, Experiential, and AI Intelligence to create integrated, full-funnel campaigns that shatter targets and cut through the noise.

Our Dream Team Member:

  • A strategic thinker who sees the whole board, not just the next deadline
  • Trusted by clients, and the first call when something matters
  • A creative who can start from a blank page and come back with an idea nobody expected
  • A steady leader who develops people instead of just assigning them work
  • Comfortable across disciplines, and fluent enough in influencer, paid and affiliate to build a real integrated plan
  • A real media person with relationships worth something and a pitch that lands
  • Commercially minded about scopes, budgets and where the growth is
  • Curious about new tools, AI, and technology, and quick to try them to make work faster and better
  • Calm under pressure and direct when something needs to be said
  • Passionate about staying ahead of trends in the CPG and F&B space

Position Overview:

The Account Director leads integrated programs for the agency's largest clients, owning strategy, creative direction and the client relationship from planning through delivery. The role sits above the account supervisor level and reports into earned media leadership. It spans strategic counsel, creative campaign development, team leadership, and cross-department coordination across PR, influencer, affiliate, paid and events. We're looking for someone who leads rather than supports, and who is excited to use new tools, including AI, to work smarter.

What You'll Do:

Client Leadership:

  • Serve as the senior day-to-day contact on the agency's largest integrated accounts
  • Provide ongoing, consistent strategic counsel that builds client trust
  • Present recommendations, plans and results to client leadership
  • Own the health of the account, including scope, budget and renewal conversations alongside agency leadership

Strategy & Creative:

  • Develop and implement public relations strategies aligned to client business goals
  • Build campaigns from a blank page: product launches, brand moments, media and influencer events, creative mailers
  • Bring fresh angles and trend-jacking opportunities to the table before clients ask for them
  • Partner with the influencer, paid, social and affiliate teams to build plans that work together rather than in parallel

Media Relations:

  • Own the earned media strategy on your accounts: the story angles, the target outlets, and the pitching calendar
  • Personally pitch and secure top-tier national coverage. This is a hands-on role, not an oversight role.
  • Build and maintain real relationships with editors, producers, freelancers and influencers in the consumer and family space
  • Direct media list development and quality control the team's pitches before they go out
  • Coach junior staff on pitch writing, follow-up, and building their own media relationships
  • Lead media training and briefing document development for client spokespeople and experts
  • Monitor daily trends and competitor coverage, and turn them into fast trend-jacking opportunities
  • Know when a story is worth chasing and when it isn't, and spend the team's hours accordingly

Awards:

  • Oversee client media awards programs and set the submission strategy

Team Leadership:

  • Supervise and mentor team members at all levels
  • Delegate meaningful work and give constructive, timely feedback
  • Foster a collaborative and productive remote work environment

Project Management:

  • Own campaign and account timelines from kickoff through delivery across multiple workstreams
  • Track deliverables, budgets, staffing and team responsibilities
  • Responsible for quality control and on-time delivery of the team's work
  • Flag risks and staffing gaps before they become problems

Technology & AI:

  • Actively use AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, and similar) to support research, drafting, monitoring and reporting
  • Test and adopt new software and platforms, and share what works with the team
  • Stay current on how search and AI are changing brand discovery, and bring that thinking into client plans

New Business:

  • Contribute strategy and creative thinking to new business pitches
  • Help build and present pitch materials
  • Identify organic growth opportunities within existing accounts

Events / Activations:

  • Lead virtual or live media and influencer events, creative media mailers, and more
  • Develop decks and lead client presentations

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field
  • 8+ years of agency experience in the consumer, lifestyle or CPG space
  • Demonstrated experience as a day-to-day client lead, not solely a contributor
  • Experience managing and developing people
  • Working knowledge across at least a few of: earned media, influencer, affiliate, paid media, events
  • Strong, current media relationships and a portfolio of top-tier placements you secured yourself
  • Hands-on experience writing pitches and press materials that get picked up, not just reviewing someone else's
  • Fluency with media databases and monitoring tools such as MuckRack, Cision or Qwoted
  • Comfortable using AI tools day to day, with examples of how you've used them
  • A real willingness to try new technologies and adopt new tools quickly
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • A proactive, self-starter attitude with a passion for staying ahead of trends
  • Preferred: affiliate platform experience (LTK, ShopMy, Impact) and experience in baby, parenting, toys or wellness categories

Benefits:

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid time off between Christmas and New Year's
  • Fabulous Fridays, the office closes at 3 pm!
  • 401K with a 3% company match, after your initial 3 months
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Medical and Dependent Care FSA
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Company-paid Long Term Disability

SALARY:

$95,000 - $110,000

This role includes a six-month performance review. Employees who meet all agreed-upon goals are eligible for a $5,000 base salary increase.

jobs.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?


  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer, you will build AI-assisted platforms for manufacturing tests and debug automation software with direct, real-world consequences on the factory floor.
  • You will own end-to-end features across event-driven platforms, from cloud infrastructure and backend microservices, up through an agentic LLM pipeline, out to a modern web frontend.
  • LLMs are a core building block of what we build, and AI coding agents are a core part of how we build it but we treat them as power tools operated by strong engineers, not autopilots.
  • This role requires someone who can define work with precision, critically evaluate agent-generated output, and write code themselves when needed.
  • As the Python & Java Full Stack Developer (AI-Capabilities), you are equally comfortable writing a Python Lambda handler, designing an agent tool, building a Java microservice, defining infrastructure as code, tuning a message-bus consumer, and building an Angular component with an AI agent working alongside you.

How We Work with AI


  • We use AI coding agents Claude, Kiro, and similar agentic IDEs/CLIs (we use Kiro) but as power tools in the hands of engineers who could do the work without them.
  • We are seeking a passionate developer who has experienced building without AI, understands its capabilities and limitations, and knows when to rely on AI versus writing code themselves.
  • The challenge isn’t generating code. It’s defining requirements precisely and rigorously validating the output.

Engineering Fundamentals

  • You can read, debug, and correct generated code as readily as you can produce it, and you can justify an architectural decision independent of what any tool suggested.

Spec-Driven Development

  • Decompose features into clear requirements, design, and task breakdowns that both humans and agents execute against, treating the spec as the source of truth and iterating on it.

Skills and Powers

  • Author and use reusable agent capabilities (skills, steering docs, custom tools/MCP integrations, project conventions) to encode team standards and make agents productive in a large codebase.

Prompt and Context Engineering

  • Give agents the right context (conventions, contracts, constraints) and validate their output rather than trusting it blindly.

Correctness Discipline

  • Pair agent velocity with strong testing, review, and observability so fast-moving changes stay safe in production.

What will you do?


  • Design, build, and ship feature end-to-end across the full stack AWS infrastructure, Python and Java backend services, agentic LLM workflows, and the Angular frontend for a system serving manufacturing across multiple sites.
  • Build and evolve agentic AI workflows on Amazon Bedrock.

(LLM reasoning + embeddings):

    • tool/function calling, RAG,
    • prompts,
    • validation loops, and
    • fallback strategies that stay correct and observable under production load
  • Own backend services across two ecosystems
    • Python serverless (Lambda, event-driven) and
    • Java microservices (Spring Boot/Quarkus) with REST and event-driven APIs, persistence, async pipelines, and message-bus integrations
    • Care for idempotency, retries, and dead-letter handling throughout
  • Define and evolve infrastructure as code (AWS CDK) across multi-stack deployments with cross-stack references.
  • Treat published API surfaces as backwards-compatibility contracts, using shared interface/schema libraries consumed across services and clients.
  • Develop retrieval and scoring logic:
    • log chunking, embeddings, vector/semantic search in OpenSearch, and relevance ranking
  • Instrument with CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, tracing, structured diagnostic events and own CI/CD on Azure DevOps with gated, reversible rollouts.
  • Contribute to shared foundational code with wide blast radius, keeping changes narrow and well-tested.

How will you get here?


Python

  • Modern typing, async patterns, data validation (e.g., Pydantic), clean error handling, and a codebase-scale sense of structure.

Backend Engineering in Java

  • Deep experience with Spring Boot and/or Quarkus, clean architecture, and idiomatic use of the type system.
  • Production AWS serverless and cloud experience across the stack:

Compute

  • Lambda
  • ECS Fargate

Data & Messaging

  • DynamoDB
  • S3
  • SQS
  • OpenSearch

Networking

  • VPC
  • VPC Endpoints
  • API Gateway (Private)

Eventing & Scheduling

  • EventBridge

Security & Identity

  • IAM
  • IAM Roles Anywhere (trust anchor, cross-environment access)

AI

  • Amazon Bedrock

Ops & Config

  • CloudWatch (alarms + dashboards)
  • SSM Parameter Store
  • ECR assets

Persistence Expertise

  • JPA / Hibernate
  • JDBC
  • transaction management
  • NoSQL data modeling (DynamoDB access patterns),
  • and relational database design, management, and query optimization

API Design

  • Production REST services; comfortable with versioning and backwards-compatibility.

Modern Concurrency

  • Java virtual threads (Project Loom) and reasoning clearly about concurrency correctness.

Microservices & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Designing and operating microservices with a message bus (NATS.io, Kafka, SQS, or similar), including idempotency, retries, and failure handling.

Hands-on LLM/agent Development

  • Building applications with LLMs (function calling, prompt design, RAG, embeddings) and evaluating output quality. You understand that specifying and validating agent behavior is the hard part.

AI-assisted development Practice

  • Daily, judicious use of AI coding agents (Claude, Kiro, etc.), spec-driven workflows, and reusable agent skills/powers, paired with the fundamentals to review their output critically.

Frontend Development in Angular

  • Building and maintaining a modern web UI (Angular/TypeScript) that consumes these APIs.

Testing Discipline

  • Unit, integration, and mocking as a first-class part of shipping.

Containerization & Orchestration

  • Docker and Docker Swarm
  • Kubernetes

Cloud-Native Workflow

  • Git
  • Azure DevOps pipelines
  • and code review in a sizable multi-repo codebase

Deployment Strategies

  • Blue/green, canary, gated rollout, and rollback

Observability, Security & Analytics

  • Structured logging, tracing, metrics; secure coding and auth fundamentals; and building/consuming analytics on operational data.

Education:

  • BS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field
  • MS preferred

Experience:

  • 10+ years’ experience in a software development capacity with enterprise server, storage or networking products.

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical, Dental, Prescription Drug, and Vision Insurance with HRA and HSA options
  • 401K Match
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Paid Time Off

  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Annual Merit Increases
  • Community Volunteer Opportunities
The pay range for this role is $100,100 - $180,200. Job-related, non-discriminatory factors used to determine the actual offered rate include qualifications and experience, geographic location, education, external market data, and consideration of internal equity. The anticipated close date of this job requisition is: October 25, 2026.As part of the total rewards package, this position is eligible for a short-term incentive based on performance. In addition, Jabil offers benefits to enhance your health, wealth, and resilient self. jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

    • Openness to learn the required technologies.
    • An interest in development, new technologies and innovation.
    • Supporting development teams into the refactoring of technical debt.

At Partnerize, we recognise it is unrealistic for a candidate to fulfil 100% of the criteria in this job description. We encourage you to apply if you feel you meet the majority of the requirements above. We know that skills evolve over time, so if you have a keen appetite to learn and evolve alongside us over time, come join our team!

US Benefits & Perks

  • Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need
  • Enhanced parental leave (16 weeks for birth parent, 8 weeks for non-birth parent at full pay)
  • Regular company events and activities
  • Robust Company Sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits
  • 401k Plan – 4% employee match
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Fridays program

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

1.20.Participates in cross-functional teams to develop new/enhanced systems/processes/programs/policies to support business needs.

1.21.Performs other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

2.1.2.Develops policies, guidelines, and implementing procedures and ensures consistent company-wide implementation.

2.1.3.Develops budgetary plans, programs, and guidelines to ensure the team’s strict adherence with financial guidelines and requirements.

2.1.4.Ensures that operating expenses are well within the prescribed limits of budget plans and fiscal guidelines.

2.2.Organizing

2.2.2.Delineates, defines, and streamlines its variousfunctional activities, thereby ensure its effectiveness in maximizing the utilization of both asset and people resources.

2.3.1.1.In collaboration with Human Resources Department and Health Plan Administrator, conducts in-depth assessment interviews to determine the technical and behavioral competencies of the candidate to ensure that the best from among the qualified candidates are being hired in the company.

2.3.1.2.Adheres to, and implements the philosophy of “hiring the best fit” and ensures that prospective employees’ personal values are aligned with the company’s corporate values.

2.3.2.Conducts regular and periodic meetings with the team, to ensurethe following:

2.3.2.1. Implementation of all Pricing & Underwriting plans, programs, and projects are strictly adhering to prescribed deadlines and schedules.

2.3.2.2.All communications and relevant information pertaining to the team are cascaded to the proper channels within the team in particular, and the organization in general.

2.3.3.Conducts and implements “Performance Improvement Program”, through the following:

2.3.3.1.Performance coaching for the staff who failed to perform and deliver the prescribed and committed level of performance output and standards.

2.3.3.2.Performance counseling staff with behavioral/attitudinal problems. Implements the necessary guidelines on discipline management for erring employees, in accordance with company policies, rules and regulations, due process, and government regulations.

2.3.3.3.Performance mentoring for high potential staff, capable of assuming bigger responsibilities in the future.

2.3.4.Performs training and development functions, as follows:

2.3.4.1.Designs and develops training programs that are relevant and necessary for the continuous development of the technical competencies of the team.

2.3.4.2.Recommends and implements for appropriate training programs that will further enhance and hone the technical competencies of the staff.

2.3.4.3.Conducts training programs, and acts as subject matter expert on training programs pertaining to Pricing & Underwriting Philippine team.

2.4.Controlling

2.4.2.Reviews and evaluates the performance of the team, on regular and periodic basis, and ensures that the overall performance of the team is on-track, and well within the pre-established goals and objectives.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact?

  • We are seeking a highly skilled, technically authoritative and customer-facing Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer within the Intelligent Infrastructure Segment to lead the architecture, integration, and strategic direction of advanced air and liquid-cooled server and network rack solutions for large-scale hyperscale deployments.

  • This role will serve as the senior technical authority responsible for translating customer requirements into scalable, manufacturable, and commercially viable rack systems.

  • As the Sr. Principal Hyperscale Rack Engineer, youwill operate at the intersection of engineering, customer engagement, and program execution – driving end-to-end rack architecture across mechanical, power, thermal, electrical, and software domains.

  • Success in this role requires deep technical expertise, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to lead complex programs while influencing both internal and external stakeholders.

What will you do?

  • Serve as the lead architect and development manager for complex rack-level solutions, owning system-level design decisions across mechanical, electrical, power, thermal, networking, and software integration domains.

  • Lead customer-facing technical engagements from RFI/RFQ all the way to first hardware delivery, including design reviews, trade-off discussions, and executive-level conversations.

  • Translate ambiguous or evolving customer requirements into clear program frameworks, ensuring alignment between customer expectations and engineering execution.

  • Demonstrate strong commercial awareness by effectively managing customer expectations, pushing back when requirements introduce risk or inefficiency, and confidently addressing challenging technical and cost-related questions.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across all departments (executives, engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and program) to ensure cohesive solution development with emphasis on Bill of Materials (BOM) management and scheduling.

  • Own rack-level architecture including power distribution design, thermal strategies (air and liquid cooling), cable routing, serviceability, and manufacturability.

  • Provide deep technical guidance on rack infrastructure including PDUs, busbars, liquid cooling systems (CDUs, manifolds, QDs), airflow design, and high-density compute integration.

  • Oversee architecture decisions impacting performance, cost, scalability, and deployment efficiency.

  • Drive program execution from concept through production, ensuring schedules are clearly defined, tracked, and met.

  • Apply strong program management discipline: define milestones, identify risks early, escalate issues proactively, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to commitments.

  • Drive readiness support calls internally from initial NPI scoping to prototyping to mass production, ensuring all systems are operable together from a power, thermal, and software standpoint.

  • Partner with customers and internal stakeholders to continuously refine designs based on deployment feedback and operational learnings.

  • Collaborate with compliance and certification teams to ensure mechanical designs meet global regulatory requirements (e.g., UL, CE, ISTA, ASTM).

  • Mentor and guide engineers across disciplines, establishing best practices in rack system architecture and integration.

  • Understanding of rack installation constraints, maintenance access, and serviceability in rack mechanical infrastructure.

  • Conduct root cause analysis and corrective actions for mechanical failures or field issues.

  • May perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

How will you get here?

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is required

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in engineering, systems integration, or data center hardware design.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ rack-level (L11) solution design and integration experience.

  • Minimum of 3 years’ switch/server (L10) experience, including compute, storage, or networking hardware integration.

  • Proven ability to drive the development and execution of complex rack solutions for hyperscale or large-scale data center environments, managing 12-18 month lifecycles and portfolios valued at hundreds of millions of dollars.

  • Familiarity with industry standards (EIA, ORV3, OCP) and global power architectures.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with customers in technical and commercially sensitive environments.

  • Strong background in program execution, including schedule ownership, risk management, and cross-functional leadership.

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills – a must.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, integration strategies, and program management.

  • Hands-on experience with prototype fabrication and testing (mechanical S&V, software burn-in and test validation).

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Capable of assessing projects, articulating risks, and developing project milestones.

  • Creative, self-motivated, accountable, and team-oriented.

  • Able to work independently with minimal oversight.

  • Skilled in writing reports, business correspondence, and procedural guides.

  • Effective at presenting information and responding to management, clients, and public queries.

  • Capable of influencing others and sharing best practices.

  • Familiar with stage-gate processes in project lifecycle management (PLM).

  • Able to coach and mentor less experienced engineers.

  • Demonstrated success leading in a highly matrixed environment, driving alignment and execution across cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

  • Ability to travel both domestically and internationally up to 30%.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field is preferred.

  • Extensive experience with liquid-cooled rack deployments in hyperscale or AI/ML infrastructure environments.

  • Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo/Pro-E, Inventor) and FEA software (e.g., ANSYS, Abaqus).

  • Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers (CM) a plus.

  • High level knowledge of fluid dynamics, pressure drop calculations, and pipe sizing for glycol-based systems.

  • Proven experience driving compliance and validation for rack configurations, including regulatory standards, safety requirements, and mechanical integrity (shock, vibration, and transit durability).

About Jabil’s Intelligent Infrastructure Group:

  • Headquartered in Austin, TX, with a flagship facility located near The Domain and the Austin FC stadium

  • Growing rapidly, with a team of more than 100 employees and significant expansion planned through 2026

  • Generated over $12 billion in FY25 revenue, driven largely by partnerships with major hyperscale customers

  • Delivers cutting‑edge engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions that power the world's AI infrastructure and global data center ecosystems

What Can Jabil Offer You?

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

Cayenta, a division of Harris; is seeking a Support Analyst who will help solve problems that matter.


At Cayenta, Support is about solving problems, building knowledge, and continuously improving how we serve our customers. As a Support Analyst, you'll investigate complex application issues, collaborate with teammates across the organization, and use modern tools-including AI-to help deliver accurate, efficient, and thoughtful solutions.


Customer issues can span application functionality, data, integrations, environments, databases, and communications. Every issue is an opportunity to learn something new. We don't expect you to know every answer on day one-we're looking for someone who is curious, analytical, and motivated to figure things out.


When you encounter something unfamiliar, we expect you to investigate. Search our knowledge base. Review documentation. Collaborate with teammates. Use AI to research, analyze, and challenge your thinking. Test assumptions and keep digging until you understand the problem.


Most importantly, when you learn something new, document it and share it. Every solved problem makes our entire team stronger.


This is your opportunity to deepen your expertise in the solutions used by our CIS customers while developing strong technical, analytical, and customer service skills.

Utility industry experience is required for this role.


This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US. Travel is required as needed, approximately 10%. Candidates must hold a current, valid passport and be legally eligible to travel internationally. This includes either passport based visa exemption or possession of any required travel visas for entry into Canada, the United States, and the Caribbean.


Salary:

60K - 75K

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Senior Vulnerability Management Engineer

Job Description
LSEG is seeking a Senior Vulnerability Management Engineerto join our internal offensive security team with focus on driving closure of penetration testing findings.   • Provide consultation to application and platform teams on secure design and remediation approaches, including code-level, configuration-leveland business-level recommendations.

  • Coordinate remediation activities across multiple teams, ensuring, clear ownership, agreed timelines, and risk-based prioritization.

  • Validate fixes by retesting vulnerabilities (manually and/or via tools/scripts) and updating the status of findings through closure.

  • Manage and track the remediation backlog, including SLAs, aging finings, and critical issues when needed.

  • Produce andmaintaindocumentation on remediation processes, workflows, and controls for audit and compliance purposes.

  • Prepare and deliver regular status reports and metrics on remediation progress, trends, and risk reduction to management and partners.

  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring or systemic issues and work with engineering, architecture, and governance teams to implement long-term corrective actions.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of thepentest-to-remediation lifecycle, including automation,standardizationand integration with SDLC/DevSecOpspipelines.

  • Compile technical documents,trackand document remediation metadata

  • Engagement details (who, what, when, where)

  • Testing team members and roles

  • Tools and methodologies used

  • Schedule and timelines

  • Target systems and environments

  • Constraints, exclusions, and limitations

  • Testing activities and event logs

  • Stay ahead of with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security techniques.

  • Participate in R&D initiatives as guided from leadership.

  • Support knowledge sharing and mentoring within the team.

About ComPsych

ComPsych®（コムサイク）社は、メンタルヘルスおよび生活支援サービス「GuidanceResources®」を提供する世界最大の企業です。絶え間ないイノベーションと包括的なケアへの取り組みを原動力に、世界200カ国、1億6,300万人以上の人々にサービスを提供しています。「GuidanceResources®」ブランドのもと、行動衛生（メンタルヘルス）、欠勤管理、ウェルビーイングを網羅した、カスタマイズ可能かつ完全に統合されたプログラムを展開し、従業員がより健康的で生産性の高い生活を送れるよう支援するとともに、組織の卓越性を高めています。フォーチュン500企業の40%がメンタルヘルス対策のパートナーとしてComPsychを選んでいる理由については、compsych.comをご覧ください。

ComPsych® Corporation is the world's largest provider of mental health and GuidanceResources® for life services. Driven by a commitment to constant innovation and a holistic approach to care, ComPsych serves more than 163 million people across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our customized and fully integrated programs span behavioral health, absence management, and well-being; they empower employees to lead healthier, more productive lives while fostering organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to discover why 40% of Fortune 500 companies choose ComPsych to meet their mental health needs.

About the Role

職種は「ガイダンス・コンサルタント」で、日本国内を拠点とするリモートワークのポジションです。雇用形態はフルタイムの有期雇用となります。本職は、臨床における卓越性を追求し、共感を持って対応できるメンタルヘルスの専門家に最適です。また、アクセシビリティ（利用しやすさ）、迅速な対応、そしてクライアント中心のケアが何よりも重視される、変化に富んだ環境で力を発揮できる方を求めています。

ガイダンス・コンサルタントは、電話やチャットを通じてクライアントを直接支援します。行動面の健康（ビヘイビラル・ヘルス）、精神的な健康、家族に関する悩み、そして全体的なウェルネス（心身の健康）に関わる課題に対し、プロフェッショナリズムと深い思いやり、そして適切な臨床的判断力を持って対応します。

世界最大級のEAP（従業員支援プログラム）および行動面での健康管理サービスを提供する企業の一員として、本職は専門性を高める絶好の機会となります。コンサルタントは自身の臨床的専門知識を活かして即座に支援を行い、利用可能なリソースを案内するとともに、迅速かつ適切な紹介（リファーラル）を行うことで、ケアの継続性と良好な成果の実現に貢献します。

The job title is Guidance Consultant and is a remote working role residing in the country of Japan. This is a fixed-term, full-time position. This position is ideal for mental health professionals who prioritize clinical excellence and demonstrate empathy in their approach, and who thrive in a dynamic environment where accessibility, responsiveness, and client-centered care are paramount.

Guidance Consultants provide direct support to clients via telephone and chat; they address issues related to behavioral health, emotional well-being, family concerns, and overall wellness, demonstrating professionalism, compassion, and sound clinical judgment.

Within the world's largest provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs) and behavioral health management services, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for professional development. Consultants leverage their clinical expertise to provide immediate support, guide clients toward available resources, and facilitate prompt and appropriate referrals, thereby ensuring continuity of care and positive outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • 電話やチャットを通じてサポートを提供します。これには、詳細な臨床的アセスメントの実施や、セラピスト、カウンセラー、その他の適切なウェルネス関連リソースへのクライアントの紹介が含まれます。クライアントのアセスメントを行い、コーチングの手法を用いて、前向きな行動変容を促すための個別の健康・ウェルネス戦略を策定します。
  • コンプライアンスの遵守と質の高いサービスの提供を保証するため、部門のプロトコル、業界のベストプラクティス、およびクライアント固有の要件を確実に遵守します。
  • 多様な背景やニーズを持つ個人に対し、文化的配慮と包摂性（インクルーシビティ）を持ち、敬意を払った態度でサービスを提供します。
  • 適切な判断力、批判的思考力、問題解決能力を発揮して状況を評価し、懸念事項を迅速に解決するとともに、適切なサポートの提供を促進し、クライアントの全体的な体験の向上を図ります。

jobs.excerpt: Location, Reporting & TravelThis is a fully remote role within the United States.
jobs.description:
Location, Reporting & Travel

This is a fully remote role within the United States. Periodic travel (approximately 25–30%) will be required to conduct in-person meetings with members, support conferences and member engagement events, and attend internal team gatherings.

Reports to: Senior Director, Member Success, Academic

About Us

E3n is a not-for-profit, member-based organization serving independent schools, educators, students, and families across the full student lifecycle.

Formed through the merger of the former Educational Records Bureau (ERB) and the Enrollment Management Association (EMA), E3n builds on nearly a century of collective expertise in assessment, enrollment, and student development. E3n exists to deepen school impact and advance whole-student growth by uniting academic and enrollment leadership around shared, data-driven insights.

E3n provides comprehensive assessments, professional tools, conferences, and analytics that help independent schools demonstrate their value and support student success from pre-enrollment through graduation—extending beyond academic performance to include student well-being, sense of belonging, and social-emotional development.

About the Opportunity

The Director, Member Success, Academic, plays a key role in supporting E3n member schools and organizations in effectively using the organization's achievement assessments, student well-being tools, data resources, and professional learning offerings.

Working closely with the Senior Director, Member Success (Academic), this role manages relationships with a portfolio of member schools and helps ensure members experience meaningful value from their engagement with E3n. The Director serves as a trusted partner to academic leaders, providing guidance, support, and resources that help schools understand and apply assessment and student well-being data to strengthen teaching, learning, and student outcomes.

The Director collaborates with colleagues across the organization to ensure members receive timely support, successful onboarding experiences, and access to the resources they need to maximize the value of E3n's academic and student well-being tools and services. The role also plays an important part in identifying emerging member needs and sharing insights internally to strengthen E3n's products, services, and overall member experience.

The ideal candidate brings strong relationship management and consultative communication skills and is comfortable partnering directly with heads of school, academic deans, curriculum and instructional leaders, counselors, and other school-based educators. They are confident presenting to professional audiences, facilitating thoughtful conversations around assessment data and instructional improvement, and managing multiple member relationships in a dynamic environment. The successful candidate is motivated by helping schools translate data into meaningful action while serving as a trusted partner who brings member insights back to E3n to inform future products, services, and strategy.

What You’ll Do

Reporting to the Senior Director, Member Success (Academic), the Director is responsible for managing member relationships and supporting the success of schools within their assigned portfolio.

Member Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for a portfolio of member schools.
  • Build and maintain trusted partnerships with heads of school, academic deans, curriculum leaders, division directors, counselors, and instructional leadership teams.
  • Act as a strategic partner, helping schools maximize the value of E3n's products and services.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each member's goals, priorities, and challenges while identifying opportunities to strengthen engagement and long-term partnership.

Member Onboarding & Engagement

  • Support onboarding of new members to ensure successful implementation of E3n's achievement assessments and related products and services..
  • Guide schools through effective use of assessment and student well-being tools, reporting platforms, and professional learning opportunities.
  • Facilitate ongoing engagement through regular member conversations focused on adoption, utilization, and member success.
  • Support opportunities to expand member engagement, including Associate-to-Full membership growth and additional product utilization as appropriate.

Member Support & Consultation

  • Partner with internal teams to respond to member questions and support requests in a timely manner.
  • Help schools interpret assessment results and connect insights to instructional planning and student success.
  • Coordinate with Product, Research, Professional Learning, and Platform teams to resolve member questions and improve the overall experience.
  • Ensure members receive practical guidance and resources that help them confidently leverage E3n's products and services.

Member Experience & Portfolio Insights

  • Monitor engagement across an assigned portfolio and identify opportunities to strengthen member success and retention.
  • Gather feedback from member schools and share insights to improve E3n's products, services, and member experience.
  • Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities across member schools and communicate those insights internally.
  • Maintain accurate records and timely Salesforce records by documenting member interactions, engagement, opportunities, and support activities.
  • Monitor product utilization and proactively identify opportunities to deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with colleagues across Membership, Product, Research, Professional Learning, Growth, and Platform teams to deliver an exceptional member experience.
  • Contribute member insights that inform future products, services, research, and programming.
  • Support broader Member Success initiatives and organizational priorities.
  • Identify opportunities for product expansion or additional member engagement and collaborate with appropriate internal partners to support growth.

Member Engagement Activities

  • Represent E3n through conferences, webinars, workshops, and member-facing events.
  • Facilitate professional learning opportunities and discussions focused on assessment, instructional improvement, and student success.
  • Build relationships with prospective and existing member schools while representing the organization's mission and expertise.

Why Work with Us

At E3n, you’ll join a mission-driven organization formed through the unification of two respected leaders in independent education. We’re building something new—bringing together enrollment and academic perspectives to create deeper insight, stronger institutions, and better outcomes for students from pre-enrollment through graduation.

At E3n, you’ll experience:

  • Purpose with impact. Our work directly supports educators, school leaders, and families nationwide. The decisions we make—and the tools we build—matter.
  • Smart, thoughtful colleagues. You’ll work alongside people who care deeply about education, ask good questions, and value collaboration, clarity, and integrity.
  • Whole-person thinking. Just as we help schools understand the full student journey, we strive to support employees as whole people—recognizing that strong work is sustained by balance, trust, and belonging.
  • Growth during a moment of transformation. E3n is actively evolving. That means opportunities to shape systems, influence direction, and grow alongside an organization defining its future.
  • Values-driven, data-informed. We balance heart and rigor—grounding our work in evidence while staying anchored in empathy, equity, and real-world impact.

If you’re energized by meaningful work, thoughtful problem-solving, and helping schools better serve students, you’ll find a home at E3n.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 9-12+ years of experience in education, academic leadership, assessment, member success, customer success, or relationship management.
  • Experience working with schools, educators, or education-focused organizations.

Preferred Skills & Experiences

  • Experience working within independent or private schools.
  • Experience supporting educators through assessment programs, educational data systems, or instructional improvement initiatives.
  • Background in teaching, curriculum development and planning, academic leadership, or educational assessment.
  • Experience presenting to professional audiences or facilitating workshops for educators and school leaders.
  • Experience in independent school admissions or enrollment management is a plus, particularly for candidates who also bring strong academic, teaching, or instructional leadership experience.

E3n is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming workplace. We believe our work is stronger when people of different backgrounds, identities, and experiences come together.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Mechatronics Sales Lead for B&R Industrial Automation will develop and maintain a highly effective sales channel strategy focused on expanding System Integrators and Mechatronics sales for the Americas Region to improve B&R's market penetration and realize its growth aspirations. The Sales Lead will plan and ensure the execution of the regional sales strategy to achieve both qualitative and quantitative targets for the assigned channels and products in a profitable way, with a focus on orders, revenues, growth, margin, market share, sales productivity, and customer satisfaction. Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

B&R Industrial Automation is a leading developer and manufacturer of control systems for the industrial automation market. The company was founded in 1979 in Eggelsberg, Austria, and specializes in a complete range of innovative Programmable Controllers, Industrial PC's, Operator Interfaces, Servo Drives and Motion Control products. The North American subsidiary, B&R Industrial Automation Corp., was founded in 1987 in Roswell, GA, and is responsible for all North American sales activities, as well as supporting our customers with engineering and technical expertise.

B&R has over 4,000 employees worldwide and more than 200 sales offices in 70 countries. jobs.description:
Overview

Planned Systems International, Inc. (PSI) is seeking a motivated, organized, and results-driven temporary Talent Acquisition Recruiter to join our established internal Corporate Talent Acquisition team to provide surge recruiting support across a diverse portfolio of federal government contracts and corporate positions. This temporary position will assist with high-volume hiring initiatives, proposal staffing efforts, incumbent captures, and critical hiring priorities across multiple business units.

In this role, you will partner closely with Talent Acquisition leadership, recruiters, hiring managers, and program leadership to execute full-cycle recruiting activities while helping ensure the timely delivery of qualified talent for a wide variety of clinical, technical, professional, and corporate positions. You will play a key role in maintaining recruiting momentum during periods of increased hiring demand while delivering an exceptional candidate experience and ensuring compliance with company policies and federal contracting requirements.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced recruiter who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities, and supporting mission-driven programs that directly impact federal agencies, military service members, veterans, and the communities they serve.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle for assigned requisitions, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, coordinating interviews, extending offers, and supporting pre-employment activities.
  • Support surge hiring efforts across multiple federal government contracts and internal corporate positions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition leadership, hiring managers, and program leadership to develop effective recruiting strategies and execute hiring plans.
  • Recruit for clinical, healthcare, technical, engineering, cybersecurity, intelligence, administrative, and professional labor categories supporting federal government customers.
  • Source qualified candidates utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter, iCIMS ATS, job boards, professional networks, referrals, social media, and other sourcing tools.
  • Conduct candidate phone screens to evaluate technical qualifications, experience, compensation expectations, availability, and overall fit.
  • Develop and maintain proactive candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Coordinate candidate interviews while ensuring an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring process.
  • Prepare and extend employment offers while guiding candidates through pre-employment and onboarding activities.
  • Maintain complete and accurate candidate records, recruiting activity, interview feedback, and requisition updates within iCIMS.
  • Ensure timely applicant dispositioning and maintain ATS data integrity to support compliance and recruiting metrics.
  • Ensure compliance with OFCCP regulations, EEO requirements, affirmative action obligations, and company recruiting policies.
  • Support proposal staffing efforts, incumbent captures, and rapid-response recruiting initiatives.
  • Participate in recruiting strategy meetings, workforce planning discussions, and Talent Acquisition team initiatives.
  • Represent PSI at recruiting events, military transition events, career fairs, conferences, and networking events as needed.
  • Support recruitment marketing initiatives, employer branding efforts, and additional Talent Acquisition projects as assigned.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree required; additional directly related recruiting experience may be considered in lieu of degree requirements.
  • Three (3)+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience supporting federal government contracts is required.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting for one or more of the following: DoD, DHA, VA, DHS, civilian federal agencies, or other government contracting environments.
  • Experience managing multiple requisitions simultaneously while meeting aggressive hiring deadlines.
  • Strong sourcing experience utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, networking, job boards, and passive recruiting techniques.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with candidates, hiring managers, and executive leadership.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize competing demands while maintaining a high level of customer service.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Teams, Excel, and Word.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to changing hiring priorities and business needs.
  • Occasional travel may be required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Extensive experience utilizing iCIMS Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting proposal recruiting, incumbent captures, and transition staffing.
  • Experience recruiting clinical, healthcare, IT, engineering, cybersecurity, intelligence, and professional services personnel.
  • Experience supporting Service Contract Act (SCA), exempt, and non-exempt recruiting.
  • Working knowledge of OFCCP, EEO, affirmative action, and federal contractor compliance requirements.
  • Experience utilizing LinkedIn Recruiter and advanced Boolean sourcing techniques.
  • Experience supporting nationwide recruiting across multiple states and customer programs.

Company Benefits

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. Flexible spending account and health saving account options offer pre-tax savings for qualified medical, dental, and vision expenses. The company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan has an employer contribution match that is immediately vested. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.

EEO Commitment

All personnel decisions, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination, are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. jobs.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Director of Engineering — MetaDefender Email Security

Reports to: VP, Products

Protecting the World’s Critical Infrastructure

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world’s largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.

The Product: MetaDefender Email Security

MetaDefender Email Security is OPSWAT’s email threat prevention portfolio, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to stop file-borne and email-borne threats before they reach the inbox. It comprises two complementary products designed for different environments and customer profiles — MetaDefender Email Gateway Security, deployed on-premises in front of existing mail servers, and MetaDefender Cloud Email Security, which augments Microsoft 365 — each embedding OPSWAT’s threat prevention technology, including Deep CDR, Metascan Multiscanning, Proactive DLP, and Predictive Alin AI, directly into the mail flow.

This role owns the engineering for the products across both deployment models — the on-premises gateway and the cloud-native Microsoft 365 service — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.

About This Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of the MetaDefender Email Security: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped high security environments to native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture the rest of OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products and lead a distributed team across Romania and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere — with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead as an AI-first effort: make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
  • Stay hands-on: remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap: take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the “what to ship” into the “how to build,” and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
  • Set technical direction (the “how”): drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
  • Build and lead a high-performance team: recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
  • Drive performance-based management: set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
  • Hold a security-first quality bar: champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
  • Raise engineering velocity: continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
  • Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio: establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
  • Partner cross-functionally: work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

What We Need From You

  • Full agentic development experience (required): You have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end-to-end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
  • A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC: demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
  • Proven engineering leadership: 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
  • Performance-based leadership: a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
  • Deep technical excellence: strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
  • Scalable systems experience: a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
  • Quality and test discipline: a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
  • Distributed-team leadership: demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
  • Talent magnet and clear communicator: you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
  • Security-conscious by default: operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • Domain familiarity: understanding of email as a communication channel and the underlying technology and protocols. Appreciation of the different deployment methods for email security and their characteristics.
  • Cloud services familiarity: experience of integrating products with M365 and/or Google Workspace and their associated API ecosystems
  • .NET / C# ecosystem: hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
  • Cloud-native and containers: experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
  • AI context-file authoring: experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
  • AI in CI/CD pipelines: familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
  • International team experience: a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Async and high-throughput systems: experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
  • Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT’s engineering portfolio.
  • Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
  • Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
  • A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
  • Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.
