jobs.title: Director of Learning Analytics and Strategy
jobs.excerpt: Overview The Director / Associate Director of Learning Strategy and Analytics serves as a critical connector between program strategy, course-level execution, and academic data.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Director / Associate Director of Learning Strategy and Analytics serves as a critical connector between program strategy, course-level execution, and academic data. This role leads the development of learning strategy, curriculum planning, and analytics capabilities that enable EIM and its University Partners to make more informed decisions about program design, curriculum effectiveness, learner progression, and continuous improvement.

The role is responsible for translating program-level goals, competencies, accreditation expectations, and learner outcomes into actionable curriculum structures and course-level guidance. It also provides strategic ownership of the systems, applications, and data frameworks that support curriculum planning and insight, including different platforms and other curriculum mapping, assessment, and learning-analytics tools.

Working closely with Academic Disciplines, Learning Design & Technology, Accreditation & Assessment, and University Partner leadership, this role helps ensure that curriculum decisions are informed by evidence, aligned across the learner journey, and supported by scalable processes and technology. Through curriculum strategy, product ownership, data interpretation, and cross-functional collaboration, the role strengthens EIM’s ability to connect program intent with course design, implementation, and measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to the following:

Learning Strategy & Program Alignment

  • Lead approaches for translating program vision, competencies, accreditation requirements, and program-level outcomes into coherent curriculum structures and course-level guidance.
  • Support curriculum architecture, sequencing, mapping, and alignment across courses and programs.
  • Partner with Academic Disciplines and Learning Design teams to identify curriculum gaps, redundancies, dependencies, and opportunities for improved integration.
  • Develop frameworks and tools that support new program development, curriculum redesign, and ongoing program improvement.
  • Ensure curriculum planning reflects learner progression, assessment strategy, instructional priorities, and program outcomes.

Learning Analytics & Academic Insight

  • Develop and lead a learning-intelligence approach that integrates curriculum, assessment, course, learner, and program-level data to support academic decision-making.
  • Identify priority data and insights needed by Program Directors, faculty, Academic leaders, and University Partners.
  • Translate complex academic and learning data into actionable insights, recommendations, dashboards, and decision-support resources.
  • Partner with Accreditation & Assessment and other stakeholders to connect curriculum information with student achievement, assessment performance, licensure outcomes, retention, and other indicators of program effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities for earlier detection of curriculum, implementation, or learner-performance risks.

Curriculum Technology & Product Management

  • Provide strategic product ownership for applications and technologies that support curriculum planning, mapping, assessment, and learning analytics, including platforms such as Enflux.
  • Define user needs, workflows, requirements, priorities, and adoption strategies for curriculum and learning-intelligence applications.
  • Partner with Educational Technology, vendors, and internal stakeholders to evaluate, configure, implement, and continuously improve enabling technologies.
  • Ensure tools are designed and implemented to support academic workflows rather than create additional administrative burden.
  • Establish standards and governance for curriculum data, system use, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.

Curriculum Assets & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to translate curriculum insights into reusable academic resources, learning assets, frameworks, and scalable solutions.
  • Support decisions regarding where common curriculum needs can be addressed through shared resources versus where program- or partner-specific differentiation is required.
  • Partner with Learning Design & Technology and Academic teams to inform development and prioritization of curriculum assets.
  • Use utilization, curriculum, assessment, and performance data to inform investment decisions and continuous improvement.

University Partner & Academic Collaboration

  • Partner with Program Directors, faculty, and University Partner leadership to support curriculum planning, evaluation, redesign, and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate curriculum strategy discussions and translate complex academic needs into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Serve as a senior resource for curriculum alignment, program-level design, mapping, and learning-intelligence questions.
  • Support partner-facing discussions that require integration of academic strategy, curriculum data, assessment findings, and instructional design considerations.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate closely with Academic Disciplines, Learning Design & Technology, Accreditation & Assessment, Educational Technology, Operations, and other teams to connect program strategy to execution.
  • Establish scalable processes, standards, and governance for curriculum planning and learning analytics across the Academic organization.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline curriculum workflows, improve data quality, and increase visibility into program performance.
  • Contribute to organizational planning related to new programs, partner onboarding, academic products and services, and curriculum innovation.
  • Promote a culture of evidence-based academic decision-making and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required

  • Master’s degree in curriculum and instruction, instructional design, learning sciences, higher education, educational assessment, educational technology, or related field.
  • 7–10 years of progressive experience in curriculum strategy, academic program design, curriculum mapping, learning analytics, assessment, instructional design, or related work.
  • Demonstrated experience translating program-level goals and outcomes into curriculum structures, course-level guidance, or academic improvement strategies.
  • Experience working with curriculum mapping, assessment, learning analytics, or related academic technology platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable academic insights and recommendations.
  • Strong consultative, facilitation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders in a matrixed environment.

Preferred

  • Experience in graduate, professional, or healthcare education.
  • Experience working with accreditation standards, competency-based education, or licensure-oriented programs.
  • Experience with curriculum mapping or learning-intelligence platforms such as Enflux or comparable systems.

jobs.description:
Wir suchen erfahrene Lehrkräfte (m/w/d) für unser Dozenten-Team, die uns dabei unterstützen, unsere Kunden mediengestützt, online und bundesweit erfolgreich zum Industriemeister auszubilden.

Über uns:
Mehr als 100 angehende Fach- und Betriebswirte sowie Industriemeister werden jährlich bei dem digitalen Weiterbildungsinstitut ausgebildet. Die Kundenanzahl steigt von Monat zu Monat. Die Grabowsky Consulting GmbH ist ein moderner und zertifizierter Bildungsträger und gehört zu den schnellst wachsenden Bildungsträgern in Deutschland.

Aktuell beschäftigen wir über 25 Mitarbeiter deutschlandweit und sind durchgehend auf der Suche nach neuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die uns bei unserer Mission unterstützen. Wenn du bereit für deinen großen beruflichen Durchbruch bist, dann werde jetzt Teil unseres Teams und starte deine Karriere beim Digitalen Weiterbildungsinstitut.

Mit unserer digitalen Mitarbeiterschulung wirst du von Beginn an intensiv eingearbeitet und erlernst alles, was du zur Ausführung des Jobs benötigst.

Aufgabenbereiche

  • Durchführung von interaktivem Online-Unterricht gemäß unseren Stundenplänen via Zoom mit vorgefertigten Lernunterlagen

  • Es besteht die Möglichkeit, die oben genannten Aufgaben für eine oder mehrere der nachfolgenden Fachrichtungen und Unterrichtsfächer durchzuführen:

    • Fachrichtungsübergreifende Basisqualifikationen (für alle Fachrichtungen): Naturwissenschaftliche und technische Gesetzmäßigkeiten, Betriebswirtschaftliches Handeln, Rechtsbewusstes Handeln, Methoden der Information, Kommunikation und Planung, Zusammenarbeit im Betrieb

    • Industriemeister Mechatronik: Mechanische und elektrische Systeme, Steuerungs- und Automatisierungstechnik, Betriebs- und Fertigungstechnik.

Wir bieten:

  • Intensive Einarbeitung: Auf unserem digitalen Schulungssystem erhalten neue Mitarbeiter sofortigen Zugang zu dem notwendigen Fachwissen, welches für ihre Aufgaben benötigt wird.

  • Planungssicherheit: Unsere Planung geht langfristig bis zu zweieinhalb Jahre in die Zukunft.

  • Hohe Auslastung: Ganze Unterrichtstage ermöglichen dir ein hohes Tageshonorar.

  • Professionelle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Wir arbeiten zuverlässig und strukturiert im Team.

  • Gute Honorarvergütung: Du erhältst eine gute und angemessene Honorarvergütung.

  • Home Office: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, flexibel von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten.

  • Effektive Zusammenarbeit: Du erhältst bei uns alle notwendigen Unterlagen für den Unterricht, sodass du nicht in Vorleistung gehen musst.

Requirements

  • Du arbeitest gerne in klaren Prozessen und bist organisiert

  • Die Bereitschaft, unter der Woche und/oder am Wochenende Unterrichtstage durchzuführen - insbesondere samstags von 8:00 bis 15:00 Uhr

  • Affinität zu Computern und Erfahrungen im Online-Unterricht

  • Weiterbildung zum Industriemeister (Metall, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Logistik oder Lebensmittel), Techniker, Ingenieur oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du besitzt Fachkompetenz & kannst diese auch einfach und verständlich vermitteln

  • Idealerweise Mitglied im IHK-Prüfungsausschuss für Industriemeister

Ablauf des Bewerbungsprozesses?

  • Wir nehmen dich in den Dozentenpool auf und berücksichtigen dich bei der nächsten Planung.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Lead Investor Relations team member at GitLab, you'll help rebuild our investor relations (IR) processes and shape how we communicate GitLab's strategy and performance to the public markets. Working closely with our VP of Finance Strategy & Operations, Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and executive team, you'll be a senior individual contributor with broad ownership of investor communications and relationships. You'll connect insights from across the business to explain our technical products, evolving business models, and long-term investment thesis.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead key workstreams of the quarterly earnings process, including messaging, scripts, questions and answers, data collection and synthesis, and conference call preparation; build repeatable processes with Finance, Legal, and executive leadership.
  • Gather insights from research and development, Product, Sales, and other business leaders to explain GitLab's strategy, technical products, and business model transitions in investor communications and board materials.
  • Own relationships with sell-side analysts and the investment community, monitor analyst models and consensus against our forecast, and flag gaps or risks to the head of IR and CFO.
  • Prepare the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), CFO, and other executives for investor meetings, conferences, and roadshows; lead investor calls independently when executives aren't available, explaining how GitLab's business works and answering investor questions.
  • Analyze peer and competitor earnings, Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filings, and investor days; maintain benchmarking analyses and deliver quantitative and qualitative insights for executive and board discussions.
  • Track GitLab's shareholder base and recommend investor targeting strategies to expand and maintain key ownership positions.
  • Draft and review earnings decks, shareholder letters, fact sheets, and IR website content; partner with Finance, Legal, Communications, and Strategy to keep messaging consistent, accurate, and compliant with disclosure requirements, including Regulation Fair Disclosure (Regulation FD).
  • Plan and deliver Investor Day with the head of IR to communicate GitLab's long-term story, alongside investor outreach, non-deal roadshows, and corporate access events.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience evaluating software businesses from a buy-side or sell-side investment perspective, gained through investing, equity research, investor relations, or a related field.
  • Financial modeling, valuation, and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to identify the business drivers that shape investor expectations.
  • Experience producing or analyzing earnings materials and investor presentations, and explaining technical software products, evolving business models, and financial performance clearly in writing and conversation. You can work directly with senior executives and offer an informed point of view.
  • Working knowledge of SEC reporting, Regulation FD, and public company disclosure practices.
  • Proficiency with presentation and spreadsheet tools, experience with IR and market data platforms, and experience using artificial intelligence (AI) to improve workflows or a willingness to develop that capability.
  • The ability to work independently and manage competing priorities in an all-remote, asynchronous-first environment, with an approach that reflects GitLab's values, especially transparency and efficiency.
  • Nice to have: prior experience building an internal IR function.

GitLab’s Investor Relations team drives the strategy and long-term market positioning of GitLab in the public financial markets. We are a small team, so each member has broad ownership and visibility across all aspects of IR.

jobs.excerpt: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving how we sell by bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers multiple distinct opportunities to help shape this journey while building your own expertise as a technology-focused seller. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change - help define how we engage, advise, and support customers as their technology needs become more complex. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, shaping a more consultative customer experience, and making a visible impact as our sales approach evolves, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

Asn an Account Director Senior - Large Enterprise Majors, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the senior commercial lead, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.

jobs.title: Менеджер з продажу зі знанням німецької мови (віддалено)
jobs.excerpt: Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів.
jobs.description:
Agentify — це міжнародна аутсорсингова компанія, яка з 2013 року задає тренди на ринку клієнтського сервісу та продажів. За понад 13 років роботи ми виросли з локального стартапу до потужного міжнародного хабу. Сьогодні Agentify — це сотні однодумців, які працюють як у наших сучасних технологічних офісах, так і в зручному віддаленому форматі (Remote) з будь-якої точки світу. Ми обслуговуємо провідні світові бренди, спілкуємося 5 мовами та щодня допомагаємо тисячам людей. Ми працюємо на перетині технологій та комунікацій, а кожен наш співробітник стає мультифункціональним експертом, опановуючи ключові напрямки сучасного бізнесу.

Наші Core-ніші та експертиза:

  • E-commerce & Retail — повний супровід клієнтів інтернет-магазинів: від оформлення замовлень до координації міжнародної логістики та повернень.

  • Активні продажі — робота з теплими лідами, телемаркетинг, cross-sell/up-sell та повернення клієнтів до покинутих кошиків.

  • Омніканальний Customer Care — клієнтська та технічна підтримка користувачів у режимі 24/7/365.

  • Цифрові чати — спілкування з клієнтами без голосу через Live-чати на сайтах, Email та популярні месенджери (Viber, Telegram, WhatsApp).

  • Інтелектуальна телефонія — робота з сучасним програмним забезпеченням, професійними CRM-системами та AI-інструментами автоматизації.

В свою команду зараз ми шукаємоМенеджера з продажу зі знанням німецької мови!

🌟Чому кандидати обирають Agentify?

  • Стабільність з 2013 року —прозорі виплати та впевненістьу завтрашньому дні.

  • Власна Академія —безкоштовне навчання з нуля(ділова комунікація, техніки продажів, робота з програмами та сервісами). Ми інвестуємо в розвиток співробітників і підтримуємо їх на всіх етапах адаптації.

  • Дохід без обмежень —погодинна ставка + відсоток від викупу. У продажах твій заробіток залежить насамперед від твоїх результатів.

  • Реальний кар'єрний ліфт — більшість наших Team Lead, Supervisor та QA-менеджерів виросли всередині компанії.

  • Абсолютна інклюзивність— ми вільні від стереотипів. Для нас важливі лише твої навички, енергія та бажання розвиватися.

Ми пропонуємо:

  • Своєчасна оплата праці,що складається зфіксованої ставки 6,4 Євро/год + % від викупу товарів.Очікуваний місячний дохід для ТОП-спеціаліста: ~2000 євро!

  • Повністю віддалена робота.

  • Зручний позмінний графік :9.00−18.00 та з 13.00−22.00 (в кожній зміні година обіду).

  • Бонус за успішне проходження навчання

  • Дружній колектив і наставники, які завжди допоможуть.

  • Подарунки на річницю роботи та дітям співробітників на свята.

  • Спеціальні бонуси для менеджерів з найвищими показниками: індивідуальний графік, оплата спортивних абонементів або оплата курсів з іноземної мови, оплата розваг та інші привілеї.

  • Акція «Бонус за новачка» (ти отримуєш приємний бонус за кожного працівника, що прийшов по твоїй рекомендації)

Наші бізнес-цінності:

  • Відкритість—ми цінуємо вміння говорити прямо, чути інших і шукати нові підходи.

  • Надійність— для нас важливо, щоб на кожного члена команди можна було покластися, і ми створюємо умови для відповідальної роботи.

  • Безперервний розвиток—ми не чекаємо досконалості, але очікуємо бажання вчитися та вдосконалюватися.

  • Націленість на результат— ми працюємо, щоб досягати реальних результатів, а не для виконання формальних планів.

  • Клієнтоорієнтованість— ми ставимо потреби клієнтів у центр уваги та працюємо над тим, щоб забезпечувати якісний сервіс та пропонувати рішення, які створюють реальну цінність

Твої майбутні обов’язки:

  • Здійснювати дзвінки по теплій базі на нативному ринку Польщі.

  • Виявляти потреби клієнтів, презентувати товари та працювати з запереченнями.

  • Продавати продукцію компанії за скриптами.

  • Фіксувати замовлення в CRM-системі.

Що потрібно, щоб до нас приєднатись:

  • Знання німецької мови: від рівня В2+і вище (важливо розмовний рівень)

  • ПК/ноутбук, дротова гарнітура та стабільний інтернет.

  • Вільне володіння ПК і офісними програмами.

  • Уміння продавати або бажання навчитися це робити.

  • Бажано володіння техніками продажу та роботою з запереченнями.

Що для нас важливо?

Щоб ви бачили сенс у тому, що робите, були чесними з собою та колегами й не боялися вийти за межі звичного, коли це потрібно.

Якщо ви шукаєте місце, де ваші дії справді впливають на результат, ми будемо раді познайомитися.

Надсилаючи свою заявку, ви даєте згоду на обробку ваших персональних даних компанією Agentify Ltd. з метою рекрутингу відповідно до GDPR. Ви можете відкликати свою згоду або запросити видалення ваших даних у будь-який час.

jobs.title: Content Operations Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Location: Fully Remote, UK Contract Type: Full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, 40 hours per week Mon-Fri, 8.
jobs.description:
Location: Fully Remote, UK
Contract Type: Full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, 40 hours per week Mon-Fri, 8.30am - 5.30pm, UK time.
Interviews: 2 stages, plus a short meeting with our Head of Product at final stage
Salary: £30,000 per annum
Reports to: Product Manager for Core Content

About Vable

Vable builds content intelligence software used by international law firms, consultancies and government teams. We help organisations turn information overload into competitive advantage.

Our clients rely on Vable to monitor thousands of trusted sources: the news sites, publisher feeds and email newsletters through which we track content for them daily. That only works if those sources are accurate, healthy and set up properly. Keeping them that way takes careful, hands-on work, and we need someone to help us do it well.

The Role

We are hiring a Content Operations Specialist to keep our source library accurate and reliable for clients. This is a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension.

You will work alongside our Data Specialist, setting up new sources and keeping existing ones working. Much of the job is hands-on: checking web pages and emails, working out why a source has stopped collecting content, and fixing it using our existing processes.

This is a small team of two, so your work makes a visible difference every day. The tasks are detailed, and much of it is about responding quickly to issues as they come up. No two days are quite the same: one day you might work through dozens of source checks, the next you might help deliver a large project for a client. This won't be a client-facing role, but client requests will come to you through our Customer Success team. If you love a system that runs like clockwork, and get a buzz from tracking down a problem and putting it right before anyone else notices, read on.

What You'll Do

  • Set up new sources for clients
  • Investigate and fix broken sources with the help of our internal tools, for example by reading a page's HTML, checking HTTP errors, or using XPath to extract relevant information
  • Carry out daily source maintenance, keeping error levels within our quality targets and fixing issues before clients notice them
  • Maintain publisher records, including name updates
  • Escalate wider issues to the Product Manager
  • Support client requests, from quick checks to migrations and bulk source projects
  • Take part in the maintenance projects we run at set points in the year to find hidden problems across our content
  • Share feedback on which parts of our tools and processes are slow or awkward, so we can improve them
  • Your work should show up in source health, fewer client-reported issues and faster turnaround on client requests.

Is This You?

Accuracy matters to you, whether at work or in your studies. You get real satisfaction from a system that runs smoothly, and when something looks slightly off, you want to know why and fix it.

You do your best work when you can settle in and focus. You like working at pace, moving from one problem to the next, and you enjoy the rhythm of fixing things in quick succession.

You might come from operations, data quality, research, library or information services, or a support role where you got deep into the data. You might also be a recent graduate. You don't need to be highly technical already: we will teach you how to read a page's HTML and use XPath to fix sources. What matters is that you are curious about how things work and pick up new tools quickly.

Essential Criteria

  • 2+ years in a detail-focused role, such as data quality, operations, research or support
  • Excellent attention to detail, and the patience to do a high volume of similar checks to a consistently high standard
  • The ability to learn quickly, and curiosity about how websites and tools work
  • Ownership of your work: you see tasks through, prioritise without close direction and flag problems early
  • Clear written communication, especially when explaining an issue to colleagues
  • Familiarity with HTML or XPath is a plus
  • The right to live and work in the UK

Desirable Criteria

  • Comfortable working closely with Customer Success and Product teams
  • Experience in a fully remote technical environment

Why Join?

This is a role for problem solvers who like to see results. When you fix a source, content starts flowing to clients again straight away. You will have real responsibility from your first weeks and learn quickly alongside a small team that knows the work inside out. By the end of your contract, you'll be able to cover the content function on your own.

We are investing in better tools and processes for this work, and your day-to-day feedback will help decide what we improve first.

You're Probably Not the Right Fit If:

  • You find detailed, repetitive checking draining rather than satisfying
  • You would rather wait to be told what to fix than go looking for problems, or you tend to push on alone rather than speak up when you're stuck
  • You are looking for a role focused on strategy rather than hands-on delivery
  • You like the social aspect of corridor chats and time talking face to face. We have plenty of social interaction, but it is remote.

What Success Looks Like:

🟢 First 30 Days: Confident with our sources, publishers and tools, handling day-to-day maintenance and requests with support

🟢 First 90 Days: Setting up and fixing sources independently, with proactive source-health checks back on a regular rhythm

🟢 By 6 Months: Taking on migrations and bulk projects without disruption, and able to cover the content function on your own

What We Offer:

Remote-first flexibility, WFH and learning budgets. More than that, a supportive team.

We're a team that takes ownership, stays curious, succeeds as a team and treats each other well with kindness and empathy. That's not a values statement, it's just how we work 💚

Ready to Apply?

Submit your CV, cover letter and answers to the application questions. The process runs over 2-3 weeks and has three stages: an intro call with our People team, then an interview with the Product Manager for Core Content and another applicable Vabler. Final candidates will have a short conversation with our Head of Product before an offer is made.

🎥 We record recruitment calls with your permission to ensure fairness across our remote team. We hire based on skills, potential and passion, and are an equal opportunities employer.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with end-to-end, system, user acceptance, or unit testing, defect tracking, and release management.

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring an impact analytics data analyst to join our team! The impact analytics team at Recidiviz measures our interventions so we can more effectively improve outcomes for the justice-involved population. We’re looking for a data analyst to join our team to measure historical impact and estimate future impact to inform both our product strategy and partnerships with funders.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

The Impact Analytics Data Analyst will work alongside the research and impact tracking leads to analyze the impact of Recidiviz’s products and interventions. They will build statistical models, communicate findings with stakeholders, and build reusable processes to facilitate repeated analyses. They will also contribute to aggregated metrics infrastructure and consult with other data analysts to design and measure experiments.

Core responsibilities

  • Build statistical models using Python and SQL to quantify historical impact and estimate future impact of Recidiviz interventions on the justice-involved population
  • Collaborate with Recidiviz’s growth and fundraising team to communicate impact analysis findings with stakeholders at a range of technical altitudes
  • Build automated workflows to continuously track Recidiviz’s progress in improving outcomes for the justice-involved population
  • Work closely with the impact tracking and research leads on the impact analytics team to inform data-driven product strategy at Recidiviz
  • Define measures of product usage and impact in Python and SQL through Recidiviz’s aggregated metrics framework and Looker
  • Consult with the data analysis and data science team to develop experimental and quasi-experimental rollout analysis methodologies

Wild success

One year into the role, you will have developed a model that estimates Recidiviz’s impact on the justice-involved population over the next several years. That model, alongside other impact evaluations you conduct, will have enriched both Recidiviz’s partnerships with funders and product strategy efforts with a more detailed understanding of how Recidiviz interventions can improve outcomes for the justice-involved population.

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, to help nurture a knowledgeable, data-oriented culture
  • Enthusiasm for working with internal and external partners from diverse backgrounds and worldviews, such as government staff, researchers, journalists, technical staff, and practitioners in criminal justice reform
  • Ability to inspect source data, reason about data models, examine results closely, and prepare data and analyses that are usable for various applications
  • 2 or more years of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and processing complex datasets
  • Professional work experience using SQL to work with large datasets, including high proficiency writing efficient queries for more complex data extraction and transformation tasks
  • High familiarity with Python, specifically Pandas package, for tasks such as statistical analysis and data visualization

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with statistical analysis, specifically forecasting and/or causal inference
  • Experience translating nebulous research questions into strategic analysis plans, executing those plans, and recommending future courses of action informed by analysis results
  • Experience working in a cross-functional organization that designs, builds, and launches products for users
  • Experience working with large datasets from the public sector, especially related to criminal justice
  • Familiarity with our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The annual compensation for this role is: $97,000.

What we offer

  • Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
  • 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays per year
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Complimentary One Medical membership (availability based on location)
  • Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
  • Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
  • Free mental health support via Talkspace
  • Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
  • An annual company offsite and other ad-hoc gatherings
  • All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 20 state partners - big and small, red and blue - and touches over 46% of the country’s incarcerated population. We have helped to get hundreds of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2025 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you’re really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!

About SecurityScorecard:

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

We're starting a new engineering team, and its job is to change how SecurityScorecard builds software. You'll be one of the first people on it.

The team works out how a company our size should ship code now that agents can write most of it. That means real work on the codebase: running agentic coding workflows end to end, finding where they break, building the tooling and guardrails that fix those breaks, and turning what works into the way the rest of engineering operates. We'll pick product areas to test against as we go. Over time the team takes on real product ownership and folds back into the wider engineering org.

We want strong engineers who went deep on AI coding because they couldn't leave it alone. You know how production systems fail and you've pushed agentic tools far enough to know where they still fall short. You also care about building a team you'd want to work on, and you'll stick around after the novelty wears off.

This is greenfield. You'll report to our CTO or to an engineer leading the team, and the reporting lines will move as the team grows. If titles and org charts matter a lot to you, this role won't be a good fit. We care about execution and impact.

What you'll do

  • Run agentic coding workflows on production code and find out what actually holds up at our scale
  • Build the tooling, guardrails, evals and review practices that let agents ship code we trust
  • Design systems that stay sound when most of the code is written by agents, and decide where humans need to stay in the loop
  • Ship real changes to our products, using them as test cases for the new way of working
  • Pair with engineers across the org, review their work and help them adopt what we learn
  • Raise the hiring bar: interview candidates and help decide who joins the team
  • Write down what we learn so other teams can use it without us in the room
  • Design, build, and ship customer-facing AI-powered product features using TypeScript, Go, and AWS, owning quality and reliability end-to-end
  • Architect and implement agentic workflows, LLM pipelines, and intelligent automation that help customers surface faster, more actionable security insights
  • Integrate foundation models into existing product surfaces with a practical eye toward latency, cost, output quality, and evaluation
  • Use AI-native development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, setting the standard for how this team builds
  • Lead architecture and code reviews with a focus on production-grade reliability, security, and maintainability
  • Own projects end-to-end from concept through production, including monitoring, iteration, and improvement post-launch
  • Stay current with the AI tooling and foundation model landscape and bring relevant advances into our roadmap and practices

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years building and shipping production software, with a track record at strong engineering companies (big tech, high-growth startups, or both)
  • Evidence that you drove things. We want the people who set the direction on their teams, not the ones who rode along.
  • Deep computer science and system design fundamentals. You can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and explain how it fails.
  • Heavy, hands-on use of AI coding tools on real codebases, with opinions about what works and what doesn't
  • Experience building with LLMs: agents, tool use, evals, prompt, and context design
  • Proficiency in TypeScript and strong backend engineering fundamentals
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a team that changes shape. You'll help define the job as we go.
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and production deployment practices
  • Clear, direct communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Our tech stack

TypeScript / JavaScript, Go, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, ClickHouse, PostgreSQL

How we interview:

Expect a system design round, a coding exercise where you're expected to use AI tools, and a deep dive into a project you led, including how you used AI on it. We'll ask follow-up questions until we understand the decisions you made and why.

Location and compensation:

Remote. We're hiring across United States, Canada, and Latin America.

Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

DataKind is looking for a Senior Project Manager (Remote-US)!

Location

This is a full-time, remote position that can be based anywhere in the U.S. The majority of working hours each day must fall between 8am and 6pm Eastern Time. The role includes travel within the United States, up to 10% of the time.

Salary Range

$101,000 - $112,000 annual salary.

Final salary within this range will be based on the candidate’s experience and internal equity with team members in similar roles.

Overview

Reporting to the Head of Education Initiatives, the Senior Project Manager supports effective execution and coordination across DataKind’s Education portfolio. You’ll coordinate work across Research, Product, Data Science, and our partner-facing teams, manage a set of projects and grants directly, and serve as a steady point of contact for institutional partners and funders. You bring substantive knowledge of education, particularly higher education, and the ability to contribute meaningfully to applied research, implementation, and partner-facing work when a workstream needs extra capacity.

What you’ll do

  • Coordinate timelines, milestones, deliverables, and dependencies across the Education portfolio, working with functional leads to keep commitments on track.
  • Manage designated projects and grants day to day, including deliverables, budget tracking, and funder reporting.
  • Facilitate planning and problem-solving across Research, Product, Data Science, and partner-facing teams, ensuring clarity around responsibilities, priorities, and dependencies.
  • Handle routine project matters with institutional partners, funders, and collaborators, using your own judgment and escalating strategic issues to leadership.
  • Contribute to applied research and evaluation work, project deliverables, and partner- and funder-facing materials.
  • Find and fix gaps in how the portfolio coordinates, tracks work, and runs.

Qualifications

Required

  • Deep alignment with DataKind's mission and values, and demonstrated commitment to educational equity and data-driven social impact
  • 6+ years of professional experience managing or coordinating complex, externally funded projects, preferably in applied research, education, evaluation, or technical assistance settings that involve grant reporting, budget monitoring, and multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Substantive knowledge of education, preferably higher education, along with familiarity with ed tech or technical assistance models.
  • The ability to anticipate needs, spot emerging problems, and move work forward without close direction.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including turning complex technical and research work into clear project updates, funder reports, and partner materials.
  • Strong facilitation skills and a track record of moving work forward across teams without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with project management platforms such as Asana or comparable tools, including timeline, milestone, and dependency management.
  • Demonstrated adaptability and comfort navigating ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving organizational structures while maintaining focus on key commitments and outcomes.

Preferred

  • Ability to engage with research findings, data analyses, and evaluation results and communicate their implications to varied audiences.

About DataKind

At DataKind, we believe in the transformative power of data science and AI to create a more promising future. Since our founding in 2012, we've been at the forefront of designing scalable, data-driven tools that address some of the world's toughest challenges—ranging from frontline health, humanitarian action, climate and environment, economic opportunity, education, and more. As both a product innovator and a movement catalyst, we set new standards in the social sector, empowering organizations to harness the full potential of data science and AI while putting communities first.

Why Work with DataKind

At DataKind, we believe that people are the most important asset to delivering on our mission. As a people-first remote organization, we offer the following for all our employees:

Flexibility and time off. Enjoy genuine flexibility that goes beyond adjustable hours. We build in shared time off, organization-wide recharge days, bi-weekly meeting-free days, and flexible PTO (with a minimum of 20 vacation days encouraged annually).

Comprehensive Wellness Support. We care for your total wellbeing with 100% employer-paid medical, vision, and dental benefits for employees (72% for dependents), a wellness reimbursement program for the activities and purchases that matter to you, and 12 weeks paid parental leave when you need it most.

A Culture of Growth. Every team member receives professional development funding each year, alongside mentorship and advancement opportunities. We invest in your future with a 401(k) plan with 5% employer matching.

Meaningful Connection. Despite being distributed across time zones, we value being able to come together in person for conferences, strategic planning, and at our annual staff retreat.

Living our Values. DataKind is committed to a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment in our day-to-day work and via special initiatives driven by our DEI Steering Committee.

jobs.description:
ABOUT CORDIAL

We founded Cordial in 2014 on the belief that there should be more humanity and empathy in marketing—both in how brands communicate with their customers and in how technology companies work with brands. We built our company and platform purposefully, driven by a desire to inspire more thoughtful communication and to create experiences that feel more personal and human—for consumers, for the people at the companies we work with, and for Cordial employees. Today, brands like PacSun, Revolve, Abercrombie & Fitch, Realtor.com, L.L. Bean and Forbes rely on Cordial to drive revenue growth by sending a better message.

We chose the name Cordial to symbolize how we empower our clients to communicate with their customers, as well as how we do business: with transparency, collaboration, and trust. We're building a passionate team of individuals willing to learn, grow, and be thoughtfully challenged on a daily basis to continuously improve our product, company, and culture every single day.

OUR VALUES

  • Communicate better than the rest
  • Own it, every time
  • Solve client problems tenaciously
  • Make Waves

POSITION SUMMARY

The Client Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for ensuring the success of a portfolio of Cordial’s Commercial clients. The CSM is a true client partner, a strategic account owner, who works diligently to advocate and align technology and expertise on behalf of the client. The CSM is the owner of the entire client relationship post-sale, but is included in pre-sales discovery conversations with prospective clients. Key focus areas include owning the client success plan, executive engagement, commercial relationship, and proactively managing competitive threats.

YOU WILL

  • Be client obsessed. You are characterized most by your relentless enthusiasm to immerse yourself in your clients world, learning how to change behaviors and processes that deliver meaningful business impact to your clients.You practice client management techniques that demonstrate you understand the difference between creating a happy client and a successful client, and manage their portfolio accordingly.
  • Think “big picture.” You will learn, comprehend and internalize the client's definition of success with regards to Cordial and the client’s broader business. You will develop a comprehensive understanding of business challenges faced by clients and objectives to appropriately map Cordial features and business benefits to address client needs.
  • Act as a Quarterback. You will create and deliver success plans for each client and ensure the broader Client Experience team (Technical Account Managers, Solutions Engineers and Deliverability team) stays on task to achieve agreed upon goals as stated in the plan. You will own the client cadence (planning/status/review meetings) and organization of the program.
  • Have some technical chops. You will achieve a deep understanding of Cordial’s platform and its value proposition in addition to demonstrating the platform’s capabilities.
  • Be a problem solver. The ability to problem solve both strategic campaign challenges related to client messaging programs and the technical solutions implemented for our clients is a must.
  • Take the driver’s seat. You will drive timely renewals by owning the commercial relationship end to end, including forecasting, negotiation and execution of contracts. You will focus on the continual expansion of Cordial’s integration with the client to drive even greater levels of client success. In other words, you will drive exponential rates of renewal, expansion and advocacy in Cordial’s client base. Drive, drive, drive! Partner like a boss. You will partner with Cordial’s Channel Growth & Partnership team to align technology and service partners with clients.
  • Wear your business hat. You will participate in business development and discovery meetings with prospective clients. Prospective clients will love you and ask where to sign. You will also partner with Cordial’s sales, marketing and product development team to align on client needs, use cases and success stories.
  • Will have opportunities to travel to client sites for various business meetings approximately 10% of the time (or less) annually, but will vary based on the assigned client base.

ABOUT YOU

  • You are seasoned. You have a Bachelor’s degree and 4+ years working in a client management role (both commercial and enterprise) at a SaaS company, preferably with experience in CRM.
  • You have a balanced mix of strong technical aptitude and commercial instincts.
  • You’re a relationship builder. You love working with and building long term relationships with all levels of a client’s organization.
  • You are a Self-Starter. You are independent, organized, a problem solver, and passionate about detail.
  • Communication is a breeze for you. You have excellent written and oral communications skills, especially in a business setting. You have a knack of communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • You navigate well in organizations. You can seamlessly work cross functionally, ideally with Product, Engineering and Sales. You’re a team player. You love to win negotiations. You have very smart and cordial negotiation skills.
  • You have strong project management skills. You are capable of managing multiple projects and clients at the same time.
  • You don’t mind a little chaos. You have a track record of delivering phenomenal results in a dynamic, autonomous start-up environment.
  • Last but not least, you embody Cordial’s values.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU:

  • Have experience in the enterprise marketing automation industry.
  • Have used Tools such as:, Harvest (Time Tracking), Client Success, JIRA, etc.
  • Have experience working with email marketing and digital marketing technologies, including personalization and optimization technologies, and advanced marketing automation.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$80,000.00 - $115,000.00 annually. The compensation range may be adjusted based on experience and location. In combination with base salary, Cordial's compensation package includes equity and bonus, a robust benefit plan (medical/dental/vision/life), 401k match, flexible time off. Additionally, we offer perks such as monthly wellness and cell phone stipends, childcare and continued education yearly reimbursements. We pride ourselves in maintaining a healthy work/life balance, a strong dedication to DE&I efforts, and an overall respectful and open culture!

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and executive communication skills

Location: US Remote

Role Overview

Nasuni is looking for a Senior Manager, Marketing Operations (PMO) to build and scale the operating system that turns marketing strategy into predictable execution.

You will own the Marketing PMO function, creating the planning rhythms, governance, work-management infrastructure, and cross-functional processes that help our marketing organization prioritize effectively, execute consistently, and adapt quickly as the business grows.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has built or significantly evolved a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model—not simply managed projects within an established system.

You will also lead complex strategic programs spanning Marketing, IT, Sales Operations, Finance, and other business functions, including acquisition integrations and transformation initiatives.

This role reports to the VP of Marketing Operations and works closely with functional marketing leaders and executive stakeholders.

Level & Scope

You will independently own the Marketing PMO operating model while partnering with the VP of Marketing Operations on strategic direction and priorities.

You will have autonomy to diagnose execution challenges, design governance and planning mechanisms, establish operating cadences, improve workflows, and drive adoption across teams where you may have influence but no direct authority.

The role combines operating-model design with hands-on execution. You will build the system and also lead it until the system can operate predictably at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and continuously improve Marketing’s integrated planning and operating cadence, including sprint planning, business reviews, quarterly planning, and cross-functional execution management.
  • Build scalable PMO governance that improves prioritization, accountability, handoffs, visibility, and delivery predictability across marketing functions.
  • Own and optimize Smartsheet as Marketing’s primary work-management environment, including workspace architecture, dashboards, templates, automations, and executive visibility.
  • Lead complex strategic programs spanning multiple functions, including acquisition integrations, business transformation initiatives, systems projects, and other leadership priorities.
  • Design and improve Marketing’s request and intake processes, establishing clear standards for prioritization, briefs, routing, ownership, and service expectations.
  • Identify execution risks, dependencies, and blockers early and work across functions to resolve them without relying on executive escalation.
  • Establish meaningful operating metrics, including delivery performance, governance adoption, backlog health, milestone completion, and planning predictability.
  • Partner with the VP of Marketing Operations to evolve PMO capabilities and build repeatable approaches for future integrations and transformation programs.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools to improve appropriate operational workflows such as planning, project synthesis, reporting, analysis, and workflow automation while maintaining validation, data awareness, and human accountability.

What Success Looks Like

In your first several months, you will take independent ownership of core planning and sprint cadences, establish a reliable source of truth for project execution, strengthen intake governance, and create structured workplans for priority strategic initiatives.

Over time, the Marketing Rhythm of Business should operate predictably without VP-level facilitation. Teams should experience the PMO as a function that creates clarity and makes execution easier—not as an additional layer of bureaucracy.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • 8+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience building, establishing, or substantially evolving a PMO, centralized planning function, or comparable operating model.
  • Experience leading complex programs across multiple business functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Strong enterprise work-management platform expertise, including advanced use of Smartsheet or comparable platforms involving dashboards, automation, templates, governance, and scalable workspace design.
  • Demonstrated ability to design operating processes that improve accountability, adoption, and execution—not simply administer existing processes.
  • Strong influence and stakeholder-management skills with experience working across functional and leadership boundaries.
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve professional workflows, with clear methods for validating outputs and maintaining human accountability.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, cloud infrastructure, or another complex, high-growth environment.
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or comparable project/program management certification.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, SharePoint, and Slack.
  • Experience with marketing budget governance or financial forecasting.

Ideal

  • Experience building a Marketing PMO or integrated marketing planning function from the ground up.

Experience Guidelines

Candidates will typically bring 8+ years of relevant professional experience, including meaningful experience in program management, PMO, marketing operations, business operations, or a related discipline.

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.

You’ll work with teams operating at the intersection of cloud, AI, enterprise data infrastructure, and business transformation while helping create the operating discipline needed to scale.

jobs.excerpt: Overview At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward.
jobs.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Principal Architect – Security, responsible for working with stakeholders, both leadership and subject matter experts, to build a holistic view of the organization’s security architecture, controls, and risk posture. This individual will utilize knowledge and experience to link the business mission, strategy, and processes of the organization to a secure-by-design IT strategy, and document this utilizing multiple architectural models or views that show how the current and future needs of the organization will be met in an efficient, sustainable, agile, adaptable, and secure manner. A central focus of this role is embedding security into architecture decisions across SCA’s hybrid, partner-driven environment and serving as the authoritative security voice at the Architecture Review Board. Because SCA maintains its own identity boundary with no federation to its Optum/UHG parent, this role treats identity as the primary control plane and delivers secure access through a Zero Trust, Zscaler-anchored model.

Key Accountabilities

  • Develop, maintain, promote, and evangelize an enterprise view of the security architecture blueprint and roadmap for the organization
  • Align the security strategy, controls, and solutions with the Company’s business objectives and defined risk appetite
  • Serve as the authoritative security reviewer at the ARB/DRB, evaluating architectures for security fitness and recording the Security domain sign-off
  • Partner with the CISO organization to ensure architecture aligns with the NIST CSF-aligned security remediation framework, coordinating it with the EA-owned Technical Debt Management Framework
  • Establish and lead the threat modeling practice required by Optum for qualifying solution architectures — defining which architectures trigger a threat model, the method applied (e.g., STRIDE), and how threat-model findings are remediated and carried into the ARB security sign-off
  • Perform architecture risk assessments across initiatives, mapping mitigations to the design and reducing project risk
  • Provide strategic security consultation to assigned business customers in designing technology-based solutions, and identify enabling security technologies based on requirements
  • Design and publish security patterns and reference architectures spanning identity and access management, zero-trust, data protection, network segmentation, secrets management, and logging/detection
  • Own the enterprise identity and access management architecture as the primary control plane for Zero Trust — directory and identity services (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), authentication and federation standards (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization models
  • Architect identity governance and privileged access — joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle and automated provisioning/deprovisioning, access certification and entitlement reviews, and privileged access management (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management) with just-in-time, least-privilege elevation
  • Design cross-boundary, workforce, and partner identity for SCA’s separated identity model — Optum-issued contractor identities, B2B/guest access, and Citrix — where SCA and the Optum parent maintain distinct identity stores without federation; define workload and non-human identity patterns (service principals, managed identities, workload federation) and secrets management to eliminate long-lived credentials
  • Architect data protection for PHI and PII in the ASC context, including encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization
  • Establish the Zero Trust network and secure-access architecture on the Zscaler SSE/SASE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) for identity- and posture-aware access to private applications, Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) for secure web/egress and inline inspection, and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) for monitoring — replacing implicit-trust VPN patterns and enforcing segmentation and ingress/egress controls
  • Extend the Zscaler platform into the broader control set where it fits — CASB and DLP for SaaS, posture control, and device-posture signals feeding Conditional Access — with clean integration to Entra ID, endpoint tooling, and logging/detection
  • Provide cloud and SaaS security architecture, in particular for Microsoft Azure, including landing-zone guardrails, policy-as-code, and shared-responsibility clarity
  • Map security controls to applicable frameworks (NIST CSF, HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, PCI) with ownership and an evidence approach
  • Guide vulnerability management and supply-chain security, including SBOM, patching, and security gates in the SDLC/CI-CD pipeline
  • Lead the security architecture review of third-party and vendor solutions, with particular rigor for Tier 1 PHI vendors
  • Monitor and manage security-related technical debt within the environment, coordinating remediation priority with the CISO framework
  • Contribute to the growth and maturity of the IT department through mentorship, knowledge transfer, and thought leadership by example
  • Articulate security architecture concepts, risk, and analytical findings to Executive Management, business leadership, software developers, and end users
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • 8-10+ years of experience in security architecture and engineering, with the most recent role in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • 2-5+ years of experience working in an architect or technical leadership capacity
  • Solid understanding of healthcare provider (ASC) security and compliance obligations (HIPAA, HITRUST), with the ability to provide a trusted voice at the decision-making table
  • Strong command of security frameworks and control catalogs: NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, HITRUST, SOC 2, and PCI DSS
  • Deep identity and access management expertise: directory and identity platforms (Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory), federation and authentication protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM), Conditional Access, MFA and passwordless, and RBAC/ABAC authorization
  • Identity governance and privileged access experience: IGA lifecycle and provisioning, access certification and entitlement management, and PAM with just-in-time elevation (e.g., Entra Privileged Identity Management); experience with workforce/partner identity across separated, non-federated identity stores — including externally issued contractor identities, B2B/guest, and Citrix — is a strong plus
  • Thorough understanding of cloud security and governance, in particular Microsoft Azure (landing zones, guardrails, policy-as-code)
  • Data protection expertise: encryption in transit and at rest, key management, and masking/tokenization for PHI and PII
  • Strong network and boundary security background, including segmentation and zero-trust network access
  • Hands-on Zscaler experience across the SSE platform — Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) — designing zero-trust access to replace legacy VPN, with an understanding of how Zscaler integrates with identity (Entra ID) and device posture
  • Proficiency with threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and risk assessment methodologies as they relate to integration and software engineering
  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing a threat-modeling program — establishing trigger criteria, applying a recognized methodology (e.g., STRIDE, PASTA, or attack-tree analysis), and integrating findings into architecture governance — not just performing individual threat models
  • Experience with security logging, monitoring, and detection, including SIEM and SOC integration
  • Experience with vulnerability management, SBOM, and DevSecOps / secure SDLC practices, including CI/CD security gates
  • Knowledge of TOGAF and a security architecture framework such as SABSA required; certification preferred (CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CCSP, SABSA, Microsoft SC-300 Identity and Access Administrator, Azure security certifications, or Zscaler certifications such as ZCCA/ZCCP)
  • Excellent conceptual and security design pattern skills irrespective of technology, and willingness to assume total ownership of security architecture from inception to delivery
  • Experience creating an effective framework and process model for establishing enterprise-wide security architecture
  • Ability and willingness to document security architecture, integrations, and dependencies for existing platforms and systems currently in use at SCA
  • Understanding and experience implementing the strategic alignment of business and security
  • Experience with third-party and vendor security risk management, particularly for Tier 1 PHI SaaS vendors
  • Demonstrated competency in communicating the value of security architecture to stakeholders and senior management
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to develop and conduct executive-level presentations
  • Ability to collaborate with various levels of individuals – both IT and business
  • Self-directed with the ability to work effectively under tight deadlines
  • Experience with Mergers & Acquisitions, in areas of security diligence and integration, is desirable.

We are looking for skilled engineers to join a new team that will deploy and maintain our established cross-domain system for a customer. The system uses an AMQP event-driven microservices architecture and extensively utilizes docker container services. As a team member, you will maintain a continuous deployment pipeline, work with feature delivery teams to promote component releases into production, and apply configuration management tools to ensure all deployments are consistent and correctly configured.

The system is designed to be highly observable and available. The team will use monitoring tools to verify that all components are meeting SLA/SLO requirements. If any problems are identified, the team will take preventive actions to minimize customer impact and restore service as quickly as possible.

This role is perfect for an experienced engineer who is comfortable working in a managed service environment and wants to gain more experience with best-of-breed DevOps tools and techniques.
