jobs.description:
About Us

Zact is a Fintech innovator dedicated to a singular idea : Organizations need simpler expense and payment management systems that align the spending employee with finance and accounting while providing inherent guardrails and continuous reconciliation with financial systems.
Zact enables all parts of the company to Pay by the Rules.

About the Role

We are building out a dedicated Application Support function for our GCP-hosted, microservices-based commercial card and payments platform. This mid-level analyst is the second US seat on the team, working alongside a Lead Application Support Engineer who anchors the function.

You will handle tier-1 and tier-2 support tickets independently, investigate issues across GCP logs and MySQL data, and be a reliable presence during US banking hours for our bank clients. This is a hands-on investigation role — you will spend real time in log consoles and query interfaces, not just routing tickets.

Location

  • Zact is a global company with multiple locations across US, Europe and India.
  • We provide 100% Remote Working Option.
  • Candidates applying for this role should be located in India;

What You’ll Do

Day-to-Day Ticket Handling

  • Own the Zendesk ticket queue during US hours — triage incoming issues by severity, respond within SLA, and resolve or escalate with full documentation
  • Handle known incident types independently using the team’s runbook library — no need to escalate for established patterns
  • Be the first US contact for bank client technical queries — acknowledge promptly, investigate thoroughly, communicate clearly
  • Cover the queue when the Lead is occupied with complex incidents, client escalations, or tooling work

Investigation & Triage

  • Search and filter GCP Cloud Logging to find error entries, trace requests across microservice boundaries using correlation IDs, and identify where failures occur in the service chain
  • Write MySQL SELECT queries against production read replicas to investigate transaction status, card data, account records, and settlement details
  • Escalate to the Lead with a structured handoff — logs reviewed, queries run, hypothesis formed, nothing left vague
  • For P1/P0 incidents, join the Lead immediately — contribute to the investigation rather than waiting for direction

Monitoring & Alerting

  • Check GCP monitoring dashboards and Zendesk alert channels at shift start — surface anything anomalous before clients report it
  • Track open incidents across shifts and ensure clean handoff to the team at end of US day
  • Flag alert noise or misconfigured thresholds to the Lead — you are on the front line and will notice signal problems first

Client Communication

  • Write clear, professional, jargon-free updates to banking client operations teams during and after incidents
  • Follow up on resolved tickets — confirm the fix, provide a plain-language explanation, close cleanly
  • Maintain a professional tone under pressure; bank clients operate in regulated, audit-sensitive environments

Documentation & Knowledge base

  • Document every new issue investigated — symptom, logs found, queries run, resolution or escalation path
  • Contribute to and improve runbook entries after resolving incidents
  • Build and share a personal MySQL query library for common investigation patterns

Technology Environment

  • Cloud platform: Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Logs & monitoring: GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring — primary investigation tools
  • Database: MySQL — read-only investigation queries (SELECT only; strict change-control for anything else)
  • Architecture: Microservices — REST APIs; tracing requests across services using correlation IDs
  • Ticketing: Zendesk — managing your queue, documenting investigations, client communication
  • Scripting: Python / Bash — desirable; the Lead will help you grow here if needed
  • Product domain: Commercial card programs — card issuance, payments authorization, settlement, spend controls
  • Client environment: US community and regional banks — SLA-bound, audit-sensitive, regulated

What We’re Looking For

  • 2–4 years in application support, technical support, IT operations, or a closely related role
  • Solid SQL — you write SELECT queries with JOINs, subqueries, and WHERE clauses without needing a template; you read query results and know what to look for
  • GCP Cloud Logging or equivalent — you have used at least one cloud log platform (CloudWatch, Splunk, Kibana, Datadog, or GCP) to investigate a real production issue
  • Familiarity with microservice concepts — you understand that a user action may touch multiple backend services and know how to trace a request across them
  • REST API literacy — HTTP status codes, reading API responses, identifying where in a request chain an error originated
  • Methodical troubleshooting — you rule out possibilities systematically and document as you go
  • Clear written communication — you can write a calm, professional client-facing update mid-incident
  • Change-control discipline — you never modify production data without explicit authorization

Nice to Have

  • GCP-specific experience — Cloud Logging query syntax (Log Explorer), Cloud Monitoring dashboard navigation
  • Familiarity with Zendesk as a support platform — using ticket views, macros, and SLA tracking
  • Basic Python or Bash scripting — log parsing, simple automation, or one-off scripts count
  • Experience in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment — fintech, banking, healthcare, or telecoms
  • Exposure to commercial card or payments concepts — authorization flows, settlement, spend controls — helpful but fully trainable

Working Hours

  • Standard shift of 8–10 hours per day, US business hours (Eastern or Central preferred for bank client coverage)
  • ~2-hour overlap with India team at start of US day — used for handoff, standups, and any incidents in flight

Role: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer

Experience: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience

Employment Type: Full-Time (US Remote)

Work Location: US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data.

Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge.

The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying.

You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement, build, and maintain production knowledge graph solutions across LPG and RDF graph technologies.
  • Build scalable pipelines to transform healthcare/FHIR data into appropriate graph representations.
  • Implement mappings between patient/clinical data and concepts represented in the clinical ontology.
  • Develop reusable mapping and transformation patterns rather than one-off implementations.
  • Implement consistent approaches for entity identity, canonical identifiers/URI/IRI, relationships, and concept linking.
  • Maintain provenance and traceability between source data, mapping rules, and resulting graph entities and relationships.
  • Develop and optimize graph queries using Cypher and/or SPARQL.
  • Implement automated validation and testing to identify unresolved mappings, inconsistent relationships, and other graph-quality issues.
  • Work with ontology, FHIR, terminology, and clinical SMEs to clarify ambiguous or missing mapping requirements.
  • Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software/data engineering experience, including hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph technologies.
  • Strong understanding of knowledge graph and graph data modeling concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with either:
    • Labeled Property Graphs, such as Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent, or
    • RDF/semantic technologies, such as RDF/RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
  • Working knowledge of, or ability to work across, both LPG and RDF graph models.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or similar languages.
  • Experience building production data ingestion, transformation, or integration pipelines.
  • Experience with graph databases and/or RDF triple stores.
  • Understanding of entity identity, graph relationships, mappings, provenance, and data quality.
  • Ability to translate conceptual models and mapping specifications into production implementations.
  • Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements and cross-functional technical/domain teams.

Other Qualifications (OQs)

  • Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs.
  • Healthcare or life sciences data experience.
  • Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, including concepts such as Coding, CodeableConcept, Reference, and Identifier.
  • Experience with ontology-driven data integration or semantic mapping.
  • Experience with SHACL or other graph/semantic validation approaches.
  • Experience with terminology/concept normalization and canonical concept mapping.
  • Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS.
  • Cloud and CI/CD experience.

What Sets You Apart?

  • Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs.
  • Healthcare or life sciences data experience with familiarity with HL7 FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS).
  • Experience with ontology-driven data integration, semantic mapping, and SHACL/semantic validation approaches.
  • Cloud and CI/CD engineering experience in production environment.

What you bring

Required

  • Demonstrable, hands-on development or integration experience with Fiserv DNA.

  • Direct experience using DNA APIs or integration interfaces, with the ability to explain the specific products, transactions and tools used.

  • Experience delivering or supporting at least one DNA-related solution in a production financial-services environment.

An asset

  • Experience supporting Canadian credit unions.

  • Experience with multiple DNA versions, upgrades or core banking conversions.

  • Integration experience involving digital banking, loan origination, CRM, payments or reporting platforms.

  • C#/.NET, SQL, Oracle/PLSQL, middleware, cloud platforms or CI/CD experience relevant to your previous DNA work.

  • Previous delivery experience with Fiserv, a credit union, a core banking service provider or a systems integrator.

What success looks like

You can independently assess a DNA integration requirement, identify the relevant interfaces and dependencies, and deliver a secure, tested and supportable solution. Please submit your résumé online, and include the following in your cover letter:

  4. Technical stack: Languages, databases, integration platforms and testing tools used.

jobs.description:
Role Title: Business Operations Expert

Role Type: Contract

Location: Remote, global

Required Skills:

  • Turning Real Operations Work Into a Defined Task

  • Objective Grading Criteria

  • Business Operations

  • Process Design and Ownership

  • Operational Reporting and Data Discrepancies

Opportunity Snapshot:

  • Pay: Up to $90/hour equivalent

  • Time per task: ~10 hours per task

  • Location: Fully remote — no geographic restrictions. Strong English required (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)

  • Next step: Complete the role-specific AI interview — it’s how your expertise gets in front of the client

  • Your tasks: Design realistic, multi-step business operations tasks with objective criteria for grading the output

Your domain knowledge is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.

The work is to turn real operational workflows into benchmark tasks: realistic, difficult, and gradable against objective criteria. If you’ve written an SOP, built a QA checklist, or trained a team against a standard, that’s the instinct this needs.

Scope of Work:

  • Design multi-step tasks drawn from real operations work — reporting, process design, workflow management — with realistic reference files and clear instructions.

  • Define objective grading criteria so two qualified reviewers would reach the same verdict on the same output.

  • Build tasks that require judgment rather than lookup: ones where the right answer depends on reading the materials correctly.

  • Create or source the supporting materials each task needs: spreadsheets, system exports, process documentation, operational reports.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable instead of submitting them anyway.

  • Deliver approved tasks on schedule and at the required quality level.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of hands-on responsibility in business operations, operations reporting, process design, or workflow management — direct ownership of the work, not supervisory-only or adjacent exposure.

  • Experience creating or applying structured standards: SOPs, QA checklists, process documentation, service level definitions, or training assessments.

  • Strong Excel capability and comfort reasoning across multiple documents at once.

  • Strong English, written and spoken — B2 minimum, C1 preferred.

  • AI or LLM evaluation experience is a plus, but not required.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Big Ideas PH is seeking a high-velocity, execution-driven Influencer Outreach Specialistwith dedicated experience in the beauty and skincare space to power creator activation programs for two premier US beauty brands:Patchology (micro-creator high-frequency seeding) and Kate Somerville(tiered authority outreach). Reporting directly to brand marketing leads and managers, this is a daily execution and high-cadence volume role centered on sourcing creators, driving outreach, managing end-to-end sample fulfillment, and converting contacts into organic brand advocacy. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love solving operational puzzles, and take pride in hitting daily conversion targets, this role is for you.

This is a full-time, contractual, freelancer position for a trial period of 3 months while working at home. If you are a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual with experience and qualified based on the criteria below, we encourage you to apply.

Upon successful completion of the evaluation period, the contractor's performance will be reviewed, potentially leading to a contract renewal that may include a benefits package.

JOB DESCRIPTION
​

  • High-Volume Daily Outreach: Execute 50–75 outbound creator or influencer touches per day across TikTok and Instagram using tailored, brand-aligned messaging (no generic mass-DM copy), using an influencer management platform

  • Dual-Engine Program Execution: Sourcing and activating creators against strategic briefs for two distinct brand engines:

    • Patchology (Velocity Engine): High-frequency micro-creator seeding and volume gifting.

    • Kate Somerville(Authority Engine): Tiered outreach targeting beauty creators, wellness influencers and lifestyle trendsetters.

  • Sample Fulfillment Workflow & Tracking: Manage end-to-end sample requests including logging creator addresses, submitting accurate warehouse requests, tracking timestamped shipments, and proactively following up to confirm receipt.

  • Creator Relationship Nurturing & Follow-Ups: Conduct timely post-outreach follow-ups to maintain creator engagement and maximize response-to-posted content conversion rates.

  • Content Auditing & Compliance Tracking:Monitor, log, and verify live creator posts to ensure accurate product tagging, adherence to brand messaging, and compliance with FTC disclosure guidelines.

  • Data Logging & Reporting Discipline:Daily and weekly tracking of outreach volume, response rates, sample shipments, and content output using spreadsheets or ShopMy/CRM tracking tools to roll up actionable performance data to brand leads.

  • CRM & Creator Database Management: Maintain a clean, organized creator directory categorized by creator tiers, skin concerns/niches, platform performance, and engagement metrics.

  • Daily Alignment & Problem Solving: Participate in daily standups or asynchronous check-ins with brand leaders, proactively troubleshooting stalled responses or shipping delays to maintain continuous workflow velocity

​

Requirements

  • EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

    • As least 2-3 years prior experience in influencer marketing, social media management, creator recruiting, talent outreach, or affiliate marketing management.

    • What this job is NOT:Not a community manager, not a content creator, not a paid media buyer.

  • TECHNICAL AND OTHER SKILLS (MUST-HAVES)

    • Direct Creator Outreach Experience:Proven experience in hands-on creator outreach on TikTok (including TikTok Shop Creator Marketplace / Affiliate Plan) and Instagram (DM, email, or native outreach tools). Generic social media management is not a substitute.

    • Seeding Platform Fluency:Direct operational familiarity with ShopMyor comparable creator gifting platforms (Superfiliate, GRIN, Aspire).

    • Fulfillment Operations Comfort:Hands-on experience working inside sample fulfillment workflows (address logging, warehouse coordination, and timestamped shipment tracking).

    • Exceptional English Communication:Fluency in written English required to draft personalized, brand-voice outreach messages that build authentic creator connection.

    • Rigorous Reporting Discipline:Consistent track record of daily/weekly data logging, tracker hygiene, and clear performance reporting.

    • High comfort working with spreadsheets(Google Sheets, MS Excel) and CRM-style tracking tools to maintain data accuracy.

    • Self-starter mindset with full comfort working toward daily/weekly outreach targets and performance KPIs.

  • PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

    • Beauty/CPG Industry Background:Hands-on experience in the beauty, skincare, or consumer packaged goods space.

    • Campaign Structure Knowledge:Ability to differentiate gifting/seeding workflows (low-cost, product-only) from contracted posting waves (negotiated deliverables and paid agreements).

    • FTC Disclosure Familiarity:Understanding of basic FTC compliance requirements for influencer gifting and sponsored content.

    • Experience utilizing AI tools(e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) with strong prompting skills to optimize outreach copy generation and communication efficiency.

    • Prior experience supporting US-based clients or working in a remote agency ecosystem.

  • REQUIREMENTS FOR REMOTE WORK

    • Eligible to legally work as a remote freelancer or contractor based in the Philippines.

    • Natural-born Filipino citizen or Foreigner with a working VISA or permit to legally work in the Philippines.

    • Has own computer or laptop capable of handling the rigorous demands of work.

    • Has a fast and reliable internet connection at home (at least 200-300 MBPS)

    • Has a quiet and distraction free work environment at home.

    • Willing to work in graveyard shifts or changing shift US schedules.

HOURS OF WORK

  • Work from home. Full-time freelancer, contractual position

  • Full-time, 40 hours per week (8 guaranteed paid hours per workday, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour unpaid break).

  • US Time Zone / Graveyard Shift 9:00AM to 6:00 Eastern EST, USA time zone

  • US Holidays are observed off (unpaid during trial); PH Holidays are regular workdays. Overtime requires prior client approval.


Benefits

  • COMPENSATION:$7 to $10 per hour GROSS rate depending on experience
  • TAXATION:As per Philippine Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) regulations, professional fees for self-employed individuals are subject to a5% or 10% Expanded Withholding Tax (EWT). The final tax will be calculated based on the freelancer's submission of a valid Certificate of Registration (COR) as self-employed.
  • CONTRACT:This is a 3-month long freelancing trial contract (full-time) that can be done remotely at home with a computer and a fast and reliable internet connection. There are no benefits for Freelancers during the evaluation period.
  • EXCLUSIVITY OF ENGAGEMENT:By accepting a full-time freelancer contract with Big Ideas, you agree that this position serves as your sole full-time role. Upon executing this contract, you are required to formally resign from and relinquish any existing full-time employment or contracts. Secondary part-time roles or freelance commitments are permitted, provided they are transparently declared prior to signing, do not present a conflict of interest, and do not compromise your availability or performance.​
  • POSSIBLE RENEWAL:However, if the Client decides to renew the contract there may be certain benefits such as paid sick leaves, paid vacation leaves, HMO health insurance and 13th month pay. These are not guaranteed and everything will depend on performance and client discretion.
  • REPORTING TO:Although you will be reporting directly to the designated manager from our client, you will also be reporting to and will be supervised by Big Ideas Social Media Inc, who is the consultant and service provider (Agency) of the US business. Big Ideas will be the ones to provide your compensation and other HR and administrative needs locally.
  • LEGAL STATUS:You will be classified as “Self-Employed” when it concerns legality and taxation. You will not be considered an employee of our Client or Big Ideas Philippines but instead, you will be a self-employed freelance professional.
  • SCREENING AND VETTING PROCESS: We use AI tools to assist our team with initial application reviews and resume screening. These tools are strictly supportive; human judgment is at the core of our process, and all final hiring decisions are made by people. For information regarding your data privacy, please contact us.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft Environment (Core Focus)

  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and security policies through Azure AD / Entra ID
  • Support email setup, migrations, troubleshooting, and spam/security controls

Systems & Server Support

  • Monitor and maintain Windows Servers (on-premise and/or cloud)
  • Assist with backups, patching, updates, and system performance
  • Support virtual environments such as Hyper-V or VMware

Network Management

  • Monitor and maintain LAN/WAN, routers, firewalls, and switches
  • Troubleshoot connectivity issues and outages
  • Support VPN access and remote user connectivity

Helpdesk & User Support

  • Provide Level 1–2 support across hardware, software, and access issues
  • Resolve support tickets efficiently and escalate when required
  • Support onboarding/offboarding including device setup, email, and system access

Security & Compliance

  • Support endpoint security, antivirus, and monitoring tools
  • Maintain access controls, MFA, and security policies
  • Assist with backups, recovery processes, and data protection practices

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain IT documentation, user guides, and support processes
  • Track recurring issues and resolutions
  • Assist in reporting system performance and risks

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years experience in IT support / systems administration
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365 and Exchange environments

Why You'll Love This Role

Innovation happens when the right people, ideas, and technology come together. At Arrow, our Sales teams connect customers with the expertise, solutions, and global capabilities they need to move faster, solve complex challenges, and stay ahead of what's next.

Role Overview

The HPE SLED West Channel Manager is responsible for driving HPE growth across the West. This individual will work closely with HPE, Arrow supplier teams, and key public sector channel partners to create demand, identify growth opportunities, expand HPE portfolio adoption, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience with HPE's portfolio, deep knowledge of public sector procurement and sales motions, and established relationships throughout the SLED ecosystem.

  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, business planning, and executive communication skills.
  • Ability to analyze business performance, identify growth opportunities, and execute strategic initiatives.
  • Strong Salesforce.com and forecasting discipline.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented leader with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

We believe new technologies have the power to make life not only different, but better. At Arrow, we're helping make that future possible. We enable customers and suppliers to design and distribute technology around the world, connecting people, ideas, and innovation to solve real-world challenges. Guided by our purpose of making the benefits of technology accessible to all, we provide expertise, solutions, and connections that help shape what's next. As a global technology solutions provider, Arrow offers opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build a meaningful career while making an impact around the world.

Life at Arrow

At Arrow, we believe innovation starts with people. We create an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning help our employees grow and make a meaningful impact every day. From your first day, you'll have opportunities to build new skills, work alongside talented teams around the world, and contribute to technology that helps shape a better future. Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Care Manager – RCT to join our team! Trillium’s Care Manager – RCT plays a vital role in ensuring members receive whole person-centered care to meet their individual and complex physical, mental health, and social needs. The Care Manager serves as the single point of contact for members and works with a multidisciplinary care team, including primary care providers, specialists, care manager extenders, transition staff, and caretakers/legal guardians to promote continuity of care and quality care for each member. The Care Manager – RCT would be expected to work and be available at their remote location between the hours of 8:30 am – 5:00pm and be flexible to travel within the community to meet with members as well as attend other meetings as needed.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned members, providing ongoing care management and advocacy.
  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of member needs using person-centered planning methods and organizational tools.
  • Develop, implement, and monitor individualized care plans in collaboration with members, families, and multidisciplinary support teams.
  • Coordinate services across providers, agencies, and community resources to address member physical, behavioral, and social health needs.
  • Ensure assessments and care plans are updated to reflect changes in member needs and circumstances.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • Must meet Qualified Professional (QP) status.
  1. Fully licensed by the NC governing board regulating Human Services professions; OR Fully licensed RN who is licensed to practice in the state of NC by the NC Board of Nursing who also has four (4) years of full-time experience with the MH/DD/SA population served. OR
  2. A graduate of a college or university with a master’s degree in a human service field and has one year of full-time, pre or post-graduate degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has one year of full-time, pre or postgraduate degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  3. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a human service field and has two years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has two years of full-time, pre or post bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling; OR
  4. A graduate of a college or university with a bachelor's degree in a field other than human services and has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated MH/DD/SA experience with the MH/DD/SA population, or a substance abuse professional who has four years of full-time, pre or post-bachelor's degree accumulated supervised experience in alcoholism and drug abuse counseling.
  • Additionally, If serving members with Long Term Services and Support (LTSS) needs, the care manager, must meet the minimum QP requirements defined above (A-D) and shall additionally have at a minimum two (2) years of prior LTSS and/or Home and Community Based Service (HCBS) coordination, care delivery monitoring and care management experience. This experience may be concurrent with the years of experience required to become a Qualified Professional.
  • License and/or certification may be accepted as noted above.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within 75 miles of Trillium’s South Central Region, which includes the following counties: Carteret, Craven, Duplin, Jones, Lenoir, Onslow, Pender, Sampson, and Wayne.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship for employment now or in the future (ex: OPT F-1, J-1).

Preferred:

  • A degree in a field related to health, psychology, sociology, social work, nursing, or any other relevant human services field.

Deadline for Application:Wednesday November 4, 2026, at 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, project managers and international stakeholders, your expertise will directly influence the technical quality, efficiency and successful delivery of our projects.

Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

As a Data Engineer in the Casualty Analytics Group, you will build and maintain the data infrastructure that powers Enlyte’s analytics and decision-making capabilities. You’ll join a growing engineering team and be responsible for developing robust data pipelines that integrate data from multiple source systems into our Snowflake data warehouse, ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility for downstream analytics. You'll have the opportunity to take on increasing ownership as the team and platform mature

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain production data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt to integrate and transform data from various sources (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Salesforce)
  • Implement data models and transformations following established architectural patterns and team standards
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders and senior engineers to understand data requirements and deliver high-value integrations
  • Write and maintain documentation for pipelines, data models, and engineering processes
  • Contribute to data governance and quality practices, including testing, monitoring, and alerting
  • Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback to maintain pipeline quality
  • Build proof-of-concepts and MVPs that demonstrate value for larger data initiatives

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience building data pipelines in production cloud environments
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including performance tuning and window functions
  • Working knowledge of Python for data pipeline development and automation
  • Experience with modern data stack technologies including Snowflake, dbt, data ingestion tools (e.g. Snowflake Openflow, Fivetran), orchestration tools (e.g. Dagster, Airflow), AI-assisted development (e.g. Snowflake CoCo, GitHub CoPilot)
  • Familiarity with OLTP databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server), with understanding of the differences between OLTP and OLAP systems
  • Experience working with AWS cloud services for data workloads (S3 or similar)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and version control workflows (e.g. Git, pull requests, automated testing)
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical work to non-technical stakeholders
  • Proactive and self-motivated, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities

Preferred Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience with Medallion Architecture
  • Experience with using containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes to deploy and manage data applications
  • Experience with analytics platforms like Hex and/or BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Understanding of the insurance industry, particularly workers' compensation or P&C insurance

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $34.46 - $55.28 hourly, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Job Title:

Cloud Solution Architect -GitHub Enterprise

Job Description

Technical Products and Services (TPS):

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Overview:

As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will lead the design, optimization, and modernization of enterprise-scale source control and developer collaboration platforms, with a strong focus on large-scale GitHub Enterprise Server environments. This role is ideal for a highly experienced architect who brings deep infrastructure expertise, DevOps transformation experience, and hands-on leadership in building secure, resilient, high-performing platforms that support thousands of developers across global organizations.

You will serve as a trusted technical advisor, partnering with engineering, infrastructure, security, and executive stakeholders to deliver scalable architecture, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence for complex enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise-grade source control and developer collaboration platforms using GitHub Enterprise Server.
  • Create scalable architecture patterns that support global development teams, CI/CD pipelines, software engineering excellence, and developer productivity.
  • Develop technical roadmaps for platform modernization, migration, optimization, and long-term scalability.
  • Provide architectural governance, technical standards, and best-practice guidance across DevOps and platform engineering teams.
  • Lead deployment, configuration, administration, and optimization of GitHub Enterprise Server environments.
  • Architect high-availability, disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity solutions for mission-critical developer platforms.
  • Design integration strategies across identity, security, monitoring, ticketing, CI/CD, and enterprise infrastructure systems.
  • Support complex multi-region and large-scale enterprise implementations, including on-premises environments.
  • Perform detailed infrastructure sizing and capacity planning assessments.
  • Analyze repository growth, storage consumption, network utilization, system performance trends, and platform usage patterns.
  • Develop forecasting models to support future platform growth, infrastructure investment, and organizational expansion.
  • Recommend scaling strategies based on utilization data, business demand, and operational requirements.
  • Conduct system health assessments and performance reviews across application, database, storage, network, and infrastructure layers.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve platform responsiveness, scalability, reliability, and user experience.
  • Establish performance baselines, monitoring frameworks, operational KPIs, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Provide architectural oversight for Linux-based platform infrastructure.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, and DevOps teams to ensure platform stability, compliance, and operational readiness.
  • Design monitoring, observability, automation, and operational excellence frameworks.
  • Lead root cause analysis and remediation efforts for critical platform incidents.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to engineering leaders, platform teams, and executive stakeholders.
  • Mentor engineers, administrators, and architects on enterprise DevOps platform architecture and best practices.
  • Lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, strategic planning sessions, and modernization discussions.
  • Drive adoption of modern platform engineering practices that improve developer experience, productivity, and delivery outcomes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 10–15+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, DevOps, cloud, platform engineering, or solution architecture roles.
  • 5+ years of deep, hands-on experience with GitHub Enterprise Server.
  • Strong experience supporting large-scale, on-premises GitHub deployments.
  • Proven expertise in enterprise platform sizing, capacity planning, usage analysis, and growth forecasting.
  • Advanced knowledge of performance tuning methodologies and infrastructure optimization.
  • Strong experience with: Linux administration, Networking fundamentals, Load balancing technologies, Storage architectures, High availability and disaster recovery design, Security and identity integrations
  • Experience supporting environments with thousands of users and large-scale repository footprints.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, consulting, advisory, and technical leadership skills.
  • Experience leading enterprise DevOps transformation initiatives preferred.
  • Experience architecting hybrid infrastructure environments preferred.
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle, SDLC, best practices preferred.
  • Experience integrating source control platforms with CI/CD ecosystems preferred.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions preferred.
  • Experience with performance diagnostics, observability platforms, and monitoring tools preferred.
  • Background supporting global engineering organizations preferred.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Principal Sales Solutions Consultant is a strategic, client-facing healthcare technology advisor responsible for helping drive revenue growth through consultative discovery, enterprise solution architecture, value engineering, and technical pre-sales leadership.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Principal Sales Solutions Consultant is a strategic, client-facing healthcare technology advisor responsible for helping drive revenue growth through consultative discovery, enterprise solution architecture, value engineering, and technical pre-sales leadership.

Partnering closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, and Client Engagement teams, this individual works with prospective and existing healthcare payer clients to understand their business strategies, operational challenges, technology environments, and desired outcomes. The Lead Sales Solutions Consultant translates these insights into integrated Cotiviti solutions that connect data, intelligence, interoperability, analytics, workflow, and healthcare domain expertise.

This role extends beyond traditional product demonstrations or product-specific solution support. The Lead Sales Solutions Consultant develops comprehensive solution strategies, architects future-state environments across multiple capabilities, and creates executive-level narratives that clearly articulate the financial, operational, clinical, member, and strategic value of Cotiviti’s solutions.

The position supports complex sales pursuits across Cotiviti’s Health Enablement, Interoperability, Payment Integrity, and related solution portfolios. Success requires deep healthcare payer knowledge, strong technical and architectural credibility, executive presence, commercial acumen, and the ability to connect individual client needs to broader enterprise opportunities.

The role is equally comfortable discussing payer strategy and business outcomes with executive leaders, operational workflows with business stakeholders, solution architecture with technology leaders, and value creation with financial decision-makers. This broader, horizontal solution-consulting model reflects the organization’s goal of telling a comprehensive, end-to-end client story across business units rather than positioning isolated products.

Responsibilities

Strategic Discovery and Client Advisory

  • Lead strategic discovery sessions with prospective and existing healthcare payer clients to understand their business priorities, operational challenges, technology environments, regulatory obligations, and desired outcomes.
  • Conduct current-state assessments that evaluate client workflows, administrative platforms, data ecosystems, integration requirements, technical constraints, and organizational readiness.
  • Identify the underlying business problems clients are seeking to solve and translate those challenges into clear solution requirements and success measures.
  • Facilitate executive workshops, architecture discussions, solution-design sessions, and strategic whiteboarding engagements.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive, business, operational, and technical stakeholders throughout the sales cycle.
  • Develop a strong understanding of assigned clients and accounts to provide relevant, informed, and forward-looking solution guidance.
  • Help clients evaluate future-state opportunities related to operational performance, payment accuracy, interoperability, regulatory readiness, data exchange, member experience, and healthcare outcomes.

Enterprise Solution Strategy and Architecture

  • Develop integrated, end-to-end solution strategies that connect Cotiviti capabilities across interoperability, data, analytics, intelligence, workflow, and healthcare payer domains.
  • Design and articulate solution architectures that address data ingestion, transformation, integration, APIs, interoperability patterns, security considerations, operational workflows, and scalable deployment approaches.
  • Architect the broader client environment and explain how individual solution components work together to deliver measurable business value.
  • Translate complex business, operational, regulatory, and technical requirements into feasible and differentiated solution designs.
  • Develop current-state and future-state architecture views, data flows, integration models, and solution roadmaps.
  • Balance client requirements with Cotiviti’s product capabilities, implementation models, delivery resources, and strategic direction.
  • Identify solution assumptions, dependencies, technical risks, implementation considerations, and potential barriers to client adoption.
  • Lead or support proofs of concept, pilots, architecture reviews, and technical validations to confirm solution fit and reduce implementation risk.

Pre-Sales Leadership and Complex Pursuit Strategy

  • Lead the technical and solution-consulting strategy for assigned complex healthcare payer opportunities throughout the sales cycle.
  • Partner with Sales to develop pursuit strategies, clarify client value drivers, position Cotiviti’s differentiators, and align proposed solutions with client priorities.
  • Coordinate Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, Security, Legal, and domain experts during complex pursuits.
  • Anticipate and proactively address technical, operational, functional, regulatory, commercial, and competitive objections.
  • Support opportunity qualification by assessing solution fit, technical feasibility, implementation considerations, competitive positioning, and the potential value to the client.
  • Strengthen the sales pipeline by identifying technical differentiators, cross-sell opportunities, expansion opportunities, and future client needs.
  • Maintain a forward-looking perspective on assigned accounts by identifying what the client may need next and connecting those needs to the broader Cotiviti portfolio.
  • Help reduce sales-cycle friction by establishing early alignment among client expectations, proposed solution capabilities, and delivery requirements.
  • Ensure solution commitments are documented, achievable, and aligned with Cotiviti’s product capabilities and delivery expectations.

Value Engineering and Executive-Level Storytelling

  • Develop compelling executive-level narratives that explain why the proposed solution matters, how it supports the client’s strategy, and what outcomes it can deliver.
  • Connect solution capabilities to measurable financial, operational, clinical, member, regulatory, and strategic value.
  • Develop value propositions and business cases that quantify, where feasible, the potential impact of Cotiviti solutions.
  • Apply value-engineering principles to help clients understand expected benefits, improvement opportunities, implementation considerations, and investment rationale.
  • Communicate effectively with C-suite executives, business leaders, operational stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, and other decision-makers.
  • Adjust the depth, terminology, and presentation style based on the audience while maintaining consistency in the overall solution narrative.
  • Build credibility with executive stakeholders by demonstrating strong healthcare payer knowledge, business acumen, and technical expertise.

Executive Engagement, Solution Storytelling, and Client Workshops

  • Lead executive workshops, solution-strategy sessions, technical workshops, and architecture discussions tailored to client priorities, stakeholder needs, and desired business outcomes.
  • Develop business-led solution narratives that connect client challenges, Cotiviti capabilities, architectural choices, and measurable outcomes.
  • Use presentations, demonstrations, and other visual techniques selectively to support the broader solution narrative and validate fit; avoid feature-led or isolated product presentations.
  • Lead whiteboarding sessions that clearly communicate current-state challenges, future-state designs, workflows, data exchanges, decision points, and expected business value.
  • Respond effectively to real-time questions, objections, competitive concerns, and evolving client priorities while maintaining a coherent strategic narrative.
  • Present sophisticated healthcare, operating-model, data, and technology concepts clearly and persuasively to executive, business, operational, and technical audiences.
  • Create reusable executive narratives, workshop frameworks, value stories, architectural patterns, presentation materials, and—where appropriate—demonstration assets that strengthen the broader Solutions Consulting practice.

Healthcare Payer and Technical Expertise

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in healthcare payer operations, technology environments, and data ecosystems.
  • Apply knowledge of payer administrative platforms and workflows, including claims, encounters, enrollment, eligibility, membership, prior authorization, provider management, payment integrity, risk adjustment, quality improvement, Stars, HEDIS, and member engagement.
  • Demonstrate a good understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and technologies.
  • Apply knowledge of integration patterns, ETL processes, cloud technologies, enterprise architecture, analytics platforms, workflow automation, and complex healthcare data flows.
  • Understand how artificial intelligence, machine learning, advanced analytics, and automation may be applied to relevant healthcare payer use cases.
  • Maintain current knowledge of CMS requirements, interoperability and prior authorization mandates, market developments, emerging technologies, payer priorities, and competitive offerings.
  • Develop deep expertise in one or more Cotiviti solution or healthcare domains while maintaining the breadth required to position integrated, cross-portfolio solutions.
  • Articulate how technical components work together to address broader payer business challenges and produce measurable outcomes.

Solution Strategy, Business Case, and Technical Validation

  • Develop integrated solution recommendations and business cases that connect client priorities to Cotiviti capabilities, differentiators, implementation considerations, and expected outcomes.
  • Ensure client-facing recommendations communicate a cohesive enterprise solution and value strategy rather than disconnected product capabilities.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Security, and Delivery stakeholders to validate solution strategy, proposed architectures, value assumptions, commitments, implementation assumptions, and delivery requirements.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, gaps, decision points, and areas requiring additional validation before commercial or delivery commitments are made.
  • Lead or support proofs of concept, pilots, technical workshops, and other validation activities when they are the most effective way to reduce decision risk and advance client alignment.
  • Lead the solution strategy and substantive technical and value content for proposals and RFP responses; proposal administration and coordination are not the primary purpose of this role.

Pipeline Development and Account Expansion

  • Build and maintain account-specific knowledge to support stronger client engagement, solution continuity, and enterprise growth.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to identify cross-sell, upsell, and multi-solution opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Connect immediate client requirements to broader Cotiviti capabilities and longer-term strategic opportunities.
  • Help develop an actionable opportunity funnel by identifying emerging needs, future initiatives, and potential transformation priorities.
  • Recognize patterns across clients and markets that may indicate new solution opportunities or evolving buyer expectations.
  • Support larger and more strategic pursuits by positioning Cotiviti as an enterprise solution partner rather than solely as a product or point-solution provider.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Market Influence

  • Partner closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, Client Engagement, and other internal teams to develop coordinated solution strategies.
  • Engage appropriate product, healthcare-domain, architecture, and delivery experts based on the client’s needs and the complexity of the proposed solution.
  • Serve as connective tissue among clients, the market, Sales, Product, and Technology by translating external insights into actionable internal feedback.
  • Provide structured client, market, competitive, and technology insights to support product strategy, roadmap planning, investment decisions, and innovation.
  • Identify capability gaps and recurring client requirements that may inform future product development or partnership opportunities.
  • Contribute to the Solutions Consulting community by sharing best practices, competitive insights, value-engineering approaches, reusable assets, and architectural patterns.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to other Solutions Consultants during complex pursuits, demonstrations, workshops, and client engagements.
  • Represent Cotiviti at client forums, executive workshops, industry events, conferences, and other strategic engagements as needed.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare, business, computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 12+ years of experience in healthcare technology, solution consulting, pre-sales, sales engineering, enterprise architecture, healthcare consulting, or a comparable client-facing role.
  • Significant experience working within the healthcare payer ecosystem and a strong understanding of payer business models, operational processes, technology environments, and data ecosystems.
  • Experience selling, positioning, or supporting complex enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead strategic discovery, current-state assessments, solution workshops, architecture discussions, whiteboarding sessions, demonstrations, and technical validation.
  • Experience designing and articulating integrated, end-to-end solution architectures, including data flows, integrations, APIs, workflows, and interoperability patterns.
  • Knowledge of payer domains such as claims, encounters, enrollment, eligibility, prior authorization, payment integrity, provider management, risk adjustment, quality improvement, and member engagement.
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect technology capabilities to financial, operational, clinical, member, regulatory, and strategic value.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives, business leaders, operational stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, and technical professionals.
  • Experience developing and delivering executive presentations, solution demonstrations, technical workshops, business cases, and architecture recommendations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and operational information into clear, compelling, value-oriented narratives.
  • Knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies and the practices associated with complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-management, and stakeholder-engagement capabilities.
  • Ability to influence decisions and build alignment without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent opportunities, and remain effective in a fast-paced sales environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Product, Technology, Engineering, Delivery, and client-facing teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for client meetings, workshops, conferences, and other business needs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Cotiviti solutions or comparable healthcare analytics, interoperability, payment integrity, payer technology, or enterprise healthcare software platforms.
  • Deep expertise in one or more areas such as Payment Integrity, Risk Adjustment, Quality, Stars, HEDIS, Interoperability, Prior Authorization, Provider-Payer Connectivity, or payer data exchange.
  • Experience positioning integrated enterprise solutions that span multiple products, business units, healthcare domains, or technology platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise architecture, APIs, integration patterns, ETL processes, cloud-based data platforms, analytics, workflow automation, and complex healthcare data ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with CMS requirements, interoperability mandates, prior authorization regulations, and other healthcare payer compliance considerations.
  • Experience developing quantified business cases or applying value-engineering principles during complex sales pursuits.
  • Experience supporting proofs of concept, pilots, enterprise transformation initiatives, and strategic account expansion.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation, or advanced analytics to healthcare payer use cases.
  • Experience with consultative selling, design thinking, customer journey mapping, or outcome-based solution development.
  • Master’s degree in healthcare, business, technology, engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Relevant healthcare, enterprise architecture, cloud, interoperability, sales engineering, or technology certifications.

Cognitive and Mental Requirements

  • Ability to analyze complex business, operational, regulatory, and technical information and communicate conclusions clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to evaluate incomplete or evolving information and recommend an appropriate path forward.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy, responsiveness, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to retain and apply evolving knowledge of Cotiviti solutions, healthcare regulations, industry practices, client environments, and competitive offerings.
  • Mental flexibility to adapt communication style, presentation strategy, and technical depth to different audiences and situations.
  • Ability to remain composed, think quickly, and respond professionally during high-pressure client and sales engagements.
  • Strong organizational and planning skills to support multiple concurrent opportunities, accounts, and client activities.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Ability to remain in a stationary position, including sitting or standing, for prolonged periods.
  • Ability to perform repetitive motions involving the wrists, hands, and fingers.
  • Ability to travel as required for client-facing engagements and other business needs.
  • Must be able to provide and maintain reliable high-speed internet connectivity and an appropriate remote-office setup.
  • Must be able to maintain a dedicated and secure work area.

General Statement

Complete all responsibilities outlined through the annual performance review and goal-setting process, as well as special projects and other duties as assigned. Duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. It does not constitute an employment agreement and may be modified as Cotiviti’s business needs and the requirements of the position evolve.

Base compensation ranges from $160,000 to $195,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

This role is eligible for commission.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 10/20/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 12/202026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: Proposal Specialist
jobs.excerpt: As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the Proposal Specialist leads the end-to-end proposal process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations, running color team reviews from assignment through submission, supporting post-submission activities and coordinating all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors into one cohesive response.
jobs.description:
As the "quarterback" of each pursuit, the Proposal Specialist leads the end-to-end proposal process for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs and similar solicitations, running color team reviews from assignment through submission, supporting post-submission activities and coordinating all resources across sales, technical, pricing, contracts, legal, program management, partners and vendors into one cohesive response.

The role calls for both a strong persuasive writer and a disciplined project manager. The Proposal Specialist uses content library/knowledge management platforms and company-approved generative AI tools to produce compliant, compelling, win-focused responses efficiently. The ultimate goal of the role is to increase win rates and drive revenue.


What You Will Do:


Opportunity Assessment & Planning

  • Analyze solicitations for requirements, evaluation criteria, instructions and risks; build compliance matrices and outlines mapping each requirement to an owner.
  • Research the customer's priorities, constraints and hot buttons, the incumbent and the competitive landscape.
  • Provide relevant context and input for sales-led bid/no-bid decisions.

Proposal Leadership & Project Management

  • Build a schedule backward from the due date, define roles and track actions, risks and dependencies.
  • Manage concurrent proposals, hold contributors accountable without direct authority, escalate issues early.

Color Team Review Process

  • Plan, facilitate and adjudicate Kickoff, Pink (first draft), Red (final draft), Gold (page by page compliance); coordinate Green (pricing) reviews owned by sales or technical leads.

Strategy, Win Themes & Writing

  • Work with the opportunity team to develop the win strategy, win themes, discriminators and value propositions.
  • Write, edit and tailor persuasive, accurate, compliant content in one voice, aligned to evaluation criteria.

AI & Content Library

  • Use company-approved generative AI tools to analyze and deepen understanding of solicitations, draft and refine content, summarize requirements and speed up reviews.
  • Verify AI output, protect confidential data, and grow the content library, templates and boilerplate.

Compliance, Production & Submission

  • Ensure compliance with instructions, forms, certifications, formatting and page limits; manage final assembly, quality control and on-time submission, including via portals.

Post-Submission Support

  • Support clarifications, Q&A, orals, BAFOs and protests as needed, in a supporting rather than leading role.
  • Request and conduct debriefs, capture lessons learned, support award transition and close out opportunities.

Department Contribution

  • Join training, department and process-improvement initiatives, industry days and pre-proposal conferences; share best practices with peers.

What We Expect of You:

Minimum Basic requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Two or more years of proposal writing, proposal management, project management, technical/business writing or editorial experience.
  • Excellent writing, editing and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple deadline-driven projects at the same time.
  • Strong attention to detail and a focus on compliance.
  • Working proficiency with generative AI tools and a willingness to adopt new technology.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint) and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Sound judgment, composure under pressure and constructive communication with all levels of the organization, including executives.

Preferred skills, experience, and qualities needed

  • Public sector or government procurement knowledge, including contracts, T&Cs and purchasing requirements.
  • General knowledge of IT products, services and solutions.
  • Experience with proposal content/RFP response platforms and structured color team reviews (e.g., Shipley).
  • APMP certification (Foundation or Practitioner) or PMI certification (CAPM or PMP).

Pay range: $71,000 - $100,000 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 5% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials

CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. Levi Strauss & Co. isn't your typical retailer. We've been pushing boundaries since 1873, inventing the blue jean, redefining khakis, and breaking barriers with size-inclusive activewear. We champion sustainability and ethical practices. Our brands (Levi's®, Beyond Yoga®) stand for freedom and self-expression.


We're looking for a Manager, Retail Inventory Operations, to support optimal product availability and operational efficiency within the US and Canada retail store fleet. This role leads the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of all in-store inventory management (inbound/outbound logistics) and serves as the primary business owner for the in-store technology roadmap and our point-of-sale system. The ultimate goal is to minimize inventory loss (shrink) while equipping store teams with the best possible processes and technology to deliver a world-class customer experience. You will report to the Senior Director, Retail Enablement & Operations and lead a small team.

Responsibilities

  • Design, document, and oversee all in-store logistics processes, including receiving, unpacking, sorting, processing returns, managing store-to-store transfers, and preparing outbound shipments.
  • Implement and monitor strategies to maximize on-floor in-stocks and overall product availability, leveraging RFID tools.
  • Establish mandatory training and compliance standards to maintain high levels of physical inventory accuracy across the sales floor, back-of-house, and staging areas.
  • Serve as the operational liaison with the Transportation and Supply Chain teams to ensure optimal delivery cadence, receiving windows, and carrier performance align with store operational capacity.
  • Lead omni-channel capability management and execution, ensuring seamless customer experiences across fulfillment services including Buy Online, Pick Up In Store (BOPIS), Ship From Store, and other emerging omni-channel offerings.
  • Develop and lead the strategy to reduce operational and administrative shrink, working closely with Loss Prevention and Finance teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Design and execute internal inventory audit programs to proactively identify and address risks to inventory integrity before they result in loss.
  • Partner directly with Digital and Technology teams to manage the in-store technology roadmap, prioritizing projects that deliver the greatest impact on efficiency and customer experience.
  • Oversee the lifecycle management, replacement, procurement, and deployment of all in-store hardware, including POS systems, handheld scanners, mobile devices, and related networking equipment.
  • Act as the voice of the store associate and the consumer to influence system design and technology choices, ensuring new tools are intuitive, reliable, and directly solve store operational needs.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of two Inventory and Technology Operations Specialists, ensuring clear goals, continuous performance feedback, and opportunities for growth.
  • Collaborate with Retail Training to ensure all new inventory processes and technology rollouts are accompanied by high-quality training materials and successful change management strategies.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with senior leaders and peers across Retail Operations, IT, Finance, and Supply Chain to ensure organizational alignment on inventory and technology goals.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in workforce management, retail operations analytics, labor planning, or related analytical roles
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, data modeling, strong analytical skills, financial acumen, knowledge of retail stores and service models
  • Ability to present to executive leadership, ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, and ability to influence cross-functional teams and partners to drive projects forward deliver on objectives
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working with diverse cross-functional partners, including field teams, Finance, IT, and Product teams
  • Working knowledge of retail processes and service models, with the ability to identify opportunities to improve operating routines
  • Experience leading direct reports or project teams, with the ability to coach, prioritize work, and drive execution through others
